jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description: We are **LOTTE BIOLOGICS**! **Delivering Therapies That Enable a Healthier World**. A new company, built on 80 years of tradition. We embody our core values of being **Inspired by Science**, **Embracing Diversity**, **Fostering Talent**, and **Connecting Lives**. Our mission is to be the most trusted partner in the industry, with high standards of quality and continuous innovation, to reliably deliver benefits for patients worldwide. **Position Summary** The Associate Automation Engineer is a key member of the IT Automation team supporting process controlled automated systems at the Syracuse, NY manufacturing facility. The primary role of the associate automation engineer is to design and participate in the implementation of engineering solutions for process equipment controls, S88 batch controls, hardware, device integration, and server support for the production and building control systems. The role will work directly with process experts in determining automation requirements, developing specifications, implementing hardware/software strategies, testing designs, providing rotating 24/7 support for manufacturing systems, and working safely and efficiently in a high compliance environment. **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Owns end\-to\-end responsibility for providing design recommendations for automation related projects, ensuring processes are configured per user functional requirements. * Support the operation of all GMP/ Non GMP manufacturing systems (Process Automation Systems and Building Automation Systems) in the Manufacturing facilities at Syracuse, NY. * Participate in root case investigations of IT Automation problems and propose solutions to prevent recurrence. * Support the configuration, testing and implementation of process control solutions to a variety of complex technical problems. * Ensure the documentation of the knowledge base on how to resolve issues encountered, thus facilitate the job for future activities. * Provide oversight and ownership on the Automated Manufacturing processes, including Batch Recipes, Formulas, Phases, automated sequences, hardware, and networking components. * Participate in Lean OpEx initiatives that align with site strategy and interact with cross\-functional groups to achieve departmental and organizational goals. * Conduct all job activities in accordance with cGMP and EHS requirements. **Education \& Experience** * Knowledge of engineering or sciences generally attained through studies resulting in a B.S. in, engineering, science, biochemistry or related discipline or its equivalent is highly desired * Direct biologic manufacturing experience of 3\+ years is desired. * Knowledge and proven expertise of engineering and operating principles related to typical biopharmaceutical upstream and downstream processing and support equipment including but not limited to bioreactors, filtration and ultra\-filtration, CIP, SIP, centrifugation, chromatography, and media and buffer make\-up is preferred. * Experience with Emerson DeltaV Distributed Control Systems and/or Rockwell/Allen Bradley PLCs preferred. **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities** * Knowledge of products and technologies provided by major automation vendors, including but not limited to: Emerson \- DeltaV, Rockwell – Factory Talk \& Thin Manager, and Millipore – Common Control Platform. * Experience in deploying computing hardware and communication systems that include PCs, servers, thin clients, Ethernet infrastructure. Knowledge of instrumentation bus protocols (Ethernet, Foundation FieldBus, ProfiBus, DeviceNet, etc.) a plus. * Ability to execute innovative process control solutions for continuous improvement for control of the manufacturing operations. * Understanding of Process Flow Diagrams, Standard Operating Procedures, and Manufacturing Batch Records to design appropriate controls system programming. * Technical problem solving and analysis skills as well as good communications skills (verbal and written). * Demonstrated experience in process control methods and industry standards. * Demonstrated ability to understand process design documents such as P\&IDs, electrical schematics, and loop drawings. * Demonstrated ability to participate in multi\-disciplined team environment to achieve goals. * Knowledge and understanding of applicable regulatory requirements. * Knowledge of current industry standards for Safety and Automation. * Adaptable to a fast paced, complex, and ever\-changing business environment. **Physical Demands** This position is primarily office\-based and requires frequent use of computers, monitors, keyboards, and other technology equipment for system configuration, programming, troubleshooting, and documentation activities. The role also requires regular visits to manufacturing and utility areas to support automation systems, equipment installations, investigations, testing, and commissioning activities. Employees may be required to stand, walk, climb stairs, bend, stoop, reach, and work around manufacturing equipment for extended periods. The ability to safely access production, utility, and mechanical spaces is required. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn when working in GMP manufacturing areas, laboratories, utility spaces, and other operational environments. Occasional lifting and carrying of equipment, tools, or computer hardware weighing up to 25 pounds may be required. **Work Environment** This position operates in a combination of office, laboratory, utility, and GMP manufacturing environments within a highly regulated biopharmaceutical facility. This role works closely with cross\-functional teams including Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Validation, Facilities, and Information Technology, while also performing independent project and troubleshooting activities. The role may require work in active manufacturing areas where noise levels, temperature variations, and operational equipment are present. Participation in system implementations, maintenance activities, investigations, and troubleshooting efforts may occasionally require off\-shift support, weekends, holidays, or inclusion in a rotating 24/7 on\-call support schedule to ensure manufacturing and building automation systems remain operational. Adherence to cGMP, safety, and environmental health requirements is required at all times. **Travel** The position may require up to 5% of travel. **Target Bonus** 8% **Work Location:** East Syracuse, NY ***We are an Equal Employment Opportunity ("EEO") Employer.*** ***We believe that women, people of color, veterans and LGBTQ communities must participate in the work we do, so we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of underrepresented communities! If this is the work that you want to do, in a culture of inclusion and excellence with the goal of making our world to be a healthier place, then please apply today!***

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - NY
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Scope Labs provides a full\-service startup ecosystem focused on design and development of digital platforms and experiences. We are a team of founders consisting of experienced product managers, designers, and developers. Our expertise lies in challenging fundamental assumptions, dissecting legacy behaviors, simplifying intricate processes, and delivering experiences that leave a lasting impact. We are a small, but driven team and are looking to expand! **Our Team** We're currently a small team passionate about developing the next generation of digital products. Our founding team has spent time building, designing, and scaling products at places like Google, Tesla, Palantir, Peloton, Scale AI, MIT, Yale, Columbia, Y Combinator, and more. We're currently hiring for an in person role working from warm and sunny New York City. **What We're Looking For** As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Scope Labs, you won't just be implementing solutions. You'll be embedded directly with our startup customers, owning the entire technical relationship from day one. We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering, product instinct, and customer partnership; someone who can walk into a startup's codebase on Monday and ship something meaningful by Friday. This role is for a builder who is equally comfortable digging into a customer's production environment and white boarding a new AI workflow with their engineering lead. You'll be deploying cutting\-edge AI tooling into real startup workflows at the frontier of what's possible, and you'll be the reason those deployments succeed. The specifics of what we're building are still under wraps, but if you're excited by the idea of being one of the first people to bring genuinely new technology into the hands of fast\-moving teams, this is that role. You will represent Scope Labs in the field. That means operating with autonomy, exercising strong judgment under ambiguity, and holding yourself accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. **Responsibilities** You'll own the full technical customer lifecycle. From initial deployment through activation and ongoing utilization, you are the person who makes sure our customers are actually getting value, not just access. You'll identify and champion high\-impact use cases. You'll work closely with startup engineering teams to understand their workflows, identify where AI can meaningfully accelerate them, and get those integrations shipped. You'll be the voice of the customer internally. You'll bring patterns, friction points, and product insights back to our Product and Engineering teams, helping shape the roadmap based on what you're seeing in the field. **Preferred Qualifications** * 3\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or startup experience. Former technical founders are strongly encouraged to apply. * Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript with a track record of shipping production software. * Hands\-on experience deploying or integrating AI tooling, including LLMs, AI agents, or AI\-native developer tools, into real workflows. * High agency with comfort operating in ambiguous environments and limited direction. * Strong communication skills across audiences, from senior engineers to non\-technical founders. * Team\-first attitude with the ability to juggle multiple customer engagements simultaneously. **Bonus Points** * Experience with AI agent frameworks, MCP servers, or autonomous coding tools in production. * Background in a specific startup or enterprise vertical such as fintech, developer tools, or healthcare. * Direct UX/UI experience or strong product sense. * A portfolio of passion projects or initiatives you've directly built or majority\-contributed to. *If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* **Salary and Benefits** The expected salary range for this role is based on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Salary Range: $135,000\-$175,000 or monthly contract equivalent. This position is based in New York, NY, and requires candidates to reside in or be willing to relocate to the area. **Equal Opportunity Employer** At Scope we take pride in our best asset, our people! We focus on ensuring that our culture makes life better for the team! Scope Labs is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. We actively encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters innovation and creativity, and we welcome candidates who share our values of respect, collaboration, and excellence. To perform this job successfully, the employee(s) will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an at will relationship. Compensation Range: $135K \- $175K

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer | Full Stack Developer | Financial Services / Venture Capital
jobs.description: **ABOUT BIP CAPITAL** BIP Capital is an integrated private market investment platform built to create and capture opportunities through BIP Ventures traditional venture anchor funds, an Evergreen equity BDC, and private credit offerings. With a distinctive multi\-stage, multi\-sector investment approach and a growing array of capital offerings, BIP Capital has generated consistent top quartile returns since 2009\. **OUR PHILOSOPHY** We are champions of our investors’ goals and stewards of founders’ dreams, but more than that, we are ethical, honest partners who serve, educate, and protect our founders and investors. We take on the challenges and complex conversations because we operate out of integrity and genuine care. **ABOUT THE ROLE** BIP Capital's technology team is hiring a Junior AI Engineer to help bring large language models into the day to day work of an investment platform. You'll work directly with a Senior AI Engineer to add AI capabilities to our existing full\-stack applications, and to design and ship retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, agentic workflows, and prompt\-engineered LLM pipelines that real investment and operations teams rely on. This is an apprenticeship\-style role built for someone early in their career who is a strong full\-stack engineer first and genuinely curious about applied AI. You will not be expected to own architecture on day one. You will be expected to execute well, learn quickly, and take real work off the Senior AI Engineer's plate within your first few months **Office Environment:** Hybrid / On\-site (In\-office Wednesdays). **What you'll do** * Add AI capabilities to our existing full\-stack applications: new LLM\-powered features, workflows, and interfaces built directly into the products our investment and operations teams already use. * Build and improve RAG systems with a Senior AI Engineer, from chunking and embedding strategies through retrieval quality and evaluation. * Manage context windows and model inputs: decide what information a model actually needs, how to structure it, and when a task calls for a different model or a multi\-modal approach across text, documents, and images. * Help design agentic workflows when the problem calls for it, including multi\-step LLM pipelines, tool use, and orchestration. * Prompt\-engineer and evaluate LLM workflows, treating prompts and retrieval as things you measure rather than guess at. * Write clean, testable services and data pipelines that move information reliably between systems. * Translate fuzzy workflow needs from investment and operations colleagues into concrete technical problems. **Requirements** **What we're looking for** We weigh engineering fundamentals and trajectory far more heavily than years of experience or a specific pedigree. This is a product engineering role: we want a full\-stack engineer who is genuinely excited about building with large language models, someone who thinks naturally in terms of retrieval, embeddings, context windows, and tool use, and who wants to ship features real people use day to day. * Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field. * Solid software engineering fundamentals in Node.js and TypeScript: REST APIs, async and promise\-based concurrency, a testing framework such as Jest or Vitest, and everyday comfort in git. Our front end runs on AWS Amplify, so familiarity there is a plus. Python is a nice to have, especially for RAG and data\-heavy work, but it is not our primary stack. * Exposure to cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS, including AWS's AI and LLM services such as Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, and Knowledge Bases for Bedrock. * Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar): function calling and tool use, structured outputs, streaming responses, and managing token usage and context window limits. * Hands\-on experience building something real with LLMs, ideally something you can point to: a project, prototype, or shipped feature you can walk us through, including what broke and how you fixed it. * Comfort designing LLM\-in\-the\-loop evaluation and testing pipelines: building golden datasets, using LLM\-as\-judge scoring, and writing regression tests for prompts and retrieval, with tools such as promptfoo, Braintrust, or Ragas. * Comfort with AI native development practices: using tools like Claude Code or Cursor as part of your everyday workflow, not as a novelty. * An instinct to measure. When you change a prompt, a retrieval step, or a model, your first question is “how do I know this made it better,” whether the answer is an eval score, a latency number, or a cost\-per\-call tradeoff. * Coachability and initiative: you can take a loosely specified task and make visible progress without needing every detail spelled out. * Clear communication. Our users are non\-technical investment and operations professionals. * Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor employment visas for this position, including candidates who would require sponsorship following F\-1 OPT/CPT. **Bonus points** * Working familiarity with RAG mechanics: chunking and embedding strategies, vector stores such as pgvector, Pinecone, or Weaviate, embedding model choice, hybrid search, and reranking. * Familiarity with an agent or RAG framework (LangChain.js, LlamaIndex, AWS Strands, or a current agent SDK), though we care more that you can learn one quickly than that you know today's flavor. * Experience shipping AI features inside a production full\-stack application, not just a standalone prototype. * Awareness of data sensitivity: why investor, deal, and LP information cannot flow into arbitrary public models. * Exposure to the Model Context Protocol (MCP), whether that's building MCP servers and tools or connecting agents to them. **Success metrics** * By 90 days: you're taking sprint tasks directly, running on a weekly 1:1 cadence with your Senior AI Engineer, and have shipped a medium\-significance contribution to an active RAG or agentic workflow project. * By one year: you own an increasing share of the day\-to\-day work on at least one RAG or agentic workflow component, with your Senior AI Engineer retaining design and review oversight, and you're a regular, hands\-on contributor to the eval and testing pipeline for the workflows you support. **How we work** You'll sit on a small, embedded technology team and apprentice closely to one Senior AI Engineer. We value people who ask good questions, ship working software, and can explain a complex idea simply. What you build gets used inside the firm, often within days **Benefits** **WHY JOIN US** * **Impact**: Build AI systems and autonomous workflows that directly influence investment decisions, portfolio growth, and firm efficiency. * **Innovation**: Be on the leading edge of applying AI/LLMs to venture capital workflows. * **Collaboration**: Work with a lean, entrepreneurial team of investors, technologists, and operators. * **Growth**: Opportunity to expand into broader AI/ML roles as the firm scales its technology platform. **WHY JOIN BIP CAPITAL** * **Top\-quartile Performance**: We are a leading venture capital firm in a vibrant tech ecosystem offering national prominence. * **Internal Growth**: We foster critical thinking and promote internal advancement from day one. * **Unique Value Proposition**: Our firm boasts a robust, defensible value proposition supported by a high\-net\-worth investor base. * **Merit\-based Environment**: We encourage you to bet on yourself, leveraging your merit to excel and thrive. * **Benefits**: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive salaries, health and wellness plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and various employee well\-being programs. *BIP Capital is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics. BIP Capital is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status*.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Who we are** Hynes \& Khater is an aviation technology and consulting firm built on a simple belief: the best solutions come from people who have actually lived the problems they're solving. We work inside complex, high\-stakes environments — airlines, travel technology, enterprise platforms — where the margin for error is low and the pace doesn't stop for anyone. Our team spans consulting, software development, and platform products, and we operate as true partners to the clients we serve, not vendors managing a statement of work. We're not a big firm. We don't want to be. What we want is a team of people who are sharp, honest, curious, and genuinely invested in the outcome — people who make everyone around them better just by being in the room. **What this role is actually about** We're hiring a Software Developer to build and extend the applications our clients run their operations on. That means designing web, mobile, and service\-oriented solutions on top of APIs and web services — and owning the work end to end, from figuring out what the system actually needs to do through analysis, design, code, testing, and the documentation that lets someone else pick it up later. This is not a ticket\-taking role. You'll help define technical direction and choose the patterns we use on a project, which means the decisions you make will still be visible in the codebase years from now. You also won't start from zero — our templates, pipelines, and patterns are productized and versioned, so the work begins at about 70% and your judgment goes into the part that's actually specific to the client. You'll work across various phases of development and maintenance on approved projects, and you'll be trusted to move a piece of work forward without someone standing over it. The environment is real and the stakes are real. The systems you touch support airline operations, so correctness matters more than cleverness and a clear explanation matters as much as working code. You'll partner with support and business analysts to get technical and user documentation right, and you'll be expected to keep learning the client landscape well enough to suggest better solutions than the ones you were handed. You'll work inside one of our development PODs on a named client engagement, reporting to our Development capability lead. **What you will do** * Design and implement web, mobile, and service\-oriented solutions built on APIs and web services — loosely coupled, instrumented, and able to deploy independently * Participate in defining and implementing technical direction, and select the technical patterns used on your projects * Perform and review system analysis, design, programming, testing, debugging, and documentation * Work with support and business analysts to provide the technical documentation, user training, and manuals that go with every enhancement * Lead or contribute to process improvement — the goal is a better way of working, not just a shipped change * Keep building your understanding of the client landscape so you can suggest and implement solutions that hold up over time * Manage your own phases of development and maintenance on approved projects, and communicate honestly about where they stand **The kind of person who does well here** Technical skills matter and we'll get to those. But the people who thrive at H\&K share some things that don't show up on a resume. **They're honest before they're impressive.** When they don't know something, they say so and go find out. When something went wrong on their watch, they own it and explain what they learned. They're not trying to manage perception — they're trying to solve the problem. **They're curious about the parts they don't know yet.** This environment spans application development, integration, cloud platforms, distributed systems, and airline operations all at once. Nobody walks in knowing all of it. The people who grow fastest here are the ones who find that interesting rather than overwhelming. **They're comfortable moving before the picture is complete.** We build solutions that work now and evolve over time. That means making good decisions with incomplete information, adjusting course without losing momentum, and being energized by change rather than threatened by it. **They make the people around them better.** This is a team sport. We're looking for someone whose instinct when they figure something out is to share it — in a code review, in a design conversation, or in the documentation nobody else wanted to write. **They care about the work, not just the output.** There's a difference between closing a story and actually solving the problem behind it. We want someone who knows the difference and consistently chooses the harder, more honest path. **Required qualifications** Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related field with an emphasis in systems analysis, plus 3\+ years designing software solutions — OR 5\+ years of equivalent experience combining education, training, and hands\-on work. Proficiency in systems analysis and/or programming, including leadership responsibilities on the work you own. Experience with structured programming techniques and with transactional and message\-based patterns in an agile\-driven development project. Strong written and verbal communication skills — enough to develop, coordinate, and execute requirements, project plans, and test approaches with both technical and business audiences. **Technical experience (significant experience required):** * .NET, C\#, Java * REST / SOAP * Oracle, SQL **Preferred qualifications** Experience in an airline information systems environment, systems integration work, or airline development generally is a real advantage — but we'd rather hire someone curious about the domain than someone who has simply been near it. **Working knowledge or a solid understanding of any of the following:** * Cloud — Azure, AWS * TIBCO BusinessWorks * TIBCO BusinessEvents * Single Page Applications — Blazor, Angular, JavaScript * Domain modeling, Swagger / OpenAPI * Cache patterns and technology — Redis, ActiveSpaces * Azure DevOps **Location** This role is based in Houston and works on a hybrid schedule. You'll be onsite near the Galleria at least two days a week, with additional onsite days as the work requires — including a monthly team meeting that typically brings the full team together for a third day. We're not counting days for the sake of it, but presence matters here and we're transparent about that upfront.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: Government technology has failed citizens, public servants, and service members for decades. Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses for counter\-drone procurement to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks and months, not years. This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies. Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital. We built an internal tool called Bidbuddy. Before it existed, someone on our team spent eight hours a week scraping procurement sites, pulling RFPs by hand, and reading them to figure out which ones were worth chasing. Now one system does the scraping and the first pass of analysis. Those eight hours went back to the people doing the actual work of winning. That's one tool. We need many more, and most of them don't exist yet. Kaizen is about 40 people supporting software that reaches 40 million residents across 50\+ agencies in 17 states, and the only way that math holds is if the company runs on tools instead of hours. This role owns that. You'll go department by department, find where the time goes, and build the thing that takes it back. Sometimes that's an internal app. Sometimes it's an automation nobody notices. Sometimes it's teaching a team to use AI properly, which is often the highest leverage thing available. Then you roll it out and stay on it until people actually use it. We already have the list, and it's long. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own internal tools end to end, from the hallway conversation that surfaces the problem through architecture, build, rollout, and the week two fixes. * Build AI powered internal systems in the mold of Bidbuddy: document parsing and analysis, agentic workflows, automated research and routing, and tooling that turns hours of manual work into minutes. * Work directly with leads across Proposals, Customer Ops, Sales, Design, and Engineering to find where the time is going, and translate half\-formed asks into something worth building. * Drive AI enablement across the company. Every person at Kaizen should know how to get the most out of these tools. * Support the external analytics layer inside Kaizen's platform, so customers have clear, actionable data at their fingertips * Back up the deployment team during an implementation **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 2 to 5 years of engineering, data, or applied AI experience, or work that makes the years irrelevant. Slope matters more than seniority * Something you built end to end that a team still uses today: an internal application, an automation, a tool that changed how people work. Not a prototype, not a demo * Genuine fluency with AI tools. You've shipped with them, not just explored them, and you can name where they failed you and how you caught it * Strong SQL and enough data modeling to work in an existing warehouse and ship a model when the job calls for it * The ability to take a vague problem from a non\-technical stakeholder and come back with the right scope, not the requested one * Low ego, high output. You do the unglamorous rollout work because that's what makes the build matter **Strong Candidates May Also...** --------------------------------- * Have built internal tooling at a company where the hard part was getting hundreds of people to change how they work * Come out of forward deployed or solutions engineering at an AI or developer tools company, where the job was making software work inside someone else's mess * Know N8N, Zapier, or similar deeply enough to have a view on when not to reach for them * Have built in government, healthcare, or another environment where getting it wrong has consequences **What Kaizen Offers** ---------------------- **Health \& Insurance** * 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents. * $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA. * One Medical membership, on us — same\-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city. * Fertility and family\-building support through Carrot. * 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match. **Family \& Time Off** * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non\-birthing parents. * Unlimited PTO, with a two\-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!) * Closed for all federal holidays. * Company\-wide winter break the week of Christmas. * Company offsites throughout the year. **Office \& Remote Setup** * Up to $750 one\-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC\-based employees. $500 for remote employees. * $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution). * Expensed lunch while in the office. * Company\-provided laptop of your choice. **Wellness** * Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us. For remote employees, $100/month dedicated to gym or physical fitness reimbursement. **Stipends** * $100/month utility stipend. * $500/year professional development. * $250/year recreation. * $300/quarter pet care stipend. Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Edge & Field Systems
jobs.description: **About the team:** Mind Robotics is building robots that learn from real\-world experience — and the quality of that experience starts with how we collect and process data. Our field data collection system puts capture rigs on the factory floor at manufacturing sites, generating the raw sensor data that trains everything downstream. Our teleoperations program turns human demonstrations into high\-quality data that grounds our AI models in physical reality. Both flow through annotation and quality control into our training platform. **About the role:** As an Software Engineer on Edge \& Field Systems, you'll be one of the founding engineers on the team that owns our application layer, reporting to our Integration Manager. The systems work today; your job is to help harden and productionize them for scale — from 10 capture stations at one site to hundreds across multiple OEM plants, and from a handful of teleop stations to a multi\-shift fleet. This is early, hands\-on, 0\-to\-1 engineering: you'll ship code that runs on real hardware in real factories, and see its effect on robot behavior. **You will:** * Build the field capture stack — edge software for our data collection rigs: device management, sensor orchestration, and real\-time data quality monitoring that holds up on a factory floor, with workflows optimized for I/O\-, compute\-, and network\-bound constraints * Ship the teleop stack — collection, evaluation, and operator tooling for our teleoperation stations, including metrics, task management, and the workflows our robot operators use every day * Build and contribute to integration and validation testing for field software, including hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test setups that catch failures before they reach a live site * Build monitoring and dashboards that give visibility into fleet health, capture quality, and station uptime across sites, accounting for intermittent connectivity and bounded bandwidth in the field * Make deployment repeatable — build tooling and configuration systems that make onboarding a new manufacturing site a config change, not a custom engineering project, including device provisioning workflows * Support the field — debug issues on live systems, instrument for observability, and work directly with site operations staff and robot operators who depend on your software **Requirements:** * 2\+ years of software engineering experience building production systems * Strong programming fundamentals and comfort working across the stack — edge devices, services, and local data pipelines * Experience with at least one of: edge computing, device or fleet management, real\-time systems, robotics or sensor systems * Bias for ownership: you've taken features or systems from prototype to production and supported them in the field * Clear communication and close collaboration with product, research, and operations partners * Hands\-on experience with sensor data (video, depth, IMU, force/torque) and the infrastructure to collect and monitor it in real time is a plus * Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop or simulation\-based testing (e.g., Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo) is a plus * Background in robotics, autonomous vehicles, industrial IoT, or teleoperation systems is a plus * Exposure to manufacturing or other industrial environments is a plus

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: About Us: Exthymic is an early\-stage deep\-tech startup on a mission to prevent millions of cancer deaths by making curative cell therapies widely accessible. Our platform enables the manufacturing of patient\-specific treatments at the point of care. Led by experienced industry pioneers, we blend hardware, software, and biochemical engineering to disrupt the status quo and democratize life\-saving therapies. Join us to solve complex challenges and drive global healthcare innovation. About You You have a strong quantitative background and like working across disciplines. You are comfortable navigating both the rigor of a structured development process and the ambiguity inherent in early\-stage product development. When two teams are solving the same problem with different assumptions, you notice early and get them realigned. **Requirements** * Keep one shared picture of what the system must do. Ensure that requirements are being addressed and defined in development, and track them in a requirements management tool. Translate market and user needs into clear, testable design inputs across biology, hardware, and software. * Define and maintain the interfaces between mechanical, electrical, fluidic, software, and cell biology subsystems so teams can build in parallel without surprising each other. Maintain the interface control documents and system block diagrams that record those agreements, and raise integration risks while they are still cheap to fix. * Support verification and validation planning at the subsystem and system level, and maintain the system risk analyses that drive it. Make sure risk mitigations land in the requirements and get verified, and work with quality and regulatory to keep DHF artifacts current as designs settle. * Help with prototype assembly and testing. Work alongside the engineering and biology teams on builds and test runs, and feed what you learn back into the requirements and interfaces. * Contribute to program planning and milestone tracking with the functional leads, and flag schedule and technical risks early. Qualifications * Bachelor's or Master's degree in an engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent industry experience. * Typically 5\+ years at the intersection of biology, chemistry, and instrumentation. * Systems engineering experience building and maintaining a requirements set in a requirements management tool (e.g., DOORS, Jama, Flow Engineering), ideally through the transition from research to product development. * Experience keeping multiple engineering teams aligned: running design reviews, resolving requirement conflicts, and settling interface disagreements. * Experience working within a QMS, including design history files and supporting design artifacts. * Hands\-on laboratory experience and comfort collaborating with bench scientists. jobs.title: Systems Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Systems Engineer II **Job Type:** 6\-month contract to direct hire **Location:** Dallas, Tx \- Hybrid **Summary of Functions:** The Systems Engineer II is an entry\-level technical professional responsible for supporting the administration, maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting of enterprise server, operating system, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure platforms. This position assists with the implementation, configuration, and support of technology solutions that ensure reliable, secure, and efficient operation of enterprise systems. The Systems Engineer I works under the guidance of senior engineers while developing technical expertise, supporting operational activities, maintaining documentation, and participating in infrastructure improvement initiatives. **Duties and Responsibilities:** **Execution Excellence** * Provides day\-to\-day operational support for enterprise systems infrastructure by monitoring system health, performing routine administration tasks, supporting server operating systems, virtualization platforms, storage systems, backup solutions, and infrastructure services. Assists with incident resolution, system maintenance, software deployments, patching activities, access management, and troubleshooting technical issues while following established procedures and documenting resolutions. **Planning and Solutioning** * Assists with the planning, testing, implementation, and support of infrastructure solutions that meet business and technical requirements. Participates in system upgrades, technology refresh initiatives, application platform support activities, disaster recovery efforts, and infrastructure projects while gaining experience with enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, automation practices, and emerging infrastructure solutions. **Quality and Continuous Improvement** * Maintains accurate technical documentation, system inventories, operational procedures, and configuration records while following established standards, security requirements, and industry best practices. Identifies opportunities to improve system reliability, performance, and operational efficiency; participates in root cause analysis; supports automation and process improvement initiatives; and contributes to maintaining a stable and secure computing environment. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Collaborates with Infrastructure, Network, Security, Cloud, Application, Database, Service Desk, and business teams to resolve technical issues and support technology initiatives. Works with vendors and service providers as needed, communicates system changes and operational impacts, participates in project activities, and provides responsive technical support while maintaining effective working relationships across the organization. **Minimum Qualifications:** Education, Experience and Training: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related field; **or** an Associate degree with two (2\) years of relevant systems administration or infrastructure support experience; **or** an equivalent combination of education, technical training, certifications, and related experience. One (1\) to three (3\) years of experience supporting enterprise systems, servers, virtualization platforms, cloud environments, or related infrastructure technologies is preferred. Special Requirements/Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities: Knowledge of enterprise systems administration concepts; Windows and Linux operating systems; server hardware and virtualization technologies; storage concepts; backup and recovery operations; cloud computing fundamentals; infrastructure monitoring tools; scripting and automation concepts; information security principles as they relate to systems environments; disaster recovery practices; IT service management processes; change management procedures; and the interaction between systems infrastructure and other technology disciplines. Ability to install, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain enterprise systems; analyze technical issues and implement effective solutions; perform routine system administration tasks; document technical procedures and configurations; learn new technologies; communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical audiences; prioritize multiple assignments; work independently and collaboratively; maintain effective working relationships; and apply strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. Preferred certifications include Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, CompTIA Server\+, CompTIA Linux\+, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or equivalent systems administration certifications. **Physical/Environmental Requirements:** ---------------------------------------- Work is primarily performed in an office and data center environment and requires the ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, reach, and occasionally lift equipment weighing up to 40 pounds. The position may require work in server rooms and data centers, participation in after\-hours maintenance activities, on\-call support rotations, disaster recovery exercises, and occasional travel between organizational facilities.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work. From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job. * You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role. * You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum. * You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations. * You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew. * You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. * You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team. **Bonus** --------- * AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background. * You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers. * Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship. * Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: VP Technology & Data
jobs.description: **About Us** Atlas is built for oncologists by oncologists. We provide practices with the staff, contracts, and toolkit they need to deliver truly whole person care to their cancer patients. Our value\-based approach to care delivery aligns incentives, offering patients better outcomes, payors guaranteed reduction in medical expense, and provider partners greater financial independence. **Role Overview** At Atlas, we believe every patient deserves personalized support navigating a complex cancer care system. The VP of Technology and Data will architect and manage the platform that makes that possible. This role suits someone who thrives in ambiguity and builds structure in a fast\-moving, start\-up context. In this role, you will partner closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to understand user needs, develop a technology and data roadmap, and execute alongside Atlas and partner oncology practice teams. In the immediate term, you will also act as an independent contributor / builder to support execution of the data and product strategy. In addition to leading “data and insights as a product,” you will also be charged with recruiting and managing a team that supports daily technology operations and information security. Across these priorities, your mandate will be to accelerate adoption of AI tools by both the corporate and clinic\-based teams. **Key Responsibilities** ***Technology and Data Strategy*** * Build a short and long\-term technology and data roadmap and use Atlas' core competencies to drive build\-versus\-buy decisions. * Architect the data warehouse and reporting infrastructure supporting corporate outcome measures and continuous improvement. * Design and maintain the data feeds required for an intelligent value\-based care operation, in close partnership with Atlas' interoperability and data warehouse vendors. * Ensure that Atlas is leveraging modern AI tools to power its tech and data infrastructure. ***Daily Technology Operations*** * Code and deploy data pipelines (ETL/ELT) directly, and serve as interim DBA as you build the team. * Lead the team spanning IT and information security, data engineering, help desk, and EMR specialists. * Set direction and accountability for day\-to\-day technology issues — outages, vendor escalations, security threats, SLA breaches — with the Director of IT and Information Security owning execution. ***Partner\-Facing*** * Champion the technology vision internally, to the board, and to current and prospective partners. * Serve as the face of Atlas technology with practice partners from diligence through implementation and run\-rate operations. * Support implementation for new payer and provider clients. **Reporting:** This role will report to the President **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience * 5\-10 years of experience in healthcare IT, Data, and/or Product leadership * Basic competency as both a data engineer and data warehouse administrator with a history of prior healthcare deployments * Fluency with modern AI solutions * Experience with product strategy, build versus buy, and user needs research * Prior expertise managing and contracting key technology vendors * Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail * Proficient in performing data analyses in Excel, summarizing executive\-friendly output in PowerPoint, including performance dashboards * Ability to think critically, problem\-solve, and translate ideas into action * Self\-starter who can manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a high growth startup * Experience in outpatient value\-based care primary care * Experience working with Claude CODE CLI / IDE Extension via Claude API Some of the benefits of our comprehensive benefits package includes: * Health, Dental, Vision insurance * Competitive pay * Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave You will collaborate with like\-minded health care professionals who, like you, understand the importance and value of Atlas’ high\-quality, value\-based care model. *Atlas is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We take affirmative action to ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally\-protected characteristics.* *Atlas is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants with physical or mental disabilities. Applicants with a disability who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should email careers@atlasoncologypartners.com for assistance. Reasonable accommodation will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $225K

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: We are a West Michigan manufacturer building custom internal tools, including an in\-house ERP and client ordering portals. We need an on\-site Software Developer with a strong back\-end orientation to support, maintain, and expand our custom web application suite. This role focuses on back\-end logic, database integrations, and operational workflows, with occasional front\-end UI tweaks. You will work directly in our production codebase to solve real manufacturing and operational challenges. **What You’ll Do** * **Back\-End Development:** Build core business logic, data models, and API integrations for our ERP and ordering platforms. * **System Maintenance:** Navigate, optimize, and refactor existing code to resolve issues and build new features. * **Full\-Stack Tweaks:** Handle basic front\-end updates (HTML/CSS/JS) to keep internal interfaces clean and functional. * **Data Integrity:** Ensure query performance and reliable system communication across manufacturing workflows. **What We’re Looking For** * 1–3 years of professional web development experience centered on back\-end logic and databases. * **Open Stack Approach:** We use Laravel and Vue, but syntax is secondary to strong core engineering principles. Experience in any modern stack (.NET, Java, Python, Node, Ruby, PHP) translates well. * **Database \& API Skills:** Experience writing efficient relational database queries (MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and integrating APIs. * **Pragmatic Mindset:** Comfortable maintaining and improving an existing production codebase rather than building from scratch. * **On\-Site Presence:** Must be available to work on\-site at our West Michigan facility. **Why You’ll Love Working Here** We are a growing West Michigan team built on a culture of mutual respect and authentic support for one another. When you join us, you are not just a cog in a massive corporate machine; you are an essential part of our everyday success. Being a mid\-sized business means you get to work closely with every part of the company, from engineering and operations to the shop floor. You will actually see your code in action, watch how your work directly solves daily operational challenges, and feel the immediate impact of what you build. We value practical problem\-solving, open collaboration, and an environment where asking questions and helping a teammate is just how we do business. If you want to grow your career alongside a supportive team that values your contributions, you will fit right in. Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) 3% Match * AD\&D insurance * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr IT Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Powering the world’s payments ecosystem** ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. As a **Sr. Security Engineer** in **Norcross, GA,** you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem! **Job Purpose** The Sr. Security Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, hardening, and supporting enterprise security capabilities that protect company systems, platforms, and information assets. This role blends hands\-on security engineering with operational execution across cloud security, security operations, incident support, and AI security use cases. The position partners with engineering, cloud platform, application, data/AI, and operations teams to reduce risk, improve detection and response outcomes, and support audit and control expectations. As a senior\-level role, this position also contributes technical leadership through documentation, standardization, mentoring, and continuous improvement. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and continuously improve secure configurations and guardrails across enterprise and cloud environments, including identity and access controls, network protections, encryption, secrets management, logging, and platform hardening. * Engineer, administer, and support enterprise security technologies spanning endpoint security, vulnerability management, SIEM/logging, identity management, monitoring, detection, and cryptographic controls. * Drive remediation of security findings by prioritizing critical and high\-risk issues, validating corrective actions, and improving repeatable control patterns. * Build, operate, and enhance security operations capabilities, including detection engineering, SIEM/SOAR workflows, alert triage, investigation support, incident response playbooks, and operational runbooks. * Conduct or support incident investigations, root\-cause analysis, containment and eradication activities, and lessons\-learned follow\-through. * Participate in the on\-call support rotation for security incidents, provide technical support during active investigations and response activities, and contribute to post\-incident remediation and continuous improvement. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, engineering standards, implementation procedures, and evidence\-quality artifacts to support operational consistency and audit readiness. * Partner with engineering, cloud, application, and AI/ML stakeholders to implement scalable security controls and secure\-by\-default patterns. * Perform technical assessments and proof\-of\-concept evaluations of new security solutions and recommend changes to procedures, standards, or tooling where appropriate. * Implement practical security controls for AI\-enabled systems and workflows, including governance, access controls, monitoring, and risk reduction for model and application use cases. * Participate in audits, control reviews, and security assessments; support evidence collection, traceability, and remediation tracking. * Mentor less experienced engineers and contribute to technical leadership across the team. Perform other duties as assigned and understand and adhere to all corporate policies, including the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics. * **Qualifications (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, MIS, or related field; You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership, Platform, SRE, Security, and Data Platform to eliminate operational bottlenecks and keep our broker\-dealer and clearing systems reliable. This is a hands\-on leadership role: you will set the roadmap, run 1:1s, and make hiring decisions, and you will also review Terraform, sit in incident reviews, and make the architectural calls that shape our AWS footprint for the next three years. ***This role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week onsite in our San Francisco FiDi or Culver City office.*** **Your impact** * Lead, coach, and grow a team of cloud, DevOps, and database reliability engineers across local and offshore locations — 1:1s, growth paths, performance, and hiring. * Own delivery of the Cloud Engineering roadmap: governed EKS platform in Broker\-Dealer and Clearing, pilot\-light disaster recovery (RTO 60 min / RPO 15 min), Postgres upgrades, and edge gateway consolidation. * Drive software supply chain security and SDLC hygiene — SBOMs, signed provenance, hardened golden images, and policy\-as\-code admission control — in partnership with Security Engineering. * Own the Cloud on\-call rotation and incident response process: SLAs, runbooks, blameless post\-mortems, and follow\-through on action items. * Improve developer experience through ephemeral environments, faster pipelines, and self\-service infrastructure — measured in DORA metrics, not opinions. * Manage cloud and observability spend with a cost\-per\-service view, making trade\-offs explicit to Finance and to engineering leadership. * Represent Cloud Engineering in audits and regulatory reviews with evidence that is automated rather than assembled by hand. * Mentor and guide engineers on secure infrastructure practices so systems are both performant and resilient against security vulnerabilities. **What you'll bring** * **Experience** — 6\+ years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, including 2\+ years managing engineers at a B2B financial services, fintech, or SaaS organization + Deep AWS expertise across networking, IAM, compute, storage, and cost management at production scale + Strong Kubernetes (EKS) and Infrastructure as Code experience — Terraform, Helm, and GitOps delivery with ArgoCD + Practiced CI/CD ownership: GitLab pipelines, artifact and secrets management (Vault), and release safety * **Operational credibility** — you have run a production on\-call rotation and can act as a senior escalation point, not just route the page to someone else * Observability fluency with Open Telemetry, SLOs, and error budgets used to make real decisions * **People leadership** — a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining engineers, including remote and offshore team members * **Education** — Ideally looking for a B.A. / B.S. degree in relevant fields such as Computer Science or Software Engineering, but experience and understanding are just as important * **Technical aptitude** — You're technologically savvy and can easily get up to speed on modern tech stacks (i.e. Kubernetes, Kafka, Temporal, Postgres, and Snowflake) * **Ownership** — The pride you put into every aspect of your work is unparalleled and undeniable * **Superb communication** — Intentional dialogue is a superpower. You listen as well as you share your perspective with others. * **Resilience** — We're inspired by your unwavering determination to achieve success, no matter the adversity you face along the way. * **Assurance** — Your confidence is brilliant, yet ego\-less. You possess a strong knowledge base, the ability to discover the unknown, and are open to differing perspectives. * **Creative problem solving** — Identifying the problem is simply not enough. You're instinctually creative with your approach in finding solutions to roadblocks. **Bonus points if you bring** * Expertise with AI (Claude) best practices, and experience rolling AI\-assisted workflows out to an engineering team * Experience operating in a regulated environment — SOC 1 / SOC 2, FINRA or SEC examinations, and evidence automation * Hands\-on experience with Kong, Envoy, or Gateway API at the edge * Postgres operations depth: upgrades, replication, change data capture, and performance tuning * Familiarity with Teleport, Vault, Karpenter, and policy engines such as OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno * Experience running tabletop exercises and disaster recovery GameDays * Knowledge of brokerage platforms and the financial services industry **What we bring** Attracting and retaining top\-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we've built and are cognizant of the ever\-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best. * Stunning, amenity\-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity. * Competitive total compensation. * Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO). * 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting. * 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment. * Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L\&D budget allocation for each employee. * Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.). * Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home\-purchasing preparedness, etc.). * One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries). *Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure* *fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.* *Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

Our mission is to make financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to everyone. We’re hiring our first dedicated Senior Network Engineer. We run a regulated broker\-dealer and clearing platform on a multi\-account, multi\-region AWS estate, connected to clearing, custody, market\-data, and banking partners over dedicated circuits and encrypted tunnels. You will own how those networks are designed, segmented, secured, and operated — from cloud routing topology and partner connectivity to how our own people reach internal systems — working in close partnership with our Security team, whose requirements shape much of this roadmap, and bringing an AI\-native approach to the work. Zscaler, Netskope, or Prisma is a strong plus. + Terraform and infrastructure as code as your default, plus scripting ability (Python, Bash, or Go) and comfort with cloud APIs. + Working knowledge of Kubernetes networking — CNI behavior, ingress, service exposure, and where east\-west traffic actually goes. * **An AI\-native approach** — a requirement, not a nice\-to\-have. You already use AI tooling to write and review code, analyze configuration and logs at scale, and reason about large estates, and you verify its output before it touches production. * **A security partnership mindset** — you treat security requirements as design input, not obstacle, and can hold a technical disagreement with a security engineer and land somewhere better than where either of you started. * **Judgment and ownership** — you have worked somewhere a change window is real, you document accepted risk rather than quietly leaving it undocumented, and you can hold your own with a partner’s network team on a bridge call. * **Education** — ideally a B.A. / B.S. in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related field, but experience and understanding matter just as much. **Bonus points if you bring** * Financial services, brokerage, or another regulated industry — including connectivity to clearing, custody, banking, or market\-data counterparties. * Network integration through an acquisition or enterprise merger — address\-space reconciliation and meeting a larger partner’s standards. * Expertise with AI (Claude) best practices, including agentic workflows applied to infrastructure operations. * Service mesh or API gateway operations; edge and CDN security (WAF, bot management); campus and branch networking. * Certifications such as AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, CCNP/CCIE, or JNCIP. San Francisco, CA salary range $200,000 \- $240,000 USD **What we bring** Attracting and retaining top\-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever\-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best. * Stunning, amenity\-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity. * Competitive total compensation. * Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO). * 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting. * 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment. * Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L\&D budget allocation for each employee. * Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.). * Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home\-purchasing preparedness, etc.). * One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries). *Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure* *fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.* *Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Altruist we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

jobs.title: Lead Quality Assurance
jobs.description: **This position requires office presence of a minimum of 5 days per week and is only located in the location(s) posted. No relocation is offered.** Join AT\&T and reimagine the communications and technologies that connect the world. Our Consumer Technology experience team is delivering innovative and reliable technology solutions to power differentiated, simplified customer experiences. Bring your bold ideas and fearless risk\-taking to redefine connectivity and transform how the world shares stories and experiences that matter. Recognized as a technical expert who independently resolves highly complex challenges and leads strategic quality engineering initiatives. Provides leadership across large\-scale testing programs, influences technology direction, mentors team members, and partners with senior leadership to drive quality, performance, and AI system reliability across the organization. **What You'll Do** * Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies for enterprise applications, AI\-powered solutions, APIs, and system integrations. * Create and maintain manual and automated test cases to validate functionality, reliability, performance, scalability, and security. * Validate AI and machine learning solutions, including accuracy, model behavior, data quality, prompt performance, and responsible AI requirements. * Perform performance, load, stress, and security testing to ensure applications meet business, compliance, and operational standards. * Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution, ensuring thorough retesting and validation. * Partner closely with software engineers, AI engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to review requirements and ensure testable, high\-quality solutions. * Build and enhance automated testing frameworks that support continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) environments. * Develop testing approaches for AI agents, generative AI applications, large language model (LLM) integrations, and intelligent automation solutions. * Analyze test results, identify quality risks, and provide actionable recommendations to improve application performance and user experience. * Drive quality engineering best practices, continuous improvement initiatives, and testing standards across multiple projects and teams. * Lead complex testing efforts for large\-scale applications and provide technical guidance to less experienced team members. * Collaborate with vendors and cross\-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of high\-quality technology solutions. **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. * 5\+ years of experience in software quality engineering, testing, or quality assurance. * Experience designing and executing manual and automated testing across web, cloud, mobile, and enterprise applications. * Strong knowledge of test automation frameworks, APIs, microservices, and cloud\-based architectures. * Experience with performance, security, and regression testing methodologies. * Understanding of AI engineering concepts including LLMs, AI agents, RAG, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI system validation. * Proficiency in Python, Java, JavaScript, or similar programming languages, with experience supporting Agile and CI/CD environments. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience testing AI\-powered applications, conversational AI platforms, or agentic AI solutions. * Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Experience with AI model evaluation frameworks, test automation for AI systems, and MLOps practices. * Relevant software testing, cloud, security, or AI certifications. ATG strives to build strong relationships within the professional design community by offering complete software and hardware solutions, supported by a team of experienced technical specialists. With their deep industry knowledge, ATG delivers tailored services that meet the unique needs of AEC professionals, ensuring seamless integration and support across their technology platforms. **LOCATION:** Offices in North Little Rock, AR, and Phoenix, AZ. Open to remote in AR, LA, TX, OK, MO, TN, GA, and FL. We are looking for an experienced developer and creative problem solver to join our team and help us build impactful solutions for our clients. You’ll join a supportive team in a role with growth potential. If you love building scalable web apps and APIs in Python Django, we’ve been waiting to meet you! As a Senior level developer, you will build quality and resilient solutions for projects ranging from mobile applications to web\-based SaaS applications to enterprise process automation and integration projects. You will work closely with the Product Owner to design APIs, data models and all back\-end components to fit the project needs.
