Consumption Views * Supports reporting, analytics, and application users by designing and creating secure, performant consumption views and curated data products in Microsoft Fabric Lakehouses and Warehouses. * Creates logical relationships across source systems, Lakehouses, Warehouses, and enterprise data models to provide consistent, trusted data for reporting and analytics. * Develops and maintains SQL views, semantic\-model\-ready datasets, and reusable data structures using SQL and Microsoft Fabric tools. * Partners with reporting, analytics, and business teams to define common calculations, data definitions, and access requirements. Database Administration * Supports overall strategy related to database and data warehouse development. * Actively participates with the Business Technology department in preparing and implementing backup and disaster recovery procedures and processes for mission critical databases. * Contributes to data dictionaries and database diagrams for complex in\-house databases. * Provides on\-call support for problem resolution of database related issues. **The skills and experience we prefer you have:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, MIS or related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job. * Minimum of 5 years of experience with various MS SQL environments (2008, 2012, 2014, 2017\), designing and implementing SSIS packages and ETL development using SQL Server Data Tools. * SQL Server and/or other Microsoft technologies preferred. * Advanced knowledge of SQL, including T\-SQL, data modeling, normalization, data types, query tuning, indexing, constraints, query plans, and relational database concepts. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, notebooks, and related data engineering capabilities. * Advanced experience with SSRS, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric reporting, or comparable reporting and analytics tools. * Experience designing data solutions for both operational (OLTP) and analytical/data warehouse environments. * Experience with software deployment, source control, CI/CD pipelines, build automation, and promoting solutions across development, test, and production environments. * Ability to translate complex technical concepts and data issues into clear, non\-technical language. * Advanced client\-service skills and a strong customer\-focused mindset. * Strong listening, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams to achieve shared goals and represent business needs. * Valid driver's license. \#IND100 **How we will take care of you:** Our job titles may span more than one career level (associate, senior, principal, etc.). jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, Operational Intelligence & Assurance
jobs.description: Overview: **Being on medication is tough enough.** **We want to make getting it the easy part**. Getting prescriptions to patients has become increasingly complex. When things get messy along the prescription journey, pharmaceutical manufacturers rely on us to untangle the process and create a clear path—allowing patients to build trusting relationships with their medication brands. We’re not only committed to taking the pain out of the prescription process, but we’re also devoted to bringing the brightest minds together under one roof. We bring together diverse voices—engineers, pharmacists, customer service veterans, developers, program strategists and more—all with one vision. Each perspective and experience makes ConnectiveRx better than the sum of its parts. The Operational Intelligence \& Assurance Analyst serves as the organization's operational control tower, responsible for ensuring cases, tasks, and workflows progress through established processes accurately, efficiently, and within defined service level agreements (SLAs). This role combines operational oversight, data analytics, process governance, and AI\-enabled monitoring to provide real\-time visibility into workflow performance and identify cases requiring intervention before customer, compliance, or business impacts occur. The individual will leverage data, automation, and AI\-driven insights to monitor operational health, measure process outcomes, detect bottlenecks, identify at\-risk cases, and drive proactive resolution of workflow exceptions. Acting as a key partner to Operations, Quality, Technology, and Program Management teams, the Operational Intelligence \& Assurance Analyst helps ensure operational consistency, improve process performance, and strengthen accountability across the organization. This role is expected to be both hands\-on in the day\-to\-day operational work and forward\-looking in identifying the systems, dashboards, alerts, and operating rhythms needed to increase visibility into operational health, surface risks earlier, and drive proactive action before issues become escalations. Success in this role is measured by the organization's confidence that work is progressing through the right processes, at the right time, with full visibility into operational risks, service level performance, and opportunities for continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities, process thinking, operational discipline, and AI proficiency to transform operational data into actionable insights that improve efficiency, predictability, and customer outcomes. Responsibilities: * Monitor case movement, queue health, workflow status, and SLA performance across programs. Identify stalled, aging, misrouted, or at\-risk cases and coordinate corrective actions. Maintain a real\-time view of operational health. * Utilize AI tools, predictive analytics, and automated monitoring solutions to identify patterns, detect anomalies, predict SLA misses, and prioritize cases requiring intervention. Build and refine AI\-driven alerts and insights. Develop and maintain operational dashboards, scorecards, and KPIs in collaboration with data analytics team, as needed. Analyze trends, throughput, backlog, cycle times, and process outcomes to provide actionable insights for leadership. * Investigate root causes of recurring issues, identify bottlenecks, and recommend workflow improvements, automation opportunities, and process enhancements that improve efficiency and compliance. * Partner with Operations leadership, Program Management, Technology, Quality, and Leadership teams to review performance, escalate risks, validate corrective actions, and ensure adherence to operational standards and procedures. Qualifications: Education* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Healthcare Administration, Analytics, or a related field. * An equivalent combination of education and directly related experience may be considered. Experience* 4\-6 years of operations, business analysis, process improvement, or workflow management experience. Skills* Ability to utilize AI tools to streamline work activities and establish automation and efficiency in workstreams. * Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar). * Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify operational risks and anomalies. * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge* Proficient understanding of Salesforce.com. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Experience developing reports, dashboards, and operational metrics. * Comprehensive knowledge of patient support program operations, including copay, patient assistance (PAP), adherence, benefits verification, and reimbursement/market\-access workflows. Competencies* Business Acumen: Understands operational drivers and applies them to operational and financial decisions to ensure workflows are being executed. * Technology Savvy: Keeps current on emerging trends with key tools such as Salesforce.com and AI/BI tools. * Communication (Oral \& Written): Listens actively, adapts to different audiences, and articulates messages clearly and respectfully. * Collaboration: Builds trusted partnerships across functions; shares relevant information and aligns stakeholders toward common goals. Travel or Physical Requirements* Position requires minimal travel to office locations, client sites, and conferences. Compliance Requirements* Adhere to all Company Policies, Procedures, and other training consistent with ConnectiveRx's Information Security and Compliance Programs, including but not limited to the following compliances and regulations: SOC1, SOC2, PCI, HIPAA. * Maintain strict compliance with company and client policies regarding business rules and ethics, as well as applicable local, state, and federal laws. Compensation \& Benefits: This position offers opportunities for a bonus (or commissions), with total compensation varying based on factors such as location, relevant skills, experience, and capabilities. Employees at ConnectiveRx can access comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. The company regularly reviews and updates its health, welfare, and fringe benefit policies to ensure competitive offerings. Employees may also participate in the company’s 401(k) plan, with employer contributions where applicable. Time\-Off \& Holidays: ConnectiveRx provides a flexible paid time off (PTO) policy for exempt employees, covering sick days, personal days, and vacations. PTO is determined based on an employee’s first year of service. Employees also receive eight standard company holidays and three floating holidays annually, with prorations applied in the first year. The company remains committed to providing competitive benefits and reserves the right to modify employee offerings, including PTO, STO, and holiday policies, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Posted Salary Range: USD $72,700\.00 \- USD $98,300\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: NOC Team Lead
jobs.description: Job Title: NOC Team Lead **Department:** Network Operations Center (Charlotte, NC) **Reports To:** NOC Supervisor/Manager **Shift:** Third Shift (12am \- 8:30 am EST) Monday \- Friday in office **Job Summary:** The NOC Team Lead (Third Shift) is responsible for overseeing overnight operations of the Network Operations Center. This individual will lead a team of engineers and technicians to ensure optimal network performance, timely incident resolution, and continuous monitoring of all infrastructure and customer\-facing services. The Team Lead will act as the first line of escalation for technical and procedural issues and is expected to ensure proper shift turnover and maintain operational excellence. **Key Responsibilities:** * Provide leadership and technical guidance to overnight NOC staff, including Engineers I/II and Technicians. * Monitor network systems, infrastructure, and alarms to identify and respond to incidents promptly. * Prioritize, assign, work, and track tickets, ensuring adherence to SLAs and escalation procedures. * Serve as the shift escalation point for critical network issues and coordinate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., Engineering, Field Ops, Vendors). * Ensure accurate documentation and shift turnover notes are prepared and communicated effectively. * Assist the NOC Supervisor/Manager in evaluating team performance, identifying training needs, and mentoring junior staff. * Lead shift turnover process, manage escalations, and contribute to root cause analyses and problem management efforts. * Uphold standard operating procedures (SOPs), compliance policies, and change management processes. * Provide feedback on process improvements and participate in post\-incident reviews. **Qualifications:** * Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Networking, or related field preferred. * 3\+ years of experience in a NOC environment, with at least 1 year in a lead or supervisory role. * Strong understanding of telecommunications infrastructure (fiber, transport, IP, voice). * Proficient with NOC tools and monitoring platforms (e.g., SolarWinds, Splunk, Netcool). * Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills; ability to remain calm under high pressure. * Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy, MBS/Elements). * Effective verbal and written communication skills, especially in shift handovers and incident documentation. * Willingness to work the third shift and weekends/holidays as needed. * Willingness to be part of a rotating on\-call. * Must have demonstrated competency in all lower levels of job responsibility. * Troubleshoot network (Data \& Voice) incidents in a timely fashion. * Prioritize network issues by severity and escalating to the appropriate level, as necessary. * Resolve customer incidents via multiple communication outlets. * Must have good customer service and organizational skills. * Maintain status updates to internal and external customers until incidents are resolved. * Perform various steps to verify levels and coordinate with Field Operations. * Ability to learn and retain information in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to multitask efficiently and work independently and as a team while maintaining quality service. * Respond to customer requests and provide timely communication as defined by our department’s policies. * Experience using MS Office Suite and SharePoint. * Knowledge of Telnet, SSH, RDP, and WebHTTPS is required to access devices and utilize web and CLI interfaces. * Must maintain and/or exceed company QA scores. * Possess the ability to take on new, demanding challenges. * Demonstrate the ability to assume new levels of responsibility and deal with them effectively. * Ability to accurately identify circuit types and the solution of how they are delivered. (ie, internet, transport, managed, and voice services) * Conduct RFC and performance testing, adhere to SLA and MTTR policies and standards. * Knowledge and experience with the ability to identify and troubleshoot faults on network\-related devices such as xDSL modems, network interface devices, Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, firewalls, routers, microwave radios, voice (VoIP, SIP, PRI, hosted voice, and analog voice services) daily. * Solid background using VISIO, Network Monitoring Software, and incident management systems. * Basic knowledge of dynamic routing protocols and technologies. * Basic knowledge of layer 2 switching technologies such as Q\-in\-Q, s\-tag, c\-tag, and STP. * Ability to assist field personnel with hardware replacement. * Ability to confirm and/or perform firmware upgrades to network devices. * Knowledge of network switching functions: LNP, CNAM, CALEA, STIR/SHAKEN, etc. * Ability to analyze, summarize, test, and solve issues with VoIP and TDM services, SIP, SS7, and ISDN messaging. * Ability to manage assigned tasks with minimal supervision. * Ability to monitor and analyze alarms via the NMS system and create tickets in the incident management system accordingly in a 24/7 environment. * Assist the NOC Change Management team, as required, in determining customers impacted and the effects during network maintenance and grooming. * Perform any other duties assigned by the NOC supervisor or manager. * Assist in training as needed.

jobs.title: Data & AI Program Manager
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a Data \& AI Program Manager to support a Fortune 100 technology company. This role sits at the intersection of data strategy and applied machine learning, owning the end\-to\-end data lifecycle that fuels natural language processing (NLP) applications and large language model (LLM) development. You'll define what "good data" looks like for a range of NLP use cases, build the guidelines and pipelines to get there, and partner closely with data engineering, data science, and ML teams to turn high\-quality annotated data into measurable model performance gains. This is a full\-time position (W2 or 1099 is fine). You would be employed by Cyborg Mobile but placed with our client working full\-time there and reporting to a manager there. We're looking for someone who is a self\-starter, self\-sufficient, and able to execute with little direction. This is a remote position (Washington candidates preferred). **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Conduct market and user research to understand data needs and expectations across various NLP applications and domains * Define data specifications, scope, and sourcing strategy for each use case and domain * Design judgment guidelines and instructions for data annotation, validation, and quality control * Deliver datasets, schemas, guidelines, and annotations that meet approved specifications, scope, and sourcing requirements * Manage the end\-to\-end data annotation process * Analyze data quality metrics (accuracy, consistency, coverage, and diversity) and turn findings into actionable recommendations * Implement approved data quality improvement actions * Collaborate with client data engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers to integrate annotated data into production pipelines, support LLM fine\-tuning, and evaluate model performance and impact * Identify data gaps and opportunities; propose new data sources, methods, and features to improve data quality and model outcomes * Communicate data vision, strategy, and results to internal and external stakeholders, including product owners, engineers, researchers, customers, and partners * Prepare and deliver data reports, presentations, and demos using client\-approved formats and channels **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Experience in NLP data strategy, annotation program management, or a related data quality/linguistics role * Strong understanding of data annotation workflows, guideline design, and inter\-annotator quality control * Familiarity with LLM training/fine\-tuning pipelines and how annotated data feeds model evaluation * Analytical mindset with the ability to translate quality metrics into concrete improvement plans * Excellent stakeholder communication skills — comfortable presenting to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Experience working in large, matrixed corporate environments **Must Haves** -------------- * Customer centric * Good with follow through * Has skills to build Agents, PowerBI dashboards, Sharepoint list management, coding agents like Codex, Claude Code, Github copilot

jobs.description: **Why DOWL?** DOWL is a top\-ranked, multi\-disciplined consulting firm with over 60 years of experience in civil engineering and related services. Our in\-house expertise spans Civil and Land Development, Construction\-Related Services, Transportation and Structures, and Water and Environmental Services. At DOWL, you’re valued. We support your growth, offer great benefits, and foster a culture of integrity, professionalism, and teamwork. **Transportation Planning and Design** Join our dynamic team of transportation planners and designers dedicated to creating innovative, practical solutions that improve safety, connectivity, and accessibility. Collaborating closely with our traffic engineers, you'll help develop and implement roadway improvements that solve immediate traffic challenges while supporting long\-term community goals. If you're passionate about shaping smarter, safer transportation systems, we’d love you to be a part of our team! *This internship will be for summer 2027!* **Summary** DOWL is looking for an enthusiastic Transportation Intern to provide engineering assistance on a wide variety of engineering projects. The objective of this internship program is to find candidates that are passionate about civil engineering and provide personal, one\-on\-one mentorship to help them gain knowledge and experience with design projects. During the internship, the successful candidate will use various applications and software to analyze, develop, draft, write, and prepare design packages to support the primary engineering discipline assigned such as Transportation \& Structures, Water \& Environmental Services, Civil \& Land Development, and Construction\-Related Services groups. Duties may include performing field work to gather data, providing construction administration support, and inspections services. DOWL is a growing, multidisciplinary consulting firm with offices throughout the western United States from Arizona to Alaska. DOWL’s core values are: Innovation, Inspiration, Integrity and Inclusion, and for over 60 years we’ve been doing just that – solving infrastructure challenges in extraordinary ways. At DOWL, we believe we’re in the business of developing exceptional engineers through execution of exceptional projects. jobs.title: Structural Design Intern
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.** **As a purpose\-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever\-forward mindset.** **Job Summary:** Responsible for supporting the creation of drawings, specifications, and calculations throughout all phases of project design under close supervision. Assist in developing structural designs and analytical models for various building types and materials and perform calculations and analyses using basic knowledge of common codes with guidance from team members. Collaborate with engineers, modelers, and detailers to produce accurate 2D and 3D models using CAD tools, including Tekla Structures, and deliver coordinated, high\-quality design solutions within budget and schedule. Support construction administration activities by reviewing submittals, responding to RFIs, and participating in site visits as directed. **Key Responsibilities:** Assist in the production of drawings, specifications, and calculations, with tasks that are specific and clearly outlined, during a project’s design phase life cycle from conceptual design to completion of construction documents under close supervision and coordination with managers. Depending on depth of experience and knowledge base, assist in the development of structural designs and analytical models for various building types and materials using basic knowledge of common codes, with assistance provided by other team members. Supports construction administration activities, including reviewing shop drawings, responding to RFIs, and conducting site visits. Utilize CAD software and other tools to create 2D drawings and 3D models. Learn the basic use of Tekla Structures software. Collaborate with team members, including engineers, modelers and detailers, to meet project deadlines and deliver high\-quality design solutions within budget. **Education Qualifications:** Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in engineering with a structural focus required. **Work Experience:** No experience required. **Certifications and Licenses:** Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification in progress or intent to pursue preferred. **Anticipated starting pay range:** $29\.00\- $46\.00 ***Nothing is more important than your health and wellness. DPR offers a variety of medical, dental, vision and wellness benefits to keep you healthy. Read more about eligibility and available benefits programs*** ***for*** skilled craft and labor or experienced professionals and recent graduates . DPR Construction is a forward\-thinking, self\-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee\-owned company that has grown into a multi\-billion\-dollar family of companies with offices around the world. Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore unique paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek. Explore our open opportunities at www.dpr.com/careers .

jobs.title: Pipeline Operations Engineer II
jobs.description: At DT Midstream (DTM), we’ve got the energy to achieve great things! DTM owns and operates a diverse, integrated portfolio of midstream pipeline, storage and gathering assets, allowing us to provide a comprehensive set of midstream services to our customers across the Southern, Northeastern and Midwestern United States and into Canada. DTM is an energy industry leader with more than 20 years of proven success, and our focus is to be safe, caring, dependable and efficient in all we do. **Job Summary** The Pipeline Operations Engineer is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of pipeline systems and related facilities. This role provides technical expertise for pipeline operations, system optimization, integrity management, maintenance planning, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives. The engineer collaborates with cross\-functional teams to ensure operational excellence while maintaining the highest standards of safety, environmental stewardship, and asset performance. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Monitor and optimize pipeline system performance to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient transportation of products. * Support daily operations by providing engineering guidance, project management, scheduling support on maintenance activities, and troubleshooting technical issues. * Update and maintain regulatory pipeline records for ongoing operations. * Manage the maintenance pigging program. Activities encompass scheduling, validating, inspecting condition and inventory management of pigs and replacement parts. * Support pipeline integrity management programs, including inspections, risk assessments, corrosion mitigation, corrosion monitoring and remediation planning. * Assist in reliability centered maintenance and asset lifecycle planning activities. * Provide operational input to project engineering on pipeline projects, well connects, and pipeline expansions. * Investigate equipment failures, incidents, and operational anomalies to determine root causes and corrective actions. * Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to pipeline reliability and integrity. * Work with the system planning group to evaluate pipeline capacity, hydraulic performance, and operating conditions. * Participate in hazard analyses, incident investigations, and regulatory audits. * Promote a strong culture of safety and environmental responsibility. * Identify and implement process improvements that enhance compliance and operational safety. * Review engineering designs, specifications, and construction plans. * Conduct hydraulic modeling, pressure analysis, and operational studies. * Support commissioning, startup, and operational readiness activities. * Develop technical reports, engineering calculations, and recommendations. * Develop dashboards, reports, and metrics to support decision\-making. * Lead or participate in process improvement initiatives focused on reliability, efficiency, and cost reduction. ### **Required Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Petroleum Engineering * 5\+ years of engineering experience in pipeline operations, midstream operations, energy, or related industries. * Knowledge of pipeline operations, maintenance, and integrity management principles. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Heavy field\-level or direct operations experience preferred. * Knowledge of SCADA systems, control systems, and operational technology. * Familiarity with pipeline regulations and industry standards. **Other Requirements** ---------------------- * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Knowledge of pipeline systems, pumps, compressors, valves, and related equipment. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical data. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and engineering software tools. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration abilities. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced operational environment. * Strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- * Combination of office and field\-based work. * Regular travel to pipeline facilities, terminals, compressor stations, or operating sites.

jobs.description: Darktrace is a global leader in AI\-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day. Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real\-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead. At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end \- step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves. We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them. Our Values: Own It \| Win as One \| Raise Our Bar \| Move First. Learn Fast **Job D** **escription** **:** As a **Partner Solutions Engineer, SHI** you will build the technical capability of strategic partners and work alongside partner and Darktrace sales teams to create, progress, and expand customer opportunities. You will lead technical engagement across the partner lifecycle, from enablement and joint discovery through solution design, evaluation, business justification, deployment alignment, and value realization. As a trusted technical advisor, you will help partners confidently position Darktrace, identify customer challenges, develop relevant use cases, and communicate measurable security and business outcomes. You will combine technical depth, consultative selling, and disciplined execution to make the partner community a scalable extension of the field organization. **Key Responsibilities** *Partner Technical Strategy and Ownership* * Own the technical relationship and engagement plan for assigned partners. * Build credibility with partner sales, solutions engineering, services, and leadership stakeholders. * Develop joint technical strategies that support new customer acquisition, account expansion, renewals, and platform adoption. * Prioritize partner activity based on capability, opportunity potential, customer impact, and business outcomes. *Partner Enablement and Readiness* * Deliver structured technical enablement across Darktrace capabilities, customer use cases, competitive positioning, and value articulation. * Coach Partner SEs to lead discovery, demonstrations, technical validation, objection handling, and solution design. * Create repeatable field guidance, workshops, and technical assets that improve partner confidence and independence. * Assess partner readiness, identify capability gaps, and establish clear development actions. *Discovery and Value Alignment* * Lead and coach structured discovery aligned to MEDDPICC, identifying customer pain, impact, urgency, decision criteria, and technical requirements. * Align solutions to SOC workflows including triage, investigation, and response. * Translate customer requirements into relevant use cases, measurable outcomes, ROI, efficiency gains, and risk reduction. * Identify technical whitespace, adoption gaps, expansion opportunities, and risks across the customer lifecycle. *Solution Design and Technical Validation* * Architect scalable solutions across Darktrace platform capabilities for network, email, cloud, identity, endpoint, attack surface management, proactive exposure management, incident readiness and recovery. * Design for hybrid, multicloud, and existing security environments, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, NGFW, APIs, SPAN, and TAP requirements. * Advise partners and customers on deployment, integrations, performance, coverage, and architectural tradeoffs. * Support effective demonstrations, evaluations, and proofs of values that produce clear technical and business outcomes. *Joint Customer Engagement and Value Selling* * Engage technical and executive stakeholders with messaging tailored to their priorities and level of expertise. * Help partners translate complex cybersecurity concepts into clear, outcome focused narratives. * Lead or support high impact demonstrations, workshops, solution reviews, and executive technical conversations. * Handle technical objections and establish differentiated value in competitive opportunities. *Opportunity, Pipeline, and Account Strategy* * Partner with channel leaders, Account Executives, Expansion Account Executives, Partner SEs, and technical account teams to qualify opportunities and advance technical win plans. * Identify deal risks, remove technical blockers, maintain momentum, and support accurate opportunity progression. * Contribute to partner account planning, pipeline reviews, QBRs, and prioritization of high impact initiatives. * Ensure clean technical handoffs and continuity from presales through deployment, adoption, and expansion. *Cross Functional Collaboration* * Work with Sales, Customer Success, Technical Success, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering to deliver strong partner and customer outcomes. * Share partner, customer, market, and competitive feedback to improve product strategy, enablement, and go to market execution. * Coordinate resources to resolve challenges and strengthen the overall partner experience. **Skills and Experience** * Experience in solutions engineering, presales, partner engineering, technical account management, or a related customer facing role in cybersecurity or SaaS. Experience working at or with SHI is a plus. * Proven ability to enable technical audiences, influence stakeholders, and support both new business and expansion motions. * Strong knowledge of networking, cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP, and modern security architectures. * Experience with SOC technologies and workflows, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, and complex hybrid environments. * Ability to design solutions, deliver demonstrations, guide evaluations, and clearly communicate technical and business value. * Strong facilitation, communication, analytical, consultative selling, and business acumen. * Ability to manage multiple partner and customer priorities with urgency, ownership, and bias for execution. * Fundamental understanding of AI technologies, including LLM, ML, and NLP. * Bachelor’s degree or higher preferred, or equivalent experience. * Relevant cloud, security, and AI certifications are a plus. **Success in the Role** * Partners demonstrate greater technical confidence and independence across discovery, solution design, validation, and value selling. * Joint opportunities progress with clear technical ownership, stronger qualification, and fewer avoidable blockers. * Partner engagement creates repeatable pipeline impact across acquisition, expansion, renewals, and platform adoption. * Customers receive consistent technical experience from initial discovery through deployment, adoption, and growth. * Internal and partner teams operate with clear accountability, strong communication, and disciplined execution. **Benefits:** * 100% medical, dental and vision insurance, plus dependents * Paid parental leave * Pet insurance Discount * Life insurance * Commuter benefits * 401(k) * Employee Assistance Program As a growing business strengthening its governance and controls, this role plays a part in supporting high standards of integrity and accountability. *Darktrace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Technology that speaks your language** ======================================== Domera Labs builds Ami, the first AI companion for seniors. Ami brings the power of a smartphone into a more human form: voice\-first and deeply personalized We at Domera Labs are rethinking human\-machine interaction from first principles by introducing a better interface to interact with technology: voice By combining the most intuitive hardware design with frontier AI, Ami makes AI accessible for the fastest growing demographic worldwide. The goal is to make the everyday life older adults more seamless, while addressing that generation's biggest challenge: loneliness and isolation. With Ami we are building the category leader of a new hardware paradigm by building a full standalone device (and not a gadget) that aims to makes the smartphones of today redundant. The underlying technology of Ami combines a model\-agnostic streaming pipeline consisting of proprietary models and off\-the\-shelf frontier models to create a hyper\-personalized and proactive user experience. The backbone of Ami is built by our foundational lab that builds a social intelligence model that is optimized for social interaction, human behavior and interpersonal skills. Domera Labs has secured large distribution agreements, a model co\-development partnership with a leading AI lab, and ODM manufacturing proposals. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of human\-machine interaction, mass\-consumer facing hardware and shape frontier research with social/non\-quantifiable benchmarking. **Core Responsibilities** ========================= You will own the intelligence core of the product, end to end: * Train, fine\-tune, and evaluate the models behind the product's conversational behavior * Deploy models to production and keep them fast, reliable, and affordable at scale * ⁠Refine the full speech pipeline: STT, LLM orchestration, TTS for natural, low\-latency conversation * ⁠Build out the agent harness: scheduled actions that fire reliably, proactive behavior that feels right, and the guardrails around all of it **What we are looking for** =========================== * ⁠A builder's mindset: ship \> fail \> learn \> improve * Stay focused when multiple priorities compete and the ranking is unclear * Work seamlessly across research and engineering * Can navigate ambiguity and make progress in fast\-moving research environments * ⁠This is a founding\-level position. You will work directly with the founders, shape the architecture from the ground up, and see your work in users' hands within months, not years. **Technical Requirements** ========================== * Proven experience taking ML systems from experiment to production * ⁠Hands\-on work with LLMs and/or speech models (ASR/TTS); fine\-tuning experience is a strong plus * Comfort with real\-time constraints: streaming inference, latency budgets, graceful behavior on bad networks * **Bonus**: edge/embedded deployment, agent frameworks, evaluation infrastructure, experience in NLU / NLP **We consider candidates across experience levels and lean toward senior engineers who have worked directly with frontier AI systems. Python, deep learning frameworks, or distributed computing are non\-negotiable for this role.** **What you get** ================ * ⁠Founding\-team equity and a real say in technical direction * ⁠A product with signed launch partners, not a demo in search of a market * ⁠A small team, short decision paths * Cash compensation range of CHF 80 \- 100k with significant equity incentives * Opportunity to shape the future of hardware and social intelligent AI models **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Compensation Range: $110K \- $200K

The engineer is the team's owner for day\-to\-day test execution and defect quality on these feature tracks. **Key Responsibilities:** Manual feature validation: Execute functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing for Audio and streaming features on bench and in\-vehicle. Root cause analysis: Reproduce defects, capture and analyze logs (Wireshark, DLT, ADB, HCI/Bluetooth traces, vehicle logs), and isolate root cause before handing off to firmware owners. Field issue triage: Own first\-line triage for Audio and Streaming feature fleet issues — reproduce in lab, narrow scope, and drive issues to closure in partnership with fleet support, diagnostics, and firmware teams. Defect lifecycle: Manage defects end\-to\-end in JIRA — clear reproduction steps, attached logs, severity rationale, fix verification, and regression follow\-up. Field triage experience: Track record of reproducing and isolating defects reported from production/field environments. Strong defect\-tracking discipline (JIRA/Confluence) and experience in agile release cycles. **Preferred Qualifications:** Prior experience with in\-cabin entertainment and/or media casting frameworks. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Many structural heart patients suffer from heart failure with limited options. Our Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) team, part of the AI, Product and Platforms organization, is at the forefront of addressing these unmet patient needs through pioneering technology that enables early, targeted therapeutic intervention. Our innovative solutions are not just transforming patient care but also creating a unique and exciting environment for our team members. It is our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey. At Edwards Lifesciences, the Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) AI, Product and Platforms organization designs and builds the software and data products that clinicians and patients depend on. As a Senior Data Scientist, you own modeling for a clinical or product domain, drive problem framing with product and clinical partners, own offline\-validation rigor, and author model documentation that meets FDA submission expectations for regulated products. Based in Irvine, CA, you'll join a high\-impact medtech innovation hub in the heart of Orange County, collaborating in person with cross\-functional teams to shape patient\-focused technology. **How you'll make an impact** ----------------------------- * Domain modeling. Own modeling for a clinical or product domain, for example, arrhythmia classification, cardiac imaging segmentation, clinical prediction, or patient outcome forecasting, from framing through offline validation. * Architecture selection. Select and adapt architectures for the modality (vision transformers or encoder\-decoder networks for imaging, transformers, or temporal models for signals) and apply self\-supervised and representation learning under limited labels. * Statistical depth. Apply survival analysis, Bayesian modeling, and causal inference where the clinical question requires (statsmodels, lifelines or scikit\-survival, PyMC). * Evaluation \& subgroup. Design offline evaluation, calibration, and clinical performance validation strategies, including subgroup and bias analysis across sex, age, and device cohort, with Medical Affairs and Clinical Science. * Interpretability \& documentation. Author submission\-grade model documentation including calibration, uncertainty, and interpretability evidence (SHAP, Captum), and improve the team's modeling and validation practice. * Research adoption. Evaluate and adapt current AI/ML for health research to IHFM problems, and mentor less experienced data scientists. * Handoff. Coordinate the handoff of offline\-validated custom models to AI/ML Engineers (Applied), and partner with Regulatory Affairs on submission strategy. * Algorithm development, analysis \& reporting. Create, test, and improve complex algorithms, NLP, and machine learning models; analyze results; develop insights; and produce reports and dashboards to communicate performance and findings to stakeholders. * Data preparation \& quality. Process, cleanse, label, and verify structured and unstructured data used for analysis; collaborate with internal teams and external partners on data standards, metrics, analytics, and reporting. * Tools, integration \& design controls. Identify and integrate data sources, software, and analytics tools (e.g., Python, SQL, SAS, Power BI, Tableau Prep); support development of design control documentation including algorithm requirements and risk documentation. **What you'll need (Required):** -------------------------------- * Bachelor's in related field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Biostatistics or Scientific) plus 2 years of previous experience including industry or industry/ education * This is an onsite role based in Irvine, CA. Relocation assistance is not provided, and candidates must reside within a 50\-mile radius of Irvine to be considered. **What else we look for (Preferred):** -------------------------------------- * Depth in at least one data modality relevant to IHFM, for example, time\-series, or medical imaging (echocardiography, cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, or computed tomography). * Command of the relevant architecture families and of transfer and self\-supervised learning. * Strong Python and SQL, and depth in modeling and experiment tracking such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and MLflow. * Command of evaluation, calibration, and clinical performance methodology, including subgroup analysis, and the ability to author documentation suitable for regulatory submission. * A track record of owning modeling for a domain and communicating results to clinical, product, and regulatory partners. * Experience with clinical validation, retrospective clinical data, or regulated medical software (SaMD). * Depth in time\-series or medical imaging modeling, including segmentation and registration, for example, MONAI, pydicom, or SimpleITK. * Bayesian modeling, causal inference (DoWhy, EconML), or survival analysis (lifelines, scikit\-survival). * Generative approaches for augmentation or synthetic data (autoencoders, GANs, or diffusion models). * Exposure to multimodal modeling, combining signals, imaging, labs, and notes into patient\-state models. * Familiarity with R, JAX, or hyperparameter optimization (Optuna, Ray Tune). * Contributions to internal or external research (publications, patents, or venues such as MICCAI or ML4H). Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance\-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families. For California (CA), the base pay range for this position is $87,000 to $123,000 (highly experienced). The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website. Edwards is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer including protected Veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Programming or scripting experience using VBA. * Knowledge of LabVIEW, programmable logic controllers, manufacturing execution systems, equipment software, or other manufacturing automation technologies. * Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional technical activities, evaluate validation results, investigate software\-related issues, and communicate recommendations to engineering and quality stakeholders. * Experience participating in cross\-site or global governance councils, communities of practice, or process\-standardization initiatives. * Strong consulting and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to translate software requests into validation and documentation requirements. * Strong technical writing, analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities in a fast\-paced, shared\-service environment. * Edwards is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer including protected Veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Overhead Transmission Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** ============== Overhead Transmission Engineer **Location:** ============= Charlotte, NC **Job Summary and Description:** ================================ ### **Break Out of the Office. Collaborate directly with a vast global network of utility leaders, world\-class testing labs, manufacturers, and academic researchers.** * ### **High\-Visibility Industry Impact:** **Lead initiatives that directly influence grid reliability, emergency restoration strategies, advanced conductor adoption, and international design standards.** ### **What You’ll Do** * ### **Innovate \& Solve Complex jobs.description: Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end\-to\-end, cloud\-driven networking solutions. This role combines deep expertise in human\-computer interaction (HCI), user behavior analysis, and systems\-level thinking to assess how AI agents perform in real\-world contexts and identify opportunities for improvement. The ideal candidate will use quantitative analytics, behavioral science principles, and systems thinking to drive data\-informed product decisions and ensure AI systems are both effective and user\-centric. We’re looking for a mid\-level AI Product Analyst to own the instrumentation and reporting that prove Agent ONE is working, adopted and valued by customers, and linked to retention and revenue. product success and customer value. ### **Primary Responsibilities:** ### **AI Agent Evaluation \& Behavioral Analysis** * Design and conduct comprehensive behavioral studies to evaluate AI agent performance across usability, task completion, error recovery, and user satisfaction metrics * Apply HCI and behavioral science frameworks to understand how users interact with AI systems and identify friction points in agent behavior * Assess agent reliability, decision transparency, and failure modes from both user and systems perspectives ### **Analytics \& Quantitative Research** * Develop user analytics frameworks to track AI agent effectiveness, including KPIs for success, user trust, task completion rates, and cognitive load * Design and implement instrumentation to collect behavioral and interaction data from user sessions * Conduct statistical analysis, A/B testing, and cohort analysis to measure AI agent impact and validate product improvements ### **Systems\-Level Performance Assessment** * Evaluate AI agents holistically across performance dimensions: accuracy, latency, cost efficiency, scalability, and robustness * Model and communicate trade\-offs between performance dimensions (e.g., accuracy vs. speed, cost vs. quality) * Identify bottlenecks and systemic issues affecting user experience across the full AI\-user interaction lifecycle ### **Product Insights \& Strategy** * Translate behavioral findings and analytics into actionable product recommendations and roadmap priorities * Partner with product managers, engineers, and designers to validate hypotheses and guide feature development * Create dashboards, reports, and narratives to communicate behavioral insights to stakeholders and leadership ### **Required Qualifications** * Prior experience evaluating AI systems, machine learning models, chatbots, or autonomous agents * 4\+ years of professional experience in user analytics, product analytics, behavioral research, or HCI research roles * Strong foundation in human\-computer interaction (HCI) principles and behavioral science fundamentals (cognitive load, mental models, task completion, user trust, etc.) * Demonstrated proficiency with quantitative analytics: SQL, Python/R for statistical analysis, and familiarity with A/B testing and experimental design * Experience designing and instrumenting analytics tracking, defining success metrics, and interpreting complex datasets * Ability to think systemically about product performance and understand interactions between multiple variables affecting user outcomes * Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical findings into clear, compelling narratives for non\-technical stakeholders ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Background in formal usability testing, user research, or user testing methodologies (or equivalent research experience) * Experience with analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, Tableau) or BI tools * Familiarity with systems thinking frameworks, causal inference, or econometric modeling * Experience collaborating with ML/AI engineers or understanding of AI/ML capabilities and limitations * Graduate degree in psychology, HCI, behavioral science, statistics, or related field Experience measuring LLM or conversational\-AI systems — evaluation signals such as latency, refusal/quality scoring, or conversation\-trajectory classification. * Familiarity with networking, IT operations, or B2B SaaS, and with operational KPIs like MTTR, uptime, or escalation rate. * Experience with a modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt) and light scripting in Python or R. * Exposure to NPS, SUS, or other structured voice\-of\-customer programs; comfort with sentiment/theme analysis of free\-text feedback. ### jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **About the Role** Support Fanatics Collect's Unified Experience initiative, building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences. Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault — but those moments still feel like separate products. Your job is to make them feel like one. That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front\-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down. This is a hands\-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end — schema to API to UI — and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design. **Why Join Us** Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest\-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves. **Product Context and Scale** Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high\-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non\-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft. **First 90 Days** * Ship a meaningful, user\-facing piece of the unified experience end to end. * Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today — data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them. * Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on. * Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript. * Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel. * Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front\-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post\-launch metrics. * Build and maintain reusable front\-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on — and treat other engineers as first\-class consumers of what you build. * Contribute to cross\-surface concerns like shared identity, entitlements, inventory, and navigation between collector experiences. * Ship behind feature flags with instrumentation in place, and use the resulting data to decide what to keep, fix, or cut. * Prototype quickly with Product and Design when a working demo will settle a debate faster than a document. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, LLM\-backed workflows) to raise your own throughput, and share what works with the team. * Write meaningful tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E — using Playwright, Jest, React Testing Library, and Pytest, and keep CI/CD pipelines trustworthy. * Maintain component documentation and interaction specs via Storybook. * Participate in sprint planning, retros, and product strategy sessions; raise scope and sequencing concerns early rather than at the end. * Mentor engineers through code review and pairing, and raise the bar on code structure, testing, and documentation. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of professional fullstack development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Python, plus hands\-on cloud experience (AWS preferred). * Strong grasp of architectural patterns, API design, and application performance tuning — and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the right one. * Track record of owning features end to end in production, including the parts after launch: monitoring, debugging, and iterating on real user behavior. * Solid front\-end fundamentals: responsive UI development, accessibility (a11y), and front\-end performance practices. * Experience with state management patterns and tools such as React Context, Zustand, Redux, or XState, and a thoughtful approach to complexity in large apps. * Strong testing discipline with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Pytest. * Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices. * Comfortable working across domains — backend APIs, customer\-facing web, mobile web, and internal tools — and context switching without dropping threads. * Clear written and verbal communication; able to work directly with Product, Design, and other engineering teams and drive alignment on your own work. * Experience using or a genuine appetite for AI developer tooling to improve velocity. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience integrating or consolidating multiple existing products, including data migrations against live users. * Experience with high\-traffic, real\-time, or live\-event product surfaces. * Background in growth engineering or rapid experimentation frameworks. * Experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, or gaming live ops. * Design system or shared component library ownership. * Passion for collecting, trading, sports, or gaming — and an interest in being a user of what you build. If you like owning problems end to end, care about how software feels and not just whether it works, and want your work used daily by millions of collectors — we'd love to talk. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers* By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Director, Mainframe CICS/MVS Performance and Capacity
jobs.description: ### **Job Description:** **Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.** **Director, Mainframe CICS/MVS Performance and Capacity** **Mainframe Capacity and Performance** **Primary Domain** CICS/MVS Performance and Capacity ### **Business Overview** The Fidelity Mainframe Capacity and Performance team is responsible for capacity modeling and forecasting, performance analysis, system configuration tuning, monitoring, and L2/L3 problem determination supporting Fidelity’s large IBM z Systems infrastructure. The team supports critical online and batch applications across the enterprise and works closely with business partners, Mainframe Hosting, DBMS, CICS, MQ, Storage, Network, application teams, IBM, and other strategic vendors. This role is focused on the CICS and MVS/zOS performance and capacity domain, including CICS region behavior, transaction and program\-level performance, online response time, WLM and dispatching behavior, GP/zIIP utilization, batch and JES interactions, storage/I/O considerations, workload growth forecasting, stress\-test assessment, modernization measurement, and production resiliency. The role requires both deep hands\-on technical expertise and the ability to translate complex performance and capacity findings into clear business, resiliency, and cost recommendations for senior leadership. ### **Position Description** The Associate will focus on leading CICS and MVS/zOS performance and capacity analysis for Fidelity’s mainframe environments, providing end\-to\-end analysis, modeling, tuning recommendations, and strategic guidance for complex multi\-tier applications running on z/OS and using CICS, MQ, WAS, DB2, batch, VSAM, storage, network, and cloud\-to\-mainframe integration patterns. A major responsibility of this role is to lead and/or participate in the capacity and performance analysis of new technologies and production changes that affect online and batch workload behavior. This includes developing KPI projection models, analyzing application and infrastructure change impacts, assessing failover/failback behavior, evaluating CICS/MVS configuration choices, and driving practical recommendations that balance customer experience, resiliency, platform capacity, operational simplicity, and software/hardware cost. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. The Director is expected to guide engineers and partner business application teams through high\-severity incidents, performance reviews, stress\-test findings, modernization measurement, and ongoing capacity routines. The role also requires executive communication skills, vendor engagement, and the ability to influence application, infrastructure, and architecture decisions using data. ### **Primary Responsibilities and Skills** * Lead CICS and MVS/zOS performance and capacity analysis across production, non\-production, and business\-event scenarios including market open, batch, stress testing, cloud failback, large release windows, and modernization events. * Analyze CICS transaction, region, program, file, VSAM, DB2, MQ, WAS, DDF\-adjacent, and application flow behavior to identify response\-time drivers, CPU consumption, wait time, bottlenecks, saturation points, and resiliency risks. * Assess MVS/zOS subsystem and platform configuration opportunities including WLM policy, PR/SM weighting, LPAR logical CP and zIIP configuration, dispatching behavior, memory/real storage, JES/batch interactions, CF considerations, DASD/FICON, and I/O path behavior. * Perform transaction, program, job, STC, ASID, region, and application\-level analysis for high CPU, elongated response time, increased get/put activity, access\-path or routing changes, batch elongation, and regression findings from QA/stress\-test cycles. * Partner with application, DBMS, CICS, MQ, WAS, storage, network, modernization, and operations teams to connect performance symptoms to end\-to\-end application topology, failover behavior, transaction mix, business volume, and customer impact. * Use SMF, RMF, CICS/DBMS logs, SYSVIEW, IntelliMagic, OMEGAMON, Strobe/iStrobe, Broadcom tools, MXG/SAS, Grafana, Power BI, SQL, Python/R, JCL, REXX, and related tools to build objective performance findings and recommendations. * Develop forecasting and capacity models that connect business KPIs, transaction volumes, CPU/zIIP consumption, MSU/MIPS impact, batch demand, CICS region demand, middleware behavior, and application modernization activity. * Lead production incident analysis and problem management for CICS/MVS\-related performance, resiliency, and capacity events, including timeline reconstruction, root\-cause support, next\-step recommendations, and preventive controls. * Evaluate and recommend workload protection patterns including Safe Mode, routing controls, WLM policy changes, CICS region/thread/concurrency controls, batch scheduling adjustments, capacity configuration changes, and test access controls. * Provide technical leadership guity while building repeatable practices, dashboards, runbooks, routines, and decision frameworks. * Ability to mentor engineers, raise team capability, reduce single points of failure, and help develop the next generation of mainframe performance and capacity talent. ### **The Value You Deliver** * Improves customer experience and platform resiliency by proactively identifying CICS/MVS performance constraints before they become production incidents. * Reduces avoidable capacity and software cost by connecting CICS/MVS tuning, workload behavior, GP/zIIP usage, and MSU/MIPS consumption to specific application and infrastructure recommendations. * Strengthens modernization execution by providing objective before/after measurement for CICS\-to\-cloud, MQ/WAS changes, batch optimization, VSAM/data\-movement changes, and decommissioning initiatives. * Provides reliable CICS/MVS performance governance for major business events, production changes, stress tests, z17 migration, and large platform initiatives. * Creates repeatable CICS/MVS capacity routines, reports, dashboards, playbooks, and decision logs that reduce key\-person dependency and improve operational readiness. * Helps senior leaders make informed decisions by presenting clear options, risks, tradeoffs, quantified recommendations, and operational impacts. ### **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, or a closely related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered. * 10 plus years of technology experience with significant hands\-on experience in IBM z/OS, CICS, MVS performance, capacity planning, systems programming, middleware engineering, infrastructure engineering, or production support. * Experience in a large financial\-services, high\-volume transaction processing, or mission\-critical enterprise environment is strongly preferred. * Demonstrated experience leading complex cross\-functional technical analysis and communicating recommendations to senior leadership. **Expected Knowledge** * Core CICS/MVS * CICS region and transaction behavior, program attribution, response\-time analysis, CICS statistics/monitoring, VSAM/file activity, QR/TOR/AOR patterns where applicable, z/OS/MVS system behavior, WLM, JES/batch interactions * Mainframe Platform * z/OS, Parallel Sysplex, PR/SM, LPARs, zIIP/GP optimization, RMF/SMF, DASD/FICON, memory/real storage, coupling facility considerations, storage/I/O path behavior * Tools * SAS/MXG, SYSVIEW, IntelliMagic, OMEGAMON, Broadcom tools, Strobe/iStrobe, Grafana, Power BI, SQL, Python, R, JCL, REXX, automation and reporting workflows * Adjacent Domains * DB2, MQ, WAS, batch, VSAM, replication/data movement, cloud\-to\-mainframe, CICS\-to\-cloud, IOM/CAM failback patterns, application topology and routing * Leadership * Incident/problem management, change governance, vendor engagement, executive communication, mentoring, technical decision facilitation, capacity/cost governance Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model Fidelity is transitioning to a full\-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles. ### **Certifications:** ### **Category:** Information Technology Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement\-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self\-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise AI
jobs.description: Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. Five9 is looking for a Senior Director, AI and Innovation to lead our Enterprise AI Program — the cross\-functional effort to identify, build, and scale AI\-driven capabilities across the company. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, engineering, and business operations, translating emerging AI capabilities into measurable value for Five9's customers, agents, and internal teams. You will set the vision and own the roadmap for enterprise AI initiatives, build and lead a team executing against it, partner with product, engineering, CX, and operations leaders at the VP and executive level, and act as the primary internal evangelist and governance owner for responsible AI adoption at scale. **What You'll Do** * Define and drive the enterprise\-wide AI strategy and roadmap, aligning initiatives with Five9's broader business and goals * Identify high\-impact opportunities to apply AI (including generative AI, machine learning, and automation) across contact center operations, customer experience, and internal enterprise functions * Own the technical roadmap for Claude \& Gemini Enterprise plugin framework, a growing library of role\-based skills and agents that surface AI capabilities to employees in the context of their specific roles. This includes expanding coverage across more roles and use cases, maturing the way plugins are securely authored, tested, and deployed, and continuously improving the quality and reliability of each plugin's outputs. * Establish and own enterprise\-wide governance, risk, and compliance frameworks for responsible AI use, including data privacy, model risk, and vendor evaluation, setting policy that other leaders across the company adopt * Partner closely with Enterprise Data, Enterprise Apps, Product Development, and Infosec to connect to governed data sources, align on security controls, and ensure every integration is built on architectural standards * Build and defend the business case for AI investments at the portfolio level quantifying ROI, prioritizing initiatives, and owning progress reporting to executive leadership * Own strategic relationships with external AI vendors, technology partners, and research organizations, including negotiating terms and setting partnership strategy * Champion AI literacy and adoption company\-wide through training, communication, and change management programs, and build the organizational structure to sustain it * Track emerging AI trends and technologies, assessing their relevance and readiness for enterprise deployment at Five9, and shape long\-term technology bets accordingly * Hire, mentor, and manage a team of AI engineers, managers, and technical leads **What You'll Bring** * 8\+ years of experience in technology strategy, innovation, product management, or AI/ML program leadership, including 3\+ years in a people\- or program\-management capacity * Demonstrated experience leading enterprise\-scale AI or digital transformation initiatives from concept through production * Strong understanding of AI/ML fundamentals, generative AI, and enterprise data platforms, enough to evaluate technical trade\-offs and partner credibly with engineering teams * Experience building AI governance frameworks (data privacy, model risk, responsible AI) in a regulated or enterprise SaaS environment * Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross\-functional alignment without direct authority * Strong business acumen, able to translate AI capabilities into ROI\-driven business cases * Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field; MBA or advanced technical degree a plus * Experience in the contact center, CX, or SaaS industry is a plus Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal. Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9\.
