jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: #### **Automation Engineer** Goshen Engineering Location: Mount Olive, NC Job Type: Full\-Time #### **About Goshen Engineering** Goshen Engineering provides innovative custom engineered to order solutions in industrial automation and power distribution. We are a rapidly growing manufacturing and engineering company in Eastern North Carolina. Our automation division specializes in custom industrial automation, system integration services, turn\-key robotic systems, control system upgrades, and on\-site automation services. Our electrical power distribution division services include custom engineering of UL891 switchboards, integrated power skids, string inverter racks, EV charging solutions., custom bus duct and trough, and other fully integrated solutions for data centers, utility scale solar power, battery energy storage, electric vehicle charging, and industrial power distribution. Joining our team means embracing the opportunity to tackle a variety of complex challenges across multiple disciplines. Our work culture thrives on a spirit of teamwork, innovation, ambition, and drive while offering a unique flexibility and a family\-oriented atmosphere of a small privately held company. We are looking for individuals who are looking for more than just a routine 8\-5 job. If you are determined, ambitious, proactive in developing your skill, take pride in your work, work well with a team, value hard work, and are ready to commit to your professional growth and our company’s success, then this is the place for you. #### **About the Role** Goshen Engineering is seeking Automation Engineers to design, develop, build, integrate, test, commission, and support automation and control solutions. The role works across electrical and mechanical controls, PLC/HMI/SCADA/servo/VFD/robot programming, safety systems, technical documentation, customer support, and project execution. The position may be filled at Level I, II, or III based on demonstrated technical proficiency and experience, with responsibility increasing from assigned technical work to independent project leadership, advanced system integration, and development of less\-experienced engineers and technicians. #### **What You'll Do** * Develop electrical and mechanical controls\-system design solutions based on engineering principles, applicable codes, and customer requirements. * Work with the engineering and automation team to design, build, test, document, and implement automation solutions from concept through customer\-site implementation. * Develop and modify electrical schematics and review bills of material for automation projects and related equipment. * Program and troubleshoot PLC, HMI, SCADA, VFD, servo, and robot control systems, including Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, and a variety of other brand platforms as applicable to assigned projects. * Design and implement safety control circuits and safety\-system solutions consistent with applicable standards and project requirements. * Perform system testing, troubleshooting, startup, commissioning, and technical support at Goshen and customer locations as assigned. * Interpret customer requirements, identify design parameters and engineering challenges, and develop practical technical solutions based on customer communications and observation of processes. * Provide technical controls support to customers, including PLC, HMI, SCADA, VFD, servo, robotics, and general control\-system troubleshooting. * Act as project leader on assigned automation projects as appropriate to level, coordinating technical work and maintaining accurate project records, documentation, and customer correspondence. * Balance multiple projects and responsibilities while supporting project schedules, deliverables, testing, commissioning, and handover activities. * Manage or support vendor and bill\-of\-material activities, including product cross\-reference, component alternatives, and vendor communication as required by the assignment. * Collaborate across electrical, mechanical, process, production, quality, sales, and other functions to resolve technical and project issues. * Develop and maintain customer relationships and communicate technical information and solutions to customers and other stakeholders. * Assist in training and developing junior engineers and other team members as appropriate to level; maintain accurate project, revision\-control, and technical documentation. #### **What You'll Bring** **Required** * Associate’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a similar related engineering field; experience may be substituted for education. * Related automation, controls, electrical, or engineering experience appropriate to the assigned level. * Ability to create electrical schematics and work with PLC, HMI, VFD, servo, and robot control systems. * Ability to troubleshoot electrical, controls, and electromechanical problems and determine an appropriate course of action. * Critical thinking with exceptional problem\-solving skills; ability to work independently and in team environments. * Proactive, resourceful, highly motivated approach with strong communication skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to learn new software and technical topics quickly, balance multiple projects and responsibilities, and work with increasing independence based on level. * Ability to travel to customer sites as required for project support and commissioning; additional hours, weekends, or travel may be required based on project and customer needs. * Knowledge of electrical panel design, control circuits, power distribution, component specification, SCCR, circuit protection, applicable NEC/NFPA and IEC requirements, PLC architecture, industrial networking, machine safety, and related automation technologies as applicable to assigned work. * Regular on\-site physical presence is required; ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods, lift/carry/push/pull up to 50 pounds, and safely use computers, standard office equipment, tools, machinery, testing equipment, and measuring devices required for assigned duties. **Preferred** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a similar related engineering field. * Experience with Allen\-Bradley software family; Siemens TIA Portal experience is a plus. * Experience programming HMIs and SCADA systems * Experience with AutoCAD Electrical or similar electrical schematic software. * Experience modifying or programming industrial robotic systems; Fanuc, ABB, or Kuka experience is particularly relevant. #### **Why Goshen Engineering?** At Goshen Engineering, you'll join a growing company where your work matters. We believe in working together, supporting one another, and giving employees the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow. You'll have the chance to make a real impact while helping shape the future of our company. We offer: * Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits package * Paid time off and holidays * Professional development opportunities * A collaborative, team\-oriented work environment * Opportunities for growth as the Company continues to expand #### **Ready to Join Our Team?** If you're looking for an opportunity to grow your career while making a meaningful contribution to a company that's committed to quality, innovation, and its people, we'd love to hear from you. #### **Equal Opportunity Employer** Goshen Engineering is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected status under applicable law. #### **Experience** Preferred* Related automation, controls, electrical, or engineering experience appropriate to the assigned level. #### **Education** Preferred* Associates or better in Engineering or related field Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Co-op (January - August 2027)
jobs.description: Graco manufactures and markets premium equipment to move, measure, control, dispense and spray a wide variety of fluid and powder materials. What does that mean? Well, we pump peanut butter into your jar, and the oil in your car. We glue the soles of your shoes, the glass in your windows and the screen on your phone. We spray the finish on your vehicle, coatings on your pills, the paint on your house and texture on your walls. Graco is part of your daily life. The Graco Intern Program offers more than just work experience—it’s a chance to make an impact. As an intern, you’ll take on projects that matter to the business, contribute to initiatives that drive progress, and develop skills that prepare you for what’s ahead. Throughout the program, you’ll expand your industry knowledge, collaborate with professionals who are passionate about doing things the right way, and experience a culture that thrives on new ideas and continual growth. You’ll also take part in events designed to support both your learning and personal development. The program concludes with a final presentation where you’ll showcase your achievements and the difference you’ve made. **Job Purpose:** To support the Strategic Business Unit and the Manufacturing Cell and apply coursework to real\-world applications as a Manufacturing Engineer Intern. Position involves providing ideas, inputs and analysis as a project team member. **What You Will Do at Graco** * Provide general production support for machining and/or assembly areas by participating in hands\-on troubleshooting issues and providing technical assistance * Assist in evaluating the need for machine and/or assembly area upgrades * Participate in capital equipment justification as needed * Review and analyze standards and operational layouts to suggest improvements * Assist in the selection and implementation of tooling and fixtures for machining and/or assembly jobs * Participate in cost of quality improvements, root cause analysis and corrective action * React to changing priorities in a timely manner * Report man\-hour estimates **What You Will Bring to Graco** * Currently enrolled and pursing a Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering or comparable Engineering program * Minimum GPA of 3\.0 on a 4\.0 scale * Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills * Ability to work independently and as an effective team member * Mechanical aptitude and desire for hands on work **Accelerators** * Experience with CAD software such as AutoCAD * Experience with 3D printers *Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., H\-1B, TN, F\-1 OPT).* At Graco, you truly make a difference. Your unique talents contribute to our organizational growth and future. Not only do you make a difference, but Graco’s culture empowers employees to create their own career path. Whether you choose to advance within your current department or explore new opportunities in different divisions, you have the ability to build your future. Our managers are here to provide support and guidance as you continue to grow within your career. Graco has excellent opportunities available to individuals who want to be part of a fast\-moving, growing company that is committed to quality, innovation and solving fluid handling problems for our customers. Graco is proud to be named a Best Place to Work by Fortune Magazine in 2016, 2018, 2019, 2021 \& 2022\. Graco offers attractive compensation, benefits and career development opportunities. Graco’s comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, stock purchase plan, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and more. Our company uses E\-Verify to confirm the employment and eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E\-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify . If you are hired, your final base hourly rate will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, competencies, education, and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we will also consider internal equity of our current employees. Please keep in mind that the range provided is the full base salary range for the role. Hiring at or near the maximum of the range would not be typical to allow for future and continued salary growth. $21\.00 \- $28\.00

jobs.title: Legal Data Engineer Lead
jobs.description: Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with locations across the world in 15 countries, has an exciting employment opportunity for you. We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, along with the opportunity to work within an innovative and collaborative environment. **Join our Innovation Team as a Legal Data Analyst Lead in one of our various U.S. office locations.** We are seeking a highly skilled professional who thrives in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in every task. With a dedicated work ethic and a can\-do attitude, you will take initiative and approach challenges with confidence and resilience. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams and delivering exceptional client service. If you are someone who demonstrates initiatives, adaptability, and innovation, we invite you to join our team. **Position Summary:** The Legal Data Engineer Lead is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data\-driven and AI\-enabled solutions that support legal matters, client engagements, and internal business initiatives. This role oversees complex data engineering, integration, automation, analytics, and AI projects involving large, diverse, and often unstructured data sets, leveraging advanced technical expertise to deliver scalable, defensible, and high\-quality solutions. The position exercises independent judgment in selecting appropriate technologies and methodologies, evaluates the accuracy and reliability of AI\-assisted outputs, identifies opportunities to enhance workflows through automation and AI, and provides technical guidance to team members. **Key Responsibilities:** * Designs, develops, tests, and maintains complex data workflows and pipelines incorporating traditional data engineering, automation, and AI\-enabled processing techniques. * Develops Python\-based solutions for data processing, extraction, classification, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and reporting. * Designs workflows that use generative AI, large language models, multimodal AI, or other AI technologies to extract, classify, summarize, normalize, or structure information from PDFs, documents, images, spreadsheets, and other structured and unstructured data sources. * Develops structured AI workflows using techniques such as prompt engineering, schema\-based outputs, JSON processing, validation logic, exception handling, and automated quality\-control procedures. * Integrates AI capabilities with Python, APIs, databases, cloud services, and traditional data\-processing workflows to create repeatable and scalable analytical solutions. * Evaluates AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability and develop validation procedures appropriate for legal and client\-facing work. * Designs human\-in\-the\-loop review processes and other quality\-control mechanisms for AI\-assisted workflows where appropriate. * Identifies appropriate and inappropriate use cases for AI based on data sensitivity, analytical risk, accuracy requirements, confidentiality, and the intended use of the resulting work product. * Assists in developing standards, documentation, and governance practices for the responsible use of AI within Legal Data Analytics workflows. * Evaluates emerging AI technologies, models, platforms, and development approaches and recommend tools that can improve the efficiency, accuracy, or scalability of the department's analytical services. * Prototypes and developsAI\-enabled tools and self\-service applications that automate repetitive data preparation, extraction, review, or analytical processes. * Collaborates with attorneys and technical professionals to translate legal and business requirements into data engineering and AI\-assisted analytical solutions. * Provides technical guidance to team members on data extraction, transformation, automation, reporting, data validation, and analytics tools and processes. **Qualifications:** *Skills \& Competencies* * Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to data accuracy and quality assurance. * Strong collaboration and client service orientation with the ability to partner effectively across departments and business functions. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills with the ability to work with complex datasets and identify data quality issues, trends, and anomalies. * Strong Python programming skills with demonstrated experience developing reusable data\-processing, automation, and AI\-enabled workflows. * Practical experience incorporating generative AI or large language models into data\-processing or analytical workflows. * Understanding of prompt engineering and techniques for producing reliable, structured outputs from generative AI systems. * Experience working with structured AI o valuate AI\-generated results critically and design validation and quality\-control procedures to identify hallucinations, omissions, inconsistencies, and other output errors. * Understanding of human\-in\-the\-loop design and the importance of maintaining appropriate human review for higher\-risk legal and analytical applications. * Ability to determine when traditional programming, deterministic rules, statistical methods, or AI\-based approaches are most appropriate for a particular analytical problem. * Familiarity with responsible AI concepts, including data privacy, confidentiality, security, transparency, reproducibility, and appropriate use of AI within professional services environments. * Ability to prototype new AI\-enabled analytical workflows and move successful concepts toward repeatable production processes. *Education \& Prior Experience* * Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative or technical field required; equivalent combination of certifications and relevant professional experience may be considered * Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in data engineering, data analytics, database development, automation, business intelligence, or a related technical discipline. * Demonstrated Data extraction and document\-processing techniques * Demonstrated Data validation, reconciliation, and automated quality control * Demonstrated experience using Python and SQL to develop complex data\-processing and automation solutions. * Demonstrated experience incorporating artificial intelligence, generative AI, machine learning, natural language processing, or related technologies into data or document\-processing workflows. * Experience independently developing solutions involving structured and unstructured data, including spreadsheets, databases, PDFs, documents, images, APIs, or other source formats. * Experience evaluating and validating automated or AI\-generated outputs in environments where accuracy and reproducibility are important. * Experience supporting data\-intensive environments, preferably within a law firm, legal services, professional services, consulting, compliance, human resources, financial, litigation, or employment analytics setting. * Experience mentoring, reviewing, or providing technical guidance to less experienced technical professionals preferred. * Development of AI\-enabled self\-service applications or analytical tools *Technology* Required : * Advanced Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL * Python * Microsoft Excel * Generative AI / Large Language Models * Prompt engineering * REST APIs and JSON * Structured\-output and schema\-based AI workflows * Git or comparable source\-control practices Preferred: * Microsoft Azure * Microsoft Fabric * Azure Data Factory * Azure SQL Database * Azure AI services * Azure OpenAI or comparable enterprise LLM platforms * Power BI * SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) * Multimodal AI and document intelligence technologies * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) concepts * Vector search or semantic search concepts * AI orchestration or agent\-based workflow concepts * Machine learning or natural language processing **Physical Requirements:** * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to move from workstation or desk throughout the work area to work independently or with a team to meet with colleagues or supervisor and retrieve work assignments * This position may also be sedentary and require the employee to sit for extended periods of time * Requires manual dexterity to dial a telephone, enter data into a computer, handle objects, and operate tools GT is an EEO employer with an inclusive workplace basis.

jobs.title: Software Developer Intern
jobs.description: Software Developer Intern Location: Chicago **The Opportunity** =================== Group One Trading, a dynamic options trading firm, is actively seeking highly\-motivated people who are interested in learning and getting hands\-on experience with electronic trading systems. Our system is built on the .NET platform using C\#. The system has enough variety to challenge and interest anyone: an information\-dense user interface, a high\-throughput, low latency parallel computational core, service\-oriented architecture, and interfaces to exchanges' market data and execution systems. **Who We Are** ============== We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At Group One, we value transparency and collaboration coming from unique perspectives and backgrounds. We strive to create a workplace in which all employees have an opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. **What We Do** ============== Group One is a proprietary trading firm specializing in market making and liquidity providing strategies in options markets. Our traders provide competitive liquidity across a broad range of securities by managing portfolios of several hundred issues and simultaneously streaming quotes across multiple exchanges. Our systems and network infrastructure are vital in ensuring success. **The Skill Set** ================= During this internship, you will be mentored by senior developers and gain exposure to the business of equity options trading. You will gain real\-world experience with a team that develops proprietary software in an ever\-changing, fast\-paced, and competitive environment. A broad, multi\-platform skill set will help you be successful in this role, but there will be plenty of learning opportunities no matter how many of these skills you bring in with you. We also encourage applicants with non\-traditional backgrounds to apply. * Must be an active student during the following Fall semester working towards a BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. * Familiarity with a C\-style object\-oriented language: C\#, Java, C\+\+, or Objective\-C. * Solid Computer Science and software development fundamentals. * Desire to learn and grow as a software developer. * Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with colleagues across different functional units and locations. **Within 1 Month, You'll** ========================== * Complete your initial orientation, become familiar with our environment, our infrastructure, and our business. * Learn the roles and skillsets of your Dev teammates to discern and utilize the best advice and information for yourself and others. **Within 3 Months, You'll** =========================== * Engage and contribute directly to projects with real implications for our traders and company. **The Benefits** ================ We offer a competitive compensation package which includes company\-paid housing or housing stipend, individualized mentorship, fresh fruit and snacks daily, casual dress environment, social events, and more! In\-person interview expenses for travel and childcare will be reimbursed by Group One.

We are seeking candidates with broad skillsets and various levels of experience to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals to work right here at our Savannah facility. **What you will do:** * Develop, Design, and Certify hardware and software aspects of the Flight Control System equipment as a Verification Engineer * Write and execute system functional verification testing in an integrated lab environment * Develop tools that are used by engineering for fleet reliability data analysis and system troubleshooting * Support troubleshooting of in\-service issues impacting component reliability * Interact with suppliers during development, certification, and root cause corrective action **Education and Experience Requirements** ----------------------------------------- Bachelor's Degree Engineering or a related curriculum required or equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job. 18 months related Engineering experience. jobs.description: St. Paul, Minnesota, USA On \- Site As the largest pureplay adhesives company in the world, H.B. Fuller’s (NYSE: FUL) innovative, functional coatings, adhesives and sealants enhance the quality, safety and performance of products people use every day. Founded in 1887, with 2025 revenue of $3\.5 billion, our mission to Connect What Matters is brought to life by more than 7,100 global team members who collaborate with customers across more than 30 market segments in 150 countries to develop highly specified solutions that enable customers to bring world\-changing innovations to their end markets. Learn more at www.hbfuller.com. **What you can expect from H.B. Fuller’s Internship Program:** You’ll be joining a cohort of talented students from a variety of schools across the U.S. We hire interns in the following positions: Process Engineering, R\&D, Strategic Sourcing, Technical Sales, Supply Chain, Product Marketing, Information Technology, and more. The projects we task our interns to lead are impactful and meaningful to our organization. You’ll be supported by your Manager and Mentor to gain in\-depth knowledge of the adhesive industry and collaborate with various departments and functions. We also offer an established path for next\-level opportunities – making this internship the starting point for a long\-term career path. Location: **Saint Paul, Minnesota** Department: **Research \& Development** Our **Internship Experience** includes: * 12\-week paid program beginning the end of May to mid\-August to gain insight and knowledge in your field. * Interactive orientation and events with skilled professionals in your field, including managers, directors, and CEO. * Multiple networking, volunteer and fun events – both virtual and in\-person. * Impactful projects that make a difference internally and externally for H.B. Fuller. * End of summer final presentation to showcase your career development with support from managers and peers. **Position Overview:** The R\&D (Materials Data) Intern will work at the intersection of machine learning, chemistry, and polymer science to accelerate the development of next\-generation products within the adhesives market. This role will focus on developing AI and machine learning workflows that enable scientists to make data\-driven formulation and materials design decisions. The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in chemistry, polymer science, or materials science and has demonstrated experience applying machine learning and data science techniques to scientific problems. This position is particularly well suited for students interested in careers at the intersection of computational science, AI, and materials innovation. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Collaborate with R\&D scientists to collect, curate, and structure experimental data for machine learning applications. * Develop and validate interpretable machine learning models to predict critical material and formulation properties. * Analyze model outputs to identify meaningful structure\-property relationships and generate scientific insights. * Apply machine learning techniques to propose novel formulations and candidate materials meeting targeted performance requirements. * Develop workflows for data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and model evaluation. * Build automated data pipelines that integrate historical data sources and laboratory\-generated datasets. * Communicate technical findings and recommendations to multidisciplinary teams of scientists and engineers. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Materials Science \& Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, or a related scientific discipline. * Demonstrated proficiency in Python and common scientific computing libraries, including Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn, and PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including model development, validation, and interpretation. * Strong theoretical understanding of chemistry, polymer science, or materials science principles. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary scientific teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Double major, minor, or significant coursework in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. * Research experience involving machine learning, computational chemistry, materials informatics, polymer science, or related disciplines. * Experience working with molecular, materials, chemical, or formulation datasets. * Familiarity with feature engineering, dimensionality reduction, optimization methods, or generative AI approaches for scientific applications. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, and geographic location. The salary for this role is $22\-$25 per hour. In addition to your salary, H.B. Fuller offers employees a competitive total rewards package including comprehensive benefits, incentive and recognitions programs, health \& wellness benefits, 401K contributions, paid time off and paid holidays. jobs.title: Technical Inside Sales and Account Manager - Industrial Distribution (Fluid Power / Pneumatics)
jobs.description: You're the technical one. But you've spent years quoting and supporting other people's accounts, and nobody's ever handed you the keys. We're offering you the keys. **WHO WE ARE** HJ Kirby is a third\-generation, 60\-year\-old industrial company near Cleveland — on a mission to make American OEMs better at what they build. We design custom pressure gauges and supply the fittings, tubing, valves, and air\-prep that make our customers' equipment work: pressure, flow, pneumatic, hydraulic. We're small. We move fast and we’re using AI aggressively to punch above our weight. And we genuinely enjoy the work. We're looking for one sharp, mechanically\-minded technical person to help us build what's next. **THE ONE THING YOU MUST BRING** Real mechanical and technical understanding. You need to genuinely get how physical systems and components work — how a valve, a gauge, a regulator, or a pneumatic/hydraulic circuit actually functions. You can read a drawing and a datasheet. We can teach you our catalog. We can't teach you how to think mechanically. If that's your strength, keep reading — this was written for you. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** * Become the trusted technical go\-to for our key accounts — the person customers call when they need to solve a pressure, flow, pneumatic, or hydraulic problem. * Own the quoting, pricing, and margins for your book of accounts. * Grow those accounts the right way — by being excellent to work with, not by being pushy. * Build AI\-powered workflows alongside the owner to make all of it faster and smarter. * Over time, run these relationships end\-to\-end — with a real path to lead sales as we grow. **THIS IS FOR YOU IF…** * You're mechanically curious and you love figuring out how things work. * You're the detail person who catches the error before the customer does. * You can say "I don't know — but I'll find out," and mean it. * You understand (or can learn fast) pneumatic and hydraulic systems, valves, gauges, regulators, fittings, tubing, and instrumentation. * You can talk to engineers and maintenance managers without blinking. * You've been doing great work in inside sales, applications, technical support, field service, or quoting — and you're ready for the ownership nobody's given you yet. **WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR** (we mean this) * Road warriors. This isn't a suitcase job. * Commission chasers who need a giant quota plan to get out of bed. * Slick salespeople with no mechanical substance — polish doesn't help if you can't talk shop with an engineer. * Pure engineers who'd honestly rather not talk to a customer. If that's you — no hard feelings. This just isn't your seat. **WHAT YOU'LL GET** * Real ownership of real accounts. Your fingerprints on the whole business. * A solid base of $65,000–$85,000 (depending on experience) plus uncapped upside tied to doing the job well — not to squeezing customers. * Autonomy to work how and where you work best, once you're ramped. * A front\-row seat to — and a hand in building — how the company puts AI to work.. * The owner in your corner, not on your back. **BACKGROUNDS THAT TEND TO FIT** Inside sales, technical sales, applications engineering, sales support, field service, or customer\-service/quoting roles at a distributor or manufacturer in fluid power, pneumatics, hydraulics, instrumentation, or industrial components — the kind of place that sells valves, fittings, tubing, gauges, or transducers. A hands\-on mechanical background (field service, maintenance, technical school, or just building and fixing things) is a real plus. Fluid\-power certifications (CFPS, CFPPS, and the like) are a bonus, never a requirement. If you've got the mechanical instinct and the curiosity, we'll teach you our catalog. Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Cell phone reimbursement * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Westlake, OH 44145

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **https://haccretion.com** **Haccretion** is building a connected real estate ecosystem designed to bring property discovery, property data, professional identity, social networking, communication, brokerage operations, transaction infrastructure and eventually financial services into one network. We're hiring a **Founding Software Engineer** to help turn that architecture into a platform capable of operating at scale. **Compensation: $150,000/year** This is not intended to be a conventional software engineering position. The engineers joining Haccretion at this stage will work directly on the foundational architecture of the platform and will have an opportunity to grow with the technical organization they help create. As Haccretion expands its engineering organization, exceptional early engineers may progress into **Lead, Director, VP of Engineering, or other senior technical leadership positions**, potentially overseeing major areas of the Haccretion platform. We are looking for people who want to **build the system—and potentially help lead the organization that grows around it.** What You're Building Haccretion approaches real estate as a network rather than a collection of disconnected products. The platform is being designed around several interconnected systems: **Property Graph** — Persistent digital identities for real estate, connecting property information, history, listings, ownership relationships and market activity. **Social Graph** — Persistent identities and relationships connecting buyers, sellers, property owners, agents, brokers, lenders, investors and service professionals. **Marketplace** — Property discovery across residential, commercial, land and other real estate categories. **Communication** — Messaging and interaction between consumers, professionals and businesses within the real estate environment. **Transaction Infrastructure** — The systems connecting discovery, professional relationships, brokerage activity, documents and ultimately transactions. **Haccretion AI** — Intelligence operating across property, social and transaction data to support search, matching, automation, market intelligence and future platform capabilities. The long\-term objective is straightforward: **Everything real estate. Connected.** What You'll Do You will work directly with Haccretion's founder and future engineering team to translate the existing product architecture into scalable production infrastructure. Your responsibilities may include designing and developing core platform services; rebuilding and scaling existing functionality; developing APIs and data architecture; building property, identity and relationship systems; creating marketplace and search infrastructure; developing messaging, notifications and social functionality; integrating external property and business data; developing transaction\-oriented systems; establishing engineering standards and infrastructure; and helping recruit and mentor additional engineers as the organization grows. This position will have substantial influence over technical decisions made during Haccretion's foundational engineering stage. The Leadership Opportunity We're deliberately recruiting engineers before building a traditional hierarchy around them. That creates an unusual opportunity. Someone joining an established technology company inherits systems, organizational structures and engineering decisions made years earlier. A Founding Software Engineer at Haccretion will help make those decisions. As the company scales, we expect the engineering organization to divide into specialized areas such as: **Platform Engineering · Property \& Data Infrastructure · Marketplace · Social \& Identity · Transactions · AI \& Intelligence · Mobile · Infrastructure \& Reliability** Early engineers who demonstrate the technical ability and leadership required to own these systems will be natural candidates for senior leadership as those divisions develop. **The people who help build the foundation should have the opportunity to help lead what gets built on top of it.** Who We're Looking For We're looking for engineers who are comfortable with ambiguity, large systems and ambitious technical problems. Strong candidates will have experience in several of the following areas: full\-stack software engineering, backend systems, modern frontend frameworks, API architecture, relational and/or graph\-oriented data systems, cloud infrastructure, search systems, geospatial applications, scalable consumer platforms, real\-time communication, security, AI/ML integration or high\-volume data systems. Real estate experience is **not required**. The ability to understand complicated systems and build reliable software is substantially more important. Compensation \& Long\-Term Opportunity **Base Salary: $150,000/year** This role is being recruited as part of Haccretion's broader company\-building and financing strategy. Haccretion's founder is allocating **20% of company equity to the employee compensation pool** as the company builds its foundational team alongside its current **$20 million funding round**. Individual equity awards, vesting, role scope and other compensation terms would be established separately as part of an employment offer and should not be inferred from the size of the overall employee pool. The objective is to create meaningful alignment between Haccretion and the people responsible for building its long\-term infrastructure. Why Join at This Stage? Because the engineering organization isn't finished. Neither is the architecture. You're not being hired to maintain somebody else's mature product. You're being hired to help **build Haccretion's technical foundation, establish how the platform scales, and potentially become one of the people responsible for leading that infrastructure as the company grows.** Pay: $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Sr Red Hat/UniVerse Administrator
jobs.description: Hajoca Corporation is one of the country’s largest privately\-held wholesale distributors of plumbing, heating \& cooling, and industrial supplies. Founded in 1858, Hajoca is a company based on the principles of “Service, Integrity, Reliability,” and on relationships of trust and support with teammates, customers, and suppliers. Throughout its history, Hajoca has played an active role in shaping advances in plumbing. However, we attribute our success to two simple truths; a unique business philosophy and talented people. Hajoca is all about the people, who give us our advantage, and who will guide us successfully into the future. Hajoca has over 400 locations nationwide, called Profit Centers; and at the foundation of our family of businesses is a National Support Center (NSC) where Centers of Excellence are dedicated to enabling the success of our Profit Centers. The Infrastructure Operations team in our National Support Center (NSC) is looking for a Sr Red Hat/UniVerse Administrator at their Lafayette Hill, PA office. This position is remote. Do you have deep, hands\-on experience administering Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Rocket UniVerse or another MultiValue database? Do you enjoy tuning, securing, and troubleshooting the infrastructure supporting a mission\-critical ERP platform? Are you excited by the opportunity to own the SQL replication pipeline connecting Eclipse operational data to enterprise reporting and analytics? If so, then we’d like you to join our dedicated team as a Senior Red Hat / UniVerse Administrator. **About the Role:** The Senior Red Hat / UniVerse Administrator is the senior technical owner of the platform that Hajoca’s Epicor Eclipse ERP runs on — the Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) operating environment, the Rocket UniVerse MultiValue database beneath Eclipse, and the near real time SQL replication layer that feeds the enterprise data warehouse and business intelligence. This role keeps a mission critical, 24×7 distribution platform stable, secure, high performing, and highly available across production and non production environments, while ensuring that operational Eclipse data flows accurately and continuously into SQL Server for reporting and analytics. The ideal candidate blends deep Linux systems administration with hands on MultiValue database expertise and a strong data integration mindset — someone who can tune the OS and the UniVerse database, work fluently within the Eclipse ecosystem, and own the replication pipeline that turns nested MultiValue records into clean relational data for Power BI, SSRS, and Excel. **In this role, you will:** Own Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Administration * Install, configure, patch, and upgrade RHEL servers (physical and virtual) that host the Eclipse/UniVerse environment, keeping the estate on current, supported releases. * Tune the kernel, filesystems (LVM/XFS), memory, and CPU for MultiValue database workloads and heavy transactional I/O. * Automate provisioning, patching, and configuration management with Red Hat Satellite and Bash scripting to drive consistency and reduce manual effort. * Monitor system health, forecast capacity, and proactively tune performance to sustain availability targets. * Administer users, groups, permissions, SSH, sudo/PAM, and OS hardening in line with security policy. * Manage, networking (interface bonding, firewalld, DNS, NTP), systemd services, logging, and scheduled jobs. Own Rocket UniVerse / MultiValue Database Administration * Administer Rocket UniVerse (U2\) MultiValue database instances underpinning Epicor Eclipse — including accounts, files, file sizing/resizing, hashing, and record/group locks. * Diagnose and resolve locking, contention, and session issues; tune uvconfig, phantom processes, and shared memory parameters for optimal throughput. * Perform backups, transaction logging, and point in time recovery; validate restore procedures on a regular cadence. * Apply MultiValue performance monitoring (e.g., Rocket MVX: Performance) to track sessions, locks, host resources, and replication health. * Use RetrieVe/UniQuery and read UniVerse BASIC to investigate data issues and support reporting. * Maintain UniVerse licensing, TLS transport encryption, and data at rest encryption; open and manage support cases with Rocket Software or the VAR. Own Epicor Eclipse SQL Replication \& Maintain the Data Warehouse * Own the Epicor Eclipse SQL Replication engine that provides near real time replication of core Eclipse UniVerse (MultiValue) database files directly into a structured SQL Server data warehouse environment. * Configure, schedule, and continuously monitor replication so operational transactional data syncs into SQL tables with acceptable latency and completeness. * Manage the mapping and transformation that flattens nested multi value fields — such as multiple order lines within a single record — into standard relational rows and columns. * Administer the Information Control Engine (ICE) inte parable MultiValue based distribution ERP) sufficient to support the underlying database and data pipeline — Eclipse application administration is owned by a separate partner role. * Possess a working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and of data replication / ETL concepts. * Be proficient in Bash scripting and automation with Ansible. * Possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills and the ability to react quickly and decisively during incidents. * Have virtualization (VMware) and enterprise storage (SAN/NAS) experience. * Be available for after hours maintenance windows and shared on call support. * Have direct experience with Epicor Eclipse SQL Replication and the Information Control Engine (ICE). * Possess reporting/BI integration experience with Power BI, SSRS, and Excel against a replicated SQL data warehouse. * Have a background in wholesale distribution or another multi site, high transaction environment. a background in wholesale distribution or another multi site, high transaction environment. * Be familiar with UniVerse BASIC and comfortable reading and adjusting existing MultiValue code. * Have experience coordinating vendor support relationships (Epicor, Rocket Software, and VARs). * Have experience with Rubrik Data Protection for management of backups, recovery, and vulnerability scanning. * Have experience with Zerto Continuous Data Protection. * Demonstrate strong functional knowledge; take ownership of skills, knowledge, and relationships needed to perform the job. * Be professional, organized, and able to manage work, time, and problems. * Be results oriented; focused on attaining goals and objectives. * Have a keen ability to interpret technical problems and systematically troubleshoot and resolve. **The benefits of working with us:** Our culture is well\-suited for exceptional people who use their talents to drive business and want to share in the financial success their efforts yield. In addition to a competitive starting wage, we offer a Profit\-Sharing Program that provides each team member with an opportunity to earn a direct share of the profits on an annual basis. In addition to our generous compensation package, Hajoca also offers: Full\-time benefits (for team members working 30 or more hours per week): * Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage * Accident, Hospital Indemnity, and critical care coverage * Life insurance and Long Term Disability * Pre\-tax accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuter benefits * Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time (sick time also offered to PT team members as required by state law) * Paid pregnancy and parental leave * Paid day of community service **Full\-time and part\-time benefits:** * 401(k) * Retirement cash account with company contributions * Targeted training programs focused on your personal and professional growth * Company wellness program * Employee discounts * College tuition benefits * Please note that benefit offerings may differ for teammates employed through an intern program. EEOC Statement Hajoca Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer (Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected category pursuant to federal, state or local laws and will not be discriminated against on the basis of any such categories/status. Hajoca is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities including, but not limited to, during the application process. Please let us know if you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability. Background Screening Statement We are a drug free workplace. Employment is contingent upon pre\-employment drug screening, and successful completion of a criminal background investigation subject to any federal, state and local laws.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Automated Testing
jobs.description: Handi Quilter is a worldwide leader in longarm quilting machines and accessories. We develop innovative products that help quilters create their best work, and we are committed to high\-quality products, responsive service, and a collaborative work environment. Handi Quilter is looking for a software engineer to help us improve the reliability of software for our longarm quilting machines. This position is focused on writing automated tests for Windows applications built with C\# and .NET. You will work directly with our software, mechanical, electrical, product, and support teams. Because our software controls and communicates with physical equipment, you will work on\-site with your manager for the first few weeks while learning our products, systems, and development process. After the initial training period, our team generally works in the office three days per week. Work\-from\-home flexibility is based on demonstrated performance, independence, and the needs of the team and project. We are looking for someone who manages their work responsibly, communicates proactively, and does not require close supervision. **What Matters Most** In order of importance, we are looking for someone with: 1\. Experience writing and maintaining automated software tests. 2\. Strong C\# and .NET programming skills. 3\. The ability to investigate failures, find root causes, and communicate results clearly. 4\. An understanding of practical software\-testing methods and how testing fits into product development. 5\. The ability to mentor manual testers and recommend practical improvements to our testing processes. **What You Will Do** * Build and maintain automated tests for our Windows software using C\#, .NET, and MSTest. * Use Selenium for user\-interface testing where appropriate. Prior Selenium experience is helpful but not required. * Run tests in our build and release process, investigate failures, and clearly document defects and root causes. * Work with developers to improve testability, test coverage, and release quality. * Test software with Handi Quilter machines and related hardware. * Mentor manual testers and recommend practical improvements to our testing processes. **Required Qualifications** * Experience writing production or test code in C\# and .NET. for Microsoft Windows applications or services. * Experience creating automated tests with MSTest, NUnit, xUnit, or a similar framework. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills. * Working knowledge of Git or another version\-control system. * Ability to collaborate with software engineers and other technical teams. * Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and communicate progress without close supervision. * Ability to explain technical problems clearly in writing and conversation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Formal education, coursework, certification, or professional training in software testing or quality engineering. * Experience integrating automated tests into Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or another CI/CD system. * Experience with Selenium or another user\-interface automation tool is helpful but not required. * Experience testing software that communicates with machines, electronics, or other hardware. * Working knowledge of C\+\+. * Familiarity with WPF desktop applications. * Experience working in an Agile development environment. * A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer III
jobs.description: Job Summary Under the direction of the Director of Automation, Robotic Controls Engineer III serves as a senior technical resource for the design, programming, integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting of robotic and automated manufacturing systems. This position leads complex automation projects, develops robotics and controls standards, mentors engineering and technical personnel, and supports strategic automation initiatives across manufacturing operations. The role applies advanced knowledge of industrial robotics, PLCs, machine vision, safety systems, and controls architecture to improve safety, quality, productivity, equipment reliability, and reduce the Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ). This will be achieved while maintaining HellermannTyton's Quality and EHS certifications by supporting all corporate policies, procedures, work instructions, and required documentation. Essential Functions * Lead complex robotic, PLC, HMI, and machine vision integration projects. * Lead equipment testing, commissioning, startup, validation, and production readiness activities. * Troubleshoot and resolve advanced robotics, controls, electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, and manufacturing automation issues. * Develop, maintain, and improve technical standards, documentation, and work instructions. * Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, productivity, equipment reliability, and COPQ reduction. * Develop and implement automation solutions that improve process capability, reduce scrap and rework, and minimize the Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ). * Provide technical leadership to engineering, maintenance, quality, production, suppliers, and project teams. Other Functions * Establish robotics and controls engineering standards for all North American facilities. * Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex Robotic issues. * Assist Director of Automation in evaluating and selecting new robotics and automation technologies * Mentor Robotics \& Controls Engineers I and II. * Lead machine vision, safety, controls, and industrial networking integration activities. * Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for complex automation\-related issues. * Lead or support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). * Lead automation equipment installation, modification, and production startup activities. * Train and mentor assigned personnel on robotic and automated equipment. * Identify and lead opportunities to reduce scrap, rework, downtime, and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ). * Develop engineering standards, work instructions, and technical documentation. * Travel as required to support automation projects and manufacturing operations. Success on this role will require * Advanced understanding of industrial robotics, robotic programming, and automation systems. * Advanced knowledge of PLCs, HMIs, controls architecture, and industrial control systems. * Ability to lead troubleshooting of complex electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, and automation\-related issues. * Advanced understanding of machine vision systems, sensors, industrial networking, and controls integration. * Ability to create, review, and approve electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering documentation. * Advanced knowledge of machine safety principles, safe work practices, and equipment validation requirements. * Experience leading equipment commissioning, startup, validation, and production support. * Advanced knowledge of root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies. * Ability to lead continuous improvement efforts focused on scrap, rework, downtime, and COPQ reduction. * Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, SolidWorks/CAD, and common engineering software applications. What You'll Bring * Bachelor's degree in Robotics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related technical field. In lieu of a degree, candidates with 7\+ years of relevant experience in robotics, automation, controls engineering, or a related field will be considered. * Degreed Candidates should have 5\+ years of experience in robotics, controls, manufacturing, or automation environments. * Advanced knowledge of industrial robotics, PLCs, HMIs, machine vision, and automated manufacturing systems. * Ability to read, interpret, update, and approve electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and technical documentation. * Advanced analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead cross functional technical teams. * Advanced proficiency with SolidWorks/CAD and applicable engineering software. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, lead technical deliverables, and support project execution in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Willingness to travel as required to support automation projects, equipment installations, and startup activities. * Commitment to supporting safety, quality, continuous improvement, and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) reduction initiatives. \#LI\-Onsite \#LI\-KN1 By applying for a position with HellermannTyton, you understand that should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check through the use of our 3rd party supplier. Background checks may include some or all of the following based on the nature of the position: SSN/SIN validation, education verification, employment verification, criminal check, driving history, and drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process of which checks are required by the position. Ability to diagnose improper installation \& perform equipment installations * Ability to lift 100 pounds or greater * Must have a valid driver’s license * Welding experience is a plus * Ability to drive a commercial vehicle (pass ODOT physical) * Ability to multi\-task across many different priorities **About Us** We’re known in our industry for making the best commercial food equipment in the Every day, millions of people eat in restaurants operating Henny Penny equipment. We’re a behind\-the\-scenes engine in the world’s most demanding kitchens, including long\-term partners like McDonald’s, Chick\-fil\-A, KFC, and Wendy’s. jobs.title: Travel Demand Modeler (Mid- to Senior-Level)
jobs.description: **Career Opportunities** ======================== **Benefits of Working at Hexagon** ---------------------------------- We are a transportation consulting firm with Bay Area offices in San Jose, Gilroy, and Pleasanton. We provide services in all major aspects of transportation planning and engineering. Hexagon offers competitive salaries and a full range of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401K, bonuses, flexible work schedules, and company\-sponsored events such as holiday parties, summer picnic, and other fun events. Perhaps our best benefit is that we are a small firm, and as such, can find creative ways to fill the needs of our employees. We offer unlimited opportunities for employees to advance from Entry level positions all the way up to Partner level. We have a number of highly skilled and knowledgeable Senior and Principal level professionals with whom you will have the opportunity to work and learn. **Available Positions** ======================= Travel Demand Modeler (Mid\- to Senior\-Level) **Location:** San Jose, CA \| Hybrid Work Environment \| Mid\- to Senior\-Level **Position Overview:** We are seeking an experienced Travel Demand Modeler to join our growing team! Hexagon’s modeling practice is widely respected within the Bay Area and the surrounding counties. We have helped many cities develop their citywide models and use these models for long range planning projects. We have also been conducting model runs for over 20 years on the BART project! This role involves developing, calibrating, and applying travel demand models to support a wide range of transportation planning projects. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills, excellent analytical abilities, and the communication capacity to translate complex modeling results into actionable insights for clients. **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop, calibrate, and validate travel demand models using industry\-standard software platforms (e.g., CUBE, TransCAD) * Utilize travel demand models to support a variety of long\-range planning projects requiring VMT, turning volumes or ADT forecasts * Analyze transportation data from multiple sources including traffic counts, transit ridership, household travel surveys, and emerging mobility data * Prepare technical reports, presentations, and visualizations that communicate modeling methodologies and findings to both technical and non\-technical audiences **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Transportation Engineering, Civil Engineering, Urban Planning, or related field * 5\+ years of experience in travel demand modeling (mid\-level) or 8\+ years (senior\-level) * Proficiency with at least one major travel demand modeling software package (CUBE, TransCAD) * Proficiency with at least one major Bay Area model * Experience with statistical analysis and data visualization tools (Python, R, SQL, or similar) **Additional Desirable Qualifications:** * Experience with activity\-based models (e.g., ActivitySim, DaySim) * Knowledge of microsimulation tools and traffic analysis software * Experience with GIS applications and spatial analysis * Professional Engineer (PE) license or AICP certification * Published research or conference presentations in transportation modeling **What We Offer:** * Opportunities for promotion to leadership roles * Competitive salary commensurate with experience * Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching * Professional development opportunities and support for continuing education * Flexible work arrangements including hybrid remote work options * Opportunities to work on diverse, high\-impact projects **How to Apply:** Please submit your resume and cover letter to info@hextrans.com.

jobs.description: **Title: Enterprise Support Engineer** Location: Alpharetta, GA \& Dallas, TX \- Hybrid Duration: Contract To Hire The Enterprise Support Engineer II plays a critical role in supporting the organization’s enterprise technology environment and ensuring a high level of service for internal teams and clients. jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY: While upholding Hoyt’s Policies and Mission and Values Statement, the Junior Buyer is responsible for procurement of supplies, materials, and services for Hoyt to provide optimum value for the company. I – ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: *Responsible for ordering and timely delivery of products and services:*Uses forecast generated from Production planning to create Purchase Orders for inventoried items based on requirements. Places orders with suppliers, confirms/negotiates pricing and delivery, and enters the purchase orders into Manage 2000\. Reviews delivery dates of all open purchase orders and communicates with suppliers to ensure materials are received when needed. Works closely with Accounts Payable and Receiving departments to research and resolve quantity and/or pricing discrepancies on invoices. Production support: Supports the production floor with its immediate materials needs. Determines action/s required and acts accordingly. Actions might include expediting parts, locating parts in house, counting inventory, identifying / resolving root cause. Negotiates pricing, freight terms and credit terms with suppliers. Works closely with Supplier’s to ensure the proper amount of inventory is being ordered. Adjusts inventory levels up and down with seasonality trends and forecast requirements to ensure the proper amount of inventory. Works closely with suppliers to understand and reduce lead times. Review requisitions, place purchase orders for all non\-inventory needs. Works closely with Engineering during new product design and implementation. Recommends current suppliers or sources new suppliers for materials for the new product year or for mid\-year changes. As new technologies are introduced and become available, forwards information to Engineering for consideration. Works with engineers and suppliers to solve problems that arise concerning parts. Attends regular meetings and communicates frequently with Inventory, Production, Quality, Accounting, and Engineering. Participates in project teams as assigned. ***Hoyt Management System:*** Works with the Purchasing Manager to communicate and resolve supplier quality alerts. With the assistance of suppliers, develops cause analysis and preventative actions plans. **Additional Responsibilities:** Responsible for general housekeeping of their desk; works all scheduled hours; maintains good attendance; adheres to all safety policies, procedures, and rules; adheres to the company’s Tobacco Free policy; and performs other duties as assigned by top management. II – JOB REQUIREMENTS: **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** This position requires: * General knowledge of computers and software packages such as word processing and excel. * Basic knowledge of supply chain management. * Writing skills to be able to properly communicate procedures, memos, contract terms, and quality issues. * Interpersonal skills including the ability to tactfully direct the work of others as well as outside the department and suppliers. * Negotiation skills * Basic math skills. * Critical thinking skills. **Training and Education:***Type of Training* Associates Degree in Business or related field required, B.S. degree preferred. Additional training and professional development through seminars and involvement in a professional association is encouraged. **Required Prior Work Experience:**##### **Type of Experience Length of Experience** Purchasing experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment 1\-3 years array of commodity experience. Note: Management reserves the right to require specific training for this position. However, depending upon the type and the quality of prior work experience, some exchanges can be made between training and experience. III – QUALITY AND COMPETENCY REQUIREMENTS: **Decision Making and Problem Solving:** The Junior Buyer is responsible for investing the company's money to realize the greatest return. This individual recommends and implements strategies to develop and maintain a reliable supplier base capable of meeting Hoyt’s requirements. Problems are solved by considering courses of actions within the framework of management’s goals and standards. **Interaction with Others:** The Junior Buyer regularly interfaces with all levels of personnel throughout the organization. This individual works with suppliers to ensure healthy relationships and to maintain an open line of communication for the discussion of business issues with the suppliers. **Supervisory and Leadership Responsibilities:** This position does not directly supervise others. IV \- WORKING ENVIRONMENT: **Physical environment** **–** **This position spends most of the time in an office environment at a desk with potential exposure to wrist and eye strain from computer use. Some time is spent in the production area with potential exposure to slips and falls and varying temperatures and noise levels.** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ***Mental pressure*** \- This position is a highly stressful one in that there are constant deadlines to meet. There are constant interruptions that can be distracting to work requiring accuracy and concentration.* *Note: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the employer.*

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Features include an onsite cafeteria, open office concept, fitness center, intramural sports activities and clean, state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. The successful candidate will lead the technical development of packaging products working with business development, completing engineering, and subsequent launch into our manufacturing operations. **Role Description:** * System level design with limited guidance, frequently in the absence of specific design standards. * Product Architect * Participate in the formulation and/or evaluation of business cases. * Work within a team of Engineers/Design Specialists in the development of new Injection Molding tooling products following appropriate steps within a formal product development process. * Guide and approve the content of design documents and validation plans. * Contribute to, verify and monitor engineering documentation. * Apply scientific/engineering principles design execution. * Sizing and selection of components (for example, but not limited to linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Provide leadership, mentoring and training to team members. * Create system level concept designs in various levels of detail including function block diagrams, CAD layouts, functional decomposition. * Lead and contribute to design reviews and brainstorming sessions. Responsible for decision making in the context of product definition and architecture. * Participate in or lead continuous improvement activities. * Verify all concept and systems level process steps of the product development process and Product Release process are followed. * Drives the product development process levering team collaboration. * Design risk mitigation including participation or facilitation of FMEA. * Champion of product compliance with regulatory requirements. * Cross discipline interaction and communication including cross discipline inputs – Business Development, Analysis, Electrical, Software, Fluid Power, Metallurgy, Manufacturing, Validation/Test. * Represent Husky technically in front of customers, suppliers and technical partners. * Represent the Innovation and Sustainability department in front of internal customers including the executive. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering **Qualifications and Skills:** * 10 \+ years of design experience in a relevant industry. * Excellent communication (verbal and written) and strong presentation skills. * Specialized knowledge of products, tools, standards, processes and technology. * Specialized knowledge within injection molding, tooling and or plastics processing market. * Skilled in CAD modeling techniques – Unigraphics preferred. * Expert in calculating design parameters and applying engineering principles to design. * Strong time management and organizational skills for maximum efficiency. * Illustrates attention to detail when completing tasks. * Strong problem\-solving skills. * Advanced creativity and innovation skills. * Strong sense of ownership. * Advanced understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes related to injection molding tooling. * A flexible team player. * Demonstrated ability to lead and work both autonomously, and as part of a highly cohesive cross functional team. * Experience selecting appropriate materials and sizing various components. (for example, but not limited to, linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components, etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Well\-rounded – hands\-on mechanical ability and passion for interests and hobbies outside of work. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please. If you need special assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at talent@husky.ca. Equal Opportunity Employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60\-1\.35(c).

jobs.title: Principal Power Delivery Engineer - AI System
jobs.description: **Hyve Company Overview** ------------------------- Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US\-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co\-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time\-to\-market with single\-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co\-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure. Modern AI accelerators demand hundreds to thousands of amps at tightly regulated voltages, making power delivery one of the defining challenges of next\-generation server design. This Principal\-level individual contributor role owns the architecture, design, and validation of power delivery for Hyve's AI and compute server platforms—from 48V/54V input and intermediate bus conversion through point\-of\-load regulation for GPUs, CPUs, and memory. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- * **Power architecture.** Define end\-to\-end power delivery architecture for AI/GPU platforms, including 48V/54V direct conversion, intermediate bus, VRM/PMIC topologies, and point\-of\-load regulation for high\-current rails. * **VR and PDN design.** Design and specify multiphase voltage regulators, select power stages, controllers, inductors, and capacitors, and drive PDN design in partnership with SI/PI and layout teams to meet impedance, transient, and IR\-drop targets. * **Efficiency and telemetry.** Optimize conversion efficiency, thermal footprint, and power density; define power sequencing, telemetry, and protection strategies in coordination with firmware/BMC teams. * **Validation and bring\-up.** Lead power bring\-up and validation across EVT/DVT/PVT, including load\-line, transient, efficiency, and reliability testing; correlate bench results and drive corrective actions. * **Cross\-functional leadership.** Guide board designers, thermal, mechanical, and firmware teams on power\-related trade\-offs, set design methodology, and mentor engineers on power delivery best practices. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** ------------------------------------- * **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * **Experience:** 10\+ years of power delivery / VRM design experience for servers, GPU platforms, or high\-power electronics, with proven delivery of high\-current designs into production. * **Technical expertise:** Deep knowledge of DC/DC conversion, multiphase VR design, 48V/54V architectures, PDN design and analysis, magnetics, and power component selection; experience with power simulation and bench characterization (electronic loads, oscilloscopes, thermal tools). * **Systems knowledge:** Understanding of power sequencing, telemetry, protection, and the interaction of power delivery with thermal, SI, and firmware/BMC domains. * **Communication:** Able to lead trade\-off discussions and clearly present power architecture decisions to technical leaders and customers. Compensation: $ 214,000 to $290,000 **What’s in it for you** ------------------------ Benefit Insurance * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Mental Health Care * 401K with match * Paid Holidays, Vacation \& Sick Days * Tuition Reimbursement * Perks at Work * LEAP Program * MyFlexPay ***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
