jobs.title: Geomatics Engineer I, II, or III
jobs.description: Overview: Responsible for performing a variety of tasks related to the collection, analysis, and presentation of geospatial data for projects such as wind farms, solar power plants, and other renewable energy developments. This position will work under the direction of senior engineers, gradually taking on more responsibility as you gain experience in the industry. **Travel:** This position is open to being remote with up to 25% travel throughout the US. **Company Overview** MasTec Renewables, comprised of Wanzek Construction, IEA Constructors, and White Construction, combines over 20 years of experience in renewable energy construction. Depending on your position and project, you may work for one or more of our companies over your career with us. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News\-Record \[ENR]: \#1 in Power, \#17 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, \#20 Transportation Contractor). We embrace diverse perspectives among our employees and across all levels of our business, including our suppliers, community partners, and clients. We have built a multidimensional workforce that brings valuable differences in perspectives, work ethics, and approaches to our organization. By collaborating across departments, we foster innovation and encourage everyone—from interns to executives—to share their ideas and make an impact. Our goal is to create a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in our industry. The MasTec Renewables market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy \& Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy \& Infrastructure (CE\&I) segment generates over $4\.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do. MasTec, a minority\-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments. Responsibilities: **Essential Job Functions:*** Conduct topographic, boundary, and environmental surveys for sites involved in green energy and sustainable development using GPS, total stations, and other surveying instruments * Process and analyze geospatial data to produce maps, models, and reports that assist in the planning and design of these sites * Assist in the development of 3D models and simulations to optimize site layouts and assess environmental impacts * Ensure compliance with industry standards, environmental regulations, and land use laws relevant to sustainable projects * Collaborate with project teams to integrate geospatial data into planning, construction, and operational phases * Participate in client meetings to provide geospatial insights relevant to site selection, design, and environmental assessments * Continue to develop technical skills through ongoing training, focusing on geospatial applications in sustainable infrastructure projects * Other jobs.title: Game Mathematician II
jobs.description: **Location:** Reno, NV, US, 89521 **\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; } **Requisition ID:** 19541 IGT, where innovation meets entertainment on a global scale! From the casino floor to your mobile screen, we deliver thrilling, responsible, and unforgettable gaming experiences—powered by world‑class content, strong technical and commercial capabilities and nurtured by a culture of collaboration, accountability, and ownership. Whether it’s spinning reels, placing bets, or enabling secure payments, we turn innovation into impact through disciplined execution and long‑term value creation. With a team of over 6,000 employees across 30\+ countries and products delivered in more than 100 jurisdictions worldwide, we operate at scale while staying closely connected to costumers we serve. If you’re ready to bring your talent to a team shaping the future of entertainment, your next big move starts here \- www.igt.com. Overview If you’ve ever wondered what determines how a game feels to play—and why players keep coming back—it starts with the math! We’re hiring a Game Mathematician II to build and refine the systems that drive gameplay, payouts, and player experience across IGT’s portfolio. You’ll be working at the intersection of math, software engineering, and game design—partnering with cross\-functional teams to turn concepts into fully realized games, test how they perform, and fine\-tune the logic behind every outcome. This is a hybrid role based in our Reno, NV studio. What You’ll Do * Design and implement mathematical models and game logic that define gameplay and payouts * Create and maintain PAR sheets, pay tables, and supporting math documentation * Develop tools and models to validate game logic and underlying data * Collaborate with art, audio, engineering, and design teams to align math with player experience * Play\-test games in development and refine math based on simulations, testing, and player feedback * Analyze market performance data to identify trends and inform future game mechanics * Ensure math designs meet jurisdictional requirements and industry standards **What We’re Looking For:** * 2\+ years of experience in mathematical modeling, game math, casino game math, or similar quantitative work * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field * Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and combinatorics * Advanced Excel skills for modeling and analysis * Programming experience or familiarity with Python, Java, C\#, or C\+\+ * Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving ability * Ability to collaborate within a cross\-disciplinary game development team * Curiosity and initiative to explore new ideas and improve gameplay Keys to Success * Building collaborative relationships * Decision making * Drive results * Foster innovation * Personal energy * Self\-leadership \#LI\-CK1 IGT is committed to sustaining a workforce that reflects the diversity of the global customers and communities we serve and to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and engaged. IGT is an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We thank all applicants for their for applying; however, only those selected to interview will be contacted. IGT is the global leader in gaming. For more information, please visit www.igt.com.

Ship the Agent Registry with zero\-trust identity (SPIFFE/SPIRE), the Verizon Agent SDK with pre\-integrated LLMOps/FinOps/guardrails, the MCP Tool Gateway, and an ArgoCD\-managed DevSecOps pipeline with canary deployments and auto\-rollback. * Hitting the SLAs that keep the platform trusted. 99\.9% Gateway uptime, \=2,000ms P95 latency, Mean Time to Agent Deploy reduced from 21 days to \=7 days, 95%\+ Agent \& Registry Compliance. * Driving enterprise consolidation and cost control. Consolidate 8\+ independent BU AI integrations onto one managed gateway, enable real\-time cost attribution, and unlock $500K\+ quarterly optimization savings through intelligent routing. * Onboarding the business. Land 5\+ BU teams on the platform within 6 months, ship Agent Registry GA and SDK v1\.0, and establish the engineering operating cadence with Architecture, Operations, and BU consumers. * Leading the team. Recruit, coach, and grow a team of 3–5 platform engineers; set the engineering bar, review designs, and remove blockers so the team ships. #### **What we’re looking for…** #### **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Technical leadership experience managing software or platform engineers. * Experience running Kubernetes at production scale. * Experience operating in multi\-cloud environments (GCP and AWS). * Experience with AI/ML infrastructure: model serving (vLLM, LLM Gateways, or equivalent), inference optimization, and LLMOps. * Experience building developer platforms — SDKs, CLIs, developer portals, or self\-service onboarding. * Experience with FinOps or cost allocation models (chargeback, budget enforcement, usage attribution). #### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an MBA. * Experience with API gateway patterns: JWT authentication, rate limiting, traffic splitting, circuit breakers, and mTLS * Software or platform engineering experience. * Experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, or similar). * Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent\-to\-Agent) standards. * Experience implementing zero\-trust security (SPIFFE/SPIRE, OPA/Rego). * Experience with CDC pipelines and event\-driven data platforms (BigQuery, Kafka). * Experience delivering platforms in a telecom or large regulated enterprise (CPNI, PCI\-DSS, SOX). * Experience designing Responsible AI guardrails, evaluation pipelines, or model governance. * Experience with observability stacks (Jaeger, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, or BigQuery\-based). * Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect, CKA/CKAD. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. #### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. #### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 #### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. #### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Posted Date 9/08/2026 Description **Overview** Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. **HYBRID** Qualified candidates must live within a **180\-mile radius** of a hub location listed below and should plan to spend time working from home and some time working in the office as part of our hybrid work environment**.** **HUB LOCATIONS: Bloomington, IL; Richardson, TX; Atlanta, GA; or Tempe, AZ** **SPONSORSHIP:** Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity. **Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential** **Responsibilities** We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Availability Analytics and Automation (AAA) teams, working on innovative SRE, automation, and AI/ML solutions. The SRE team helps product teams strengthen application reliability and resiliency through capabilities such as Neighborhood Watch and Resiliency Assessments. The team leverages AWS and ROSA technologies, along with MCP servers and Agentic AI, to build and enhance these solutions. The AAA team develops GenAI\-powered tools that help investigate and troubleshoot production outages and generate ESS summaries, using GenAI Gateway and AIDE APIs to interact with LLMs. In this role, you will collaborate with Lead Software Engineers and Staff Engineers to design and develop solutions for Service Level Objectives (SLOs), observability dashboards, AI\-powered tools and agentic workflows, and automated recovery capabilities.? **Qualifications** * Develops, tests, debugs, documents, maintains, supports applications/components and primarily completes assignments with guidance and direction. * Develops an understanding in programming and is actively developing in a core programming language (e.g. Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, etc.). * Develops an understanding with State Farm compute environments, including but not limited to AWS, ROSA, CaaS, etc. * Develops an understanding with State Farm security, standards and governance. * Handles and resolves basic application and environment problems and issues. * Develop an understanding of the State Farm organizational structure. * Develops understanding of Agile techniques, activities and DevOps methods. * Develops fundamental understanding of insurance and financial services operations and Experience with AWS, ROSA desired, but not required. * Demonstrates strong consulting and problem\-solving skills. * Drives initiatives with a strong focus on achieving measurable outcomes. * Champions the use of Generative AI (e.g., Co\-Pilot) in daily development workflows (coding, documentation, testing, and ideation). * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams and business areas. * Embraces change, adjusts easily to new challenges, and maintains a focus on excellence in outcome delivery.? Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!** * **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * **Develop and Grow!** Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * **Plan Ahead!** Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * **Take a Little “You” Time!** You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * **Give Back!** We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * **Finish Strong!** Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. **Visit our** **State Farm Careers** **page for more information on our** **benefits****,** **locations****, and the** **hiring process** **of joining the State Farm team!** We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Availability Analytics and Automation (AAA) teams, working on innovative SRE, automation, and AI/ML solutions. The SRE team helps product teams strengthen application reliability and resiliency through capabilities such as Neighborhood Watch and Resiliency Assessments. The team leverages AWS and ROSA technologies, along with MCP servers and Agentic AI, to build and enhance these solutions. jobs.description: **PROJECT DESCRIPTION:** DSS has a constant increased need for the provision of full systems life cycle applications development on various computer platforms, including a variety of client eligibility and recertification systems, employment/work engagement services, claims systems, etc., that are critical to the operation and functioning of DSS programs, requiring periodic refinements to maintain the applications at optimum service levels. jobs.title: Mern Stack Developer
jobs.description: We at **Innovecture** are hiring for a **"Mern Stack Developer"** to expand our team, this is in Phoenix, AZ. You will work across various Innovecture and client teams and apply your technical expertise to some of the most complex and challenging technology problems. About **Innovecture**: Founded in 2007 under the leadership of CEO Shreyas Kamat, Innovecture LLC, began as a U.S.\-based Information Technology and Management Consulting Company focusing on technology consulting and services. With international development centers located in Salt Lake City, USA, and Pune, India, Innovecture leverages its Global Agile Delivery Model to effectively deliver client projects within budget scope and project deadline. The primary focus of Innovecture is to provide a unique wealth of expertise and experience to the IT and Management Consulting realm by utilizing various technologies across multiple industry domains. Innovecture uses best\-in\-class design processes and top\-quality talent to ensure the highest quality deliverables. With innovation embedded in its consulting and services approach, Innovecture will continue to deliver outstanding results for its Fortune 500 clients and employees. **Job Description:** Key Candidate Requirements * Strong hands\-on experience with MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. * Enterprise application development and modernization experience. * Understanding of SOA and enterprise application architecture. * Experience developing and integrating REST APIs and microservices. * Familiarity with cross\-cutting concerns including security, authentication/authorization, logging, error handling, monitoring, and resiliency. * Apigee or other API Gateway/API Management experience is beneficial. * Experience with legacy application modernization or migration is strongly preferred. * Comfort working with primarily .NET\-based legacy applications, including understanding existing code, business logic, and architecture. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. * Comfortable leveraging AI\-assisted development tools for code analysis, migration, development, testing, documentation, and engineering productivity. * Proactive, ownership\-oriented candidates who are willing to learn new technologies and business domains.

jobs.title: Silicon SoC Architect
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- The Role and Impact As a Principal Engineer specializing in Silicon SoC Architecture at Intel, you will be at the forefront of designing and driving next\-generation System\-on\-Chip (SoC) architectures that define the future of datacenter and agentic computing. This is a role of strategic importance, where your expertise will shape the technological direction of Intel and influence the industry at large. You will lead the end\-to\-end architecture and development of modular, scalable, and highly optimized SoCs that serve the needs of diverse segments, from high\-performance computing to ultra\-low power solutions. By innovating new architectural approaches and mentoring other technical leaders, you will play a pivotal role in delivering leadership solutions that power the world's most impactful technologies. Key Responsibilities * Define and develop end\-to\-end SoC architectures, including hardware, firmware, and functional specifications, to meet connectivity, configuration, performance, timing, power, and area goals. * Drive the evaluation, integration, and optimization of existing IP blocks into new SoCs, defining gaskets or glue logic as necessary. * Explore and implement novel architectural features for next\-generation products, ensuring the delivery of high\-quality, scalable designs. * Develop, execute, and analyze tests, test plans, and testing infrastructure to validate new architectures and features, using advanced statistics and data analysis to benchmark performance and identify improvements. * Collaborate with architects, design engineers, system engineers, and verification engineers to ensure seamless SoC design and address development constraints. * Review and influence cross\-functional roadmaps, define technology targets, and contribute to the long\-term innovation strategy for future SoCs. * Act as a domain expert, providing technical leadership across the organization and the industry. * Mentor and develop other technical leaders while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence in alignment with Intel's core values. * Deep expertise in SoC architecture development methodologies, system architecture, and microarchitecture. * Proven experience in defining architecture features, registers specifications, and SoC development. * Proficiency in computer architecture fundamentals, CPU architecture, and systems thinking. * Demonstrated ability in problem solving and evaluating feasibility tradeoffs to drive SoC optimization. **Qualifications:** ------------------- Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor's or BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with 12\+ years of experience. OR * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with 8\+ years of experience. OR * PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with 6\+ years of experience. Preferred Qualifications * Demonstrated track record of innovation, including conceptualizing and specifying advanced microarchitectures for future products. * Experience leading cross\-functional teams and contributing to technical strategies. * Strong coaching and mentoring skills to develop leadership within the organization. * Expertise in benchmarking, performance analysis, and advanced statistical modeling. Knowledge of emerging trends and technologies in computing, with a strategic vision for the evolution of SoC architectures. * **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, California, Santa Clara **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- US, California, Folsom, US, Colorado, Fort Collins, US, Massachusetts, Beaver Brook, US, Oregon, Hillsboro, US, Texas, Austin **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- This role is a Position of Trust. Should you accept this position, you must consent to and pass an extended Background Investigation, which includes (subject to country law), extended education, SEC sanctions, and additional criminal and civil checks. For internals, this investigation may or may not be completed prior to starting the position. For additional questions, please contact your Recruiter. **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . jobs.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non\-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions\-driven, passionate change\-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world\-wide for a better future. We aim to make our programs a model for the highest global standards and to cultivate power and lasting change not just for our clients but for all people affected by humanitarian crises. To achieve that vision, the IRC’s Technical Excellence (TE) group, located within the Crisis Response, Recovery and Development (CRRD) Department, provides technical assistance to IRC’s country program staff and shares what we learn to influence policy and practice. IRC’s Technical Excellence team is comprised of seven teams which have deep expertise in their respective fields: Education, Economic Wellbeing, Governance, Health, Violence Prevention and Response, MEAL, and Grants \& Operations. **Monitoring, Evaluation, Technology, Accountability, and Learning at the IRC** The METAL Unit is responsible for supporting CRRD to have a culture of strong data and evidence use through stewardship of the Data \& Performance Ecosystem, and for coordinating successful piloting and uptake of innovative technology solutions. The METAL Unit provides specialized support across four pillars to strengthen program effectiveness, improve decision\-making, and enhance organizational learning: Global MEAL Practice, Technology for Programs, Regional MEAL Support, and CRRD Data \& Analytics. **Job Overview** The Software Developer will be part of the METAL team which is responsible for delivering products that support the collection, management and visualization of KPIs relevant to higher\-level decision\-making for CRRD Programs. The Software Developer will build and support data tools that drive decision\-making across IRC, working with platforms like PowerApps, Power BI, Databricks, and Azure SQL. Specific tasks include data platform development, support, configuration, technical assistance and routing of technical issues, 2nd line help desk support, and participation in setting standards for processes, data quality, data security, and systems configuration. The Software Developer will report to the Technology Development Lead. They will work closely with other developers, QA, Project Manager and the Program Data Systems Product Manager. **Major Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain PowerApps and Power Automate solutions * Support development and rollout of organization\-wide data products in collaboration with METAL and sector experts * Create technical documentation including system diagrams and implementation manuals * Implement and maintain data quality processes and development standards * Ensure compliance with IRC’s data protection, confidentiality, and security policies * Provide Tier\-2 and Tier\-3 technical support, including issue routing and resolution * Collaborate with IT and data engineering teams on systems integration * Review software requirements and translate them into development tasks * Contribute to setting and enforcing standards for processes, data quality, and system configurations * Provide hyper\-support during pilot phases of technology rollouts * Perform other duties as assigned **Key Working Relationships** * Position Reports to: Technology Development Lead * Direct Reports: None * Management in Partnership: None **Key Internal Relationships:** * METAL Product Managers * METAL QA Analyst * METAL Project Manager * IT Data Team **Desired Experience and Skills** * At least five years of experience working in technology domain to develop and rollout data platforms for programs – out of which, at least three years of experience developing, implementing, and supporting PowerApps applications for large and complex programs. * Experience in source code and version control platforms, for example, GitHub, Azure DevOps, or similar. * Strong in team development processes including pair programming, shadow sessions, code reviews and other strategies to ensure high quality programing. * Strong code quality assurance practices including unit testing, integration testing, as well as regression testing to ensure quality of the code getting shipped into production. * Ability to effectively communicate in English both in verbal (i.e., day\-to\-day discussions, team meetings) and written (requirements and design jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI-Native Developer Platform
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit's 8,000\+ developers build products that power the financial lives of hundreds of millions of people. PDX — Platform Developer Experience is the team that makes those developers faster, safer, and more effective. Our north star is 3x Developer Velocity: measurably tripling the speed at which developers move from idea to production — not through incremental tooling improvements, but through a fundamental shift to AI\-native, Done\-For\-You platform experiences. We're looking for a Staff PM who can operate at the intersection of strategy and execution across multiple platform layers simultaneously — infrastructure, operational intelligence, developer tooling, and production reliability. You won't just define what gets built. You'll shape how PDX thinks about AI\-native platform design, define the measurement frameworks that show up in company\-wide goal reporting, and move 8,000 developers faster by changing the platform beneath them. This role sits at the frontier of how enterprise developer platforms are evolving: from infrastructure teams that ship APIs, to intelligence teams that ship AI\-native experiences directly in developer workflows. If that transition excites you, read on. Why This Role Is Exciting * You'll operate across multiple platform layers simultaneously — infrastructure, data intelligence, developer tooling — each with different users, adoption motions, and success metrics * You must drive adoption without mandate across 8,000\+ developers and dozens of platform teams * You're defining new interaction models (natural language interfaces, MCP\-based tooling, agentic workflows) — not iterating on existing ones * Success requires changing developer behavior at scale, not just shipping features * You'll own measurement frameworks that directly feed executive\-level goal reporting — the numbers have to be right, and the story has to be clear The 3x Developer Velocity Mission 3x is not a slogan — it's a design constraint. Every platform capability PDX builds is evaluated against one question: does this meaningfully reduce time spent on toil across the developer lifecycle? As Staff PM, you will own the measurement framework that makes 3x visible and credible: * Inner Loop: Lead Time to Change, PR Merge Velocity, Coding Start Time * Outer Loop: Deploy Time, Incident Resolution, Infrastructure Config Time * RDR Loop: Change Failure Rate, MTTR, Agent\-Driven Proficiency * Your products should move these numbers. Your dashboards should prove it. What You'll Own This role will focus on one or two of the following areas based on candidate strengths and business priorities, while influencing the broader PDX ecosystem as a Staff\-level contributor. * ODL Intelligence — Unlocking Intuit's Operational Data Lake (Key Strategic Investment) Transform Intuit's Operational Data Lake from a resource accessible only to SQL experts into an AI\-native, self\-serve intelligence platform — where any PM, TPM, developer, or engineering leader gets operational insights in seconds using natural language. Own the product strategy across five pillars: DFY Ingestion, Data Catalog \& Consumption, AI/ML Enablement, Mid\-Market Readiness, and Scalable Governance. Drive MCP server integration, semantic catalogs, and natural language\-to\-Athena SQL interfaces. This is one of the highest\-leverage intelligence bets in PDX — unlocking Dev360, FinOps, GenAI, and operational decision\-making across the company. * AI\-Native Developer Tooling \& MCP Ecosystem Define and launch MCP servers that bring platform capabilities — cloud provisioning, load testing, chaos injection, metric queries, DR orchestration — directly into developer IDEs, eliminating context switching entirely. Own Intuit's MCP Marketplace strategy, drive adoption across Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf, and grow the innersource skills ecosystem that accelerates AI adoption across the PM and engineering community. * Cloud Abstraction \& Network Infrastructure Own the shift from IaC\-heavy provisioning to platform\-managed, IDE\-first developer experiences — where infrastructure is described, not configured. Drive Done\-For\-You cloud abstraction, self\-serve VPC management, IPv6 readiness, and compliance\-by\-default guardrails (PCI\-DSS, SOX, SOC2\). Target outcomes: 70%\+ reduction in provisioning time, elimination of manual CloudOps toil, and a foundation for agentic cloud operations. * Production Reliability — DR, Chaos \& Performance Own the platform's proactive reliability posture across three interconnected areas: enterprise\-scale DR orchestration (multi\-workload failover, AI\-generated recovery procedures), chaos engineering (Smart FMEA, CI/CD\-integrated chaos stages, shift\-left resiliency enforcement), and performance engineering (cloud\-native load testing, auto\-generated scripts, IDE\-embedded testing via MCP). Drive the organizational shift from reactive incident response to prevention at code time. Change Management — cutive forums, publish thought leadership internally and externally, and represent PDX's platform vision in the cloud\-native community (CNCF, open source) * Convert **high\-ambiguity charters** into clear strategies, executable roadmaps. **Qualifications** **Technical Skills** * 7\+ years of PM experience in platform products at scale, with hands\-on ownership of distributed systems environments * Working knowledge of public cloud platforms (AWS preferred): VPC architecture, IAM, Kubernetes, service mesh (Istio/Envoy), CI/CD, and compliance frameworks (PCI\-DSS, SOX, SOC2\) * Familiarity with operational data platforms: data lakes, Athena, Redshift, or equivalent — including schema design, query patterns, and access control * Experience with or strong understanding of AI/ML developer tooling: MCP servers, LLM\-powered workflows, agent\-based systems, or IDE\-embedded AI experiences * Awareness of load testing, chaos engineering, DORA metrics, and reliability engineering practices **Product Management Skills** * Track record of shipping platform products with measurable adoption and business impact across large engineering organizations * Ability to define and operationalize company\-wide measurement frameworks for complex, cross\-cutting strategic metrics tied to executive goals with rigor in methodology and clarity in communication * Proven portfolio management: strong say\-do ratio across quarterly planning while balancing feature work, tech refresh, and run\-the\-business commitments Comfortable owning the full product arc: strategy Alpha Beta GA deprecation* successor roadmap **Staff\-Level Leadership** * **Builder mindset:** demonstrated track record of going beyond the PM role — prototyping tools, contributing to innersource repositories, or personally shipping solutions to real developer friction * Operates with systems thinking across interconnected platform domains — seeing how changes in one area create leverage or risk in others * Strong cross\-org influence without authority: proven ability to align engineers, architects, and VPs around a shared platform vision * Exceptional communicator across formats: design critiques, executive roadmap reviews, external blog posts, developer community talks * Deep empathy for the developer experience — you understand what slows developers down across the full PDLC, and you have the conviction and relationships to fix it at the platform level **What Success Looks Like** * **In 6 months:** You've shipped a platform capability that demonstrably reduces developer toil, defined a measurement framework leaders use to make real decisions, and contributed a tool or skill the broader community builds on. * **In 12 months:** You've shaped multi\-year strategy for your focus area, driven measurable progress toward 3x Developer Velocity targets — reduced lead time to production, increased self\-serve provisioning to near 100%, reduced time\-to\-insight from ODL from days to minutes — and influenced the platform philosophy of PDX beyond your direct ownership. * **At the staff level:** You are the PM other PMs come to for how to think about AI\-native platform design. Your measurement frameworks show up in IG\-03, IG\-09, and 3x Velocity reporting. Your products are the ones cited in executive forums as proof of what PDX can deliver. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** In this role, you will report to the Electrical Engineering Manager and serve as a principal technical and project lead for development of electromechanical chassis systems, including steering and driveline products. This position requires a strong understanding of overall software and hardware development processes, practical experience with embedded systems and test environments, and the ability to provide hands\-on technical support when needed. This is a principal role for an engineer who can align project goals, technical tasks, and development resources while also contributing directly to problem solving, testing, and system integration. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Lead complex engineering programs by defining project objectives, managing risks and resources, and coordinating cross\-functional teams to achieve customer and business goals. * Serve as the technical authority for software, electronic hardware, system integration, and control system development, providing guidance on architecture, requirements, technical reviews, and issue resolution. * Lead technical reviews of requirements, specifications, interfaces, drawings, validation plans, and test results, providing recommendations to improve product performance, quality, manufacturability, and development efficiency. * Define and lead verification and validation activities, including planning, traceability, test coverage, and the development of calibration, diagnostic, communication, and test tools to support efficient product development and issue resolution. * Support product launch and production by partnering with manufacturing, quality, and supplier management teams to resolve production issues, implement corrective actions, and improve quality, yield, and process robustness. * Lead and contribute to critical technical activities across product development, integration, validation, and production support, providing hands\-on expertise in problem solving, technical reviews, and issue resolution when required. * Work additional hours, including weekends, when directed by the immediate supervisor or when necessary to complete essential job duties. * Develop and maintain responsive, cooperative relationships with internal and external customers while treating others with dignity, trust, and respect. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but includes project leadership, technical leadership, mentoring, and coordination of cross\-functional engineering activities. **Job Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Strong understanding of electromechanical systems, embedded controls, electrical architectures, vehicle networks, diagnostics, and system integration. * Strong understanding of automotive software and hardware development processes, including requirements management, model\-based development, verification and validation, configuration management, and V\-cycle development. * Ability to apply control theory, system modeling, signal analysis, and closed\-loop control principles to system design, performance evaluation, and problem solving. * Working knowledge of HIL, dynamometer, laboratory, and vehicle test environments, including system integration, instrumentation, test automation, and data acquisition. * Working knowledge of automotive communication protocols and development tools, including CAN/CAN FD, diagnostics, calibration, and measurement systems. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and technical communication skills. **Benefits:** * Medical, Dental, Optical * Supplementary Insurance * Optional Benefits (pet insurance, legal consultation, cyber security, retirement support, mental health services, etc.) * 401K (With match) * HSA contribution * Success Sharing * Paid Time\-Off * Educational Reimbursement **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline required; Master's degree preferred. * Minimum 10 years of experience developing automotive electromechanical systems, preferably steering, braking, chassis, driveline, or other safety\-critical products. * Experience leading complex product development programs from concept through production launch and field support. * Experience with engineering risk assessment and structured problem\-solving methodologies, including FMEA, FTA, 8D, and root\-cause investigation. * Experience using automotive development and validation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape, HIL platforms, calibration tools, and data acquisition systems. * Experience supporting product launch and manufacturing operations, including troubleshooting production issues and implementing corrective actions. * Experience with functional safety and automotive development processes, including ISO 26262, ASPICE, CMMI, or equivalent methodologies, preferred. * Experience applying automation, data analytics, machine learning, or AI\-based tools to improve engineering productivity, testing efficiency, or decision\-making is a plus. **Work Environment:** * Work is mostly performed in a normal office setting with minimal exposure to health or safety hazards, and with substantial time spent working on a computer. * Performing this position may occasionally require exposure to manufacturing areas which require the use of personal protective equipment such as safety glasses with side shields and mandatory hearing protection. * Travel by automobile and plane required approximately 5\-10% of time.

jobs.title: Multidisciplinary Design Technician
jobs.description: Description: **Build the Models That Bring Great Projects to Life** At Jackola, we believe meaningful work happens when talented people come together to solve problems, support one another, and create projects that strengthen our communities. We're looking for a skilled and motivated Design Technician to join our multidisciplinary team in Kalispell, Montana. This is more than a drafting position. It's an opportunity to collaborate with architects, engineers, designers, clients, contractors, and communities to help shape projects that make a lasting impact. From schools and healthcare facilities to commercial developments, hospitality projects, multifamily housing, and community spaces, your work will help transform ideas into reality. If you're someone who enjoys technology, problem\-solving, collaboration, and continuous learning, we'd love to talk with you. **What You'll Do:** As a Design Technician, you'll play an important role in helping project teams deliver high\-quality, coordinated, and efficient design solutions. **Design \& Model Development** You'll help transform project concepts into detailed digital models that support every phase of design and construction. * Provide design and drafting support with Autodesk Revit \& Civil 3D models across architectural, structural, civil, and MEP disciplines. * Create accurate project models, drawings, and documentation. * Support project teams through planning, design, and construction phases. * Maintain organized project files and model standards to ensure consistency and efficiency. **Project Delivery \& Technical Support** You'll work closely with multidisciplinary teams to help projects move from concept to completion. * Collaborate with architects, engineers, designers, contractors, and consultants throughout the design process. * Provide Autodesk Revit technical support to project team members. * Assist with troubleshooting modeling challenges and coordination issues. * Participate in project reviews and coordination meeting * Help teams deliver projects that meet client expectations and project goals. **Quality \& Continuous Improvement** You'll help strengthen the processes and standards that support successful project delivery. * Participate in QA/QC procedures to ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and client requirements. * Contribute to BIM/CAD standards and best practices. * Support company\-wide initiatives focused on efficiency, consistency, and innovation. * Stay current with evolving technologies and industry trends. Requirements: **What We're Looking For:** We're seeking a detail\-oriented and collaborative professional who enjoys both the technical and team\-oriented aspects of design. You may be a great fit if you have: * An Associate's Degree (AA or AAS) in BIM/CAD or a closely related field. * A minimum of two years of Autodesk Revit and/or Civil 3D drafting and design experience in architectural, structural, Civil, or MEP environments. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities. * Excellent communication and problem\-solving abilities. * The ability to work independently while thriving as part of a collaborative team. * A commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement. **Bonus Qualifications:** * Experience working in multidisciplinary design environments. * Familiarity with BIM standards and model coordination workflows. * Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud, Navisworks, or related software platforms. * A passion for helping teams improve design quality and production efficiency. ***WHY JOIN JACKOLA?*** At Jackola, we are committed to supporting our employees both professionally and personally. We believe that when our people have the resources, trust, and encouragement they need to thrive, our projects and communities benefit as well. ***What we offer:*** * Profit Sharing Opportunities that allow employees to share in the company's success. * Professional development and continuing education assistance. * Paid professional registration and licensing fees. * Flexible scheduling, including opportunities for a four\-day workweek. * A comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, and security, including company paid dental, vision, as well as three health plan options. * A collaborative, team\-first culture where your perspective and leadership are valued. **Join Jackola Engineering \& Architecture and help us create places and solutions that matter.**

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Network Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Lead the Way to Intelligent Banking with Us!** You might not think about what happens behind the scenes when you check your bank balance or deposit a check from your phone, but we do. Every day. Kinective empowers banks and credit unions to move beyond keeping up with technology to shaping the future of banking. Our platform seamlessly connects the right tools, delivers real\-time data, and drives smarter operations for more than 4,000 financial institutions nationwide. We are a fast\-growing team built on individual ownership, company\-wide collaboration, and setting industry\-leading standards. Here, new ideas are encouraged, candid feedback is welcomed, and your growth truly matters as much as the company’s. At Kinective, we are leading the way to intelligent banking together and enjoying the journey along the way. **Why This Role Matters** Every role at Kinective exists to move the needle for our clients, partners, and the financial institutions we serve. We are looking for a Senior Cloud Network Engineer at Kinective to own and evolve the networking backbone that powers our products and connects us to our customers. This is a product\-facing role — not internal IT. You will design, build, and operate the cloud and customer\-facing network infrastructure that directly impacts product reliability, security posture, and compliance standing. You will work primarily across AWS with supporting Azure environments, manage VPN tunnel infrastructure for client connectivity, and play an active role in SOC 2 and PCI DSS audit readiness and evidence collection. This role requires someone who thinks in systems, communicates clearly across engineering, security, and customer teams, and takes ownership end\-to\-end. Everything we build is delivered as code — no click\-ops in production. What you’ll own Cloud \& Product Networking * Design and operate network architectures across AWS (primary) and Azure, including VPCs, VNets, and Transit Gateways * Enforce strict network segmentation between production and non\-production environments — separate VPCs/VNets, distinct routing domains, and explicit deny\-by\-default posture * Manage routing, peering, and segmentation across multi\-cloud environments to support product SLAs and security boundaries * Maintain and optimize network performance, availability, and observability across cloud regions * Collaborate with platform and infrastructure engineering teams to integrate networking into CI/CD pipelines and IaC workflows Client VPN \& Secure Connectivity * Design, provision, and maintain IPsec and SSL/TLS VPN tunnels connecting product environments to enterprise clients * Own the full lifecycle of client tunnel onboarding — from technical scoping through cutover and steady\-state support * Serve as the primary technical point of contact during client network onboarding and connectivity incidents; lead customer\-facing troubleshooting calls and produce written RCAs when client connectivity is impaired * Troubleshoot and resolve tunnel stability, latency, and routing issues in coordination with client network teams — including packet capture and side\-by\-side config review * Maintain documentation for all client connectivity configurations, including IP schemas, tunnel parameters, and escalation paths Security \& Compliance * Support SOC 2 (Type II) and PCI DSS audit cycles — collecting network evidence, remediating findings, and responding to auditor requests * Implement and enforce network controls aligned to SOC 2 Common Criteria and PCI DSS network segmentation and firewall requirements * Conduct periodic firewall rule reviews, NACLs/security group audits, and access control assessments * Collaborate with the security team on threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and incident response for network\-layer events * Maintain network diagrams and data flow documentation required for compliance scoping Operations \& Engineering Excellence * All network infrastructure changes are delivered as code — no console changes in production. Author and maintain reusable OpenTofu / Terraform modules for VPCs, VNets, TGW attachments, VPN tunnels, firewall rules, and routing policy. Every change lands via peer\-reviewed PR * Track work, changes, and incidents in JIRA; contribute to clear ticket hygiene and change\-management workflows * Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and runbooks for network health across environments * Participate in on\-call rotation for network\-layer incidents; lead post\-incident reviews for network events * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to architectural decisions and standards Requirements: **Necessary Qualifications \& Competencies** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of hands\-on network engineering experience in cloud\-native or hybrid environments * Deep expertise with AWS networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, Route 53, Security Groups, NACLs, Network Firewall) * Cloud security \& connectivity — hands\-on with AWS IAM (roles, policies, identity federation), SSM (Systems Manager, Session Manager, Parameter Store), GuardDuty, and Security Hub * Working knowledge of Azure networking (VNet, Azure Firewall, NSGs) — we recognize deep expertise in both clouds is rare; strong AWS with willingness to grow in Azure (or vice versa) is acceptable * Proven experience designing and operating IPsec/IKEv2 and SSL VPN tunnels with enterprise clients * Solid understanding of BGP, OSPF, and routing policy in multi\-cloud and hybrid contexts * Hands\-on experience with compliance programs — SOC 2 and/or PCI DSS — specifically network controls and audit evidence * Experience authoring reusable OpenTofu or Terraform modules, not just consuming them * Strong TCP/IP fundamentals: subnetting, DNS, TLS, NAT, load balancing * Hands\-on packet\-level troubleshooting — Wireshark, tcpdump, mtr, iperf, dig * Proficiency with AWS CLI, Azure CLI, Python, Bash/PowerShell, and Docker for automation, tooling, and troubleshooting * Strong written and verbal communication skills — comfortable running technical calls with customer network engineers **Preferred Skills** * Working understanding of modern AI tooling and hands\-on experience with coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate module authoring, troubleshooting, and documentation * Experience with network observability tooling (e.g., VPC Flow Logs, Azure NSG Flow Logs, Datadog, Grafana, Dynatrace) * Familiarity with Nagios or similar network monitoring platforms * Familiarity with zero trust network architecture (ZTNA) principles and implementation * Familiarity with Cisco Meraki and IPS/IDS platforms * DDoS protection and WAF experience — AWS Shield/WAF or Azure Front Door/WAF * Hybrid DNS design across Route 53, Azure Private DNS, and on\-prem resolvers * Exposure to Kubernetes networking (CNI, ingress controllers, service mesh) in multi\-cloud deployments * Financial\-services or regulated\-industry background * Relevant certifications: AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, Azure Network Engineer Associate, CCNP, or equivalent * Experience working within a CI/CD\-driven infrastructure model (Harness, GitHub Actions, or similar) **Pay, Benefits \& Total Rewards** **$160,000–$180,000 with 10% bonus potential** The salary range listed reflects the minimum and maximum for this role. Individual compensation is based on experience, qualifications, job\-related skills, location, and internal equity, and most offers are not made at the top of the range. Base pay is one part of Kinective’s Total Rewards package. Depending on the role, employees may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or equity. All employees have access to a competitive benefits package designed to support health, well\-being, and financial security, including: * Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision, prescriptions, life \& disability) * Flexible PTO, 11 company holidays, and generous parental and caregiver leave * An immediately vested 401(k) with company contributions * Wellness resources and professional development opportunities If you’ve made it this far, we’d love to hear from you. Click Apply to start the conversation, even if you’re not sure you check every box. Learn more about Kinective at www.kinective.io. **Please note that this role does not currently offer sponsorship opportunities. Open to Colorado residents only.**

preferred. * 4\+ years of software engineering or machine learning experience, with a focus on applied AI. * Strong software development skills in Python and experience with libraries like Langchain/Langgraph, Agent SDKs, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy/Alembic, PySpark/Polars/Pandas. * Experience with tracing systems (MLFlow, Sentry), RAG Systems, Memory Systems, MCP Servers, Agent Skills, and jobs.title: Senior Architect
jobs.description: **About Knightscope** Knightscope (NASDAQ: KSCP) is a security technology company building the nation's first Autonomous Security Force — autonomous machines, AI\-driven software, and elite security professionals operating as one integrated managed service. The Company is on a mission to make the United States of America the safest country in the world. One Team. One Force. **Job Summary** Knightscope is looking for a Sr. Architect to lead the design of our AI\-native Signals platform, the real\-time data and intelligence layer that ingests, fuses, and acts on signals from our autonomous machines, sensors, and security operations. This is a hands\-on architecture role responsible for setting the technical direction for a platform that must scale from edge device to cloud with low\-latency, high\-reliability requirements. **About the Role** As Sr. Architect for the Signals platform, you will own the end\-to\-end architecture for how Knightscope's autonomous machines and security devices generate, transmit, process, and surface actionable signals. You'll partner closely with hardware, robotics, ML, and product teams to define data contracts, streaming and event\-driven architecture, and the AI/ML pipelines that turn raw sensor data into real\-time alerts and insights for customers and operators. You will set engineering standards, mentor senior engineers, and make build\-vs\-buy and platform investment decisions that shape the future of autonomous security. **Key Responsibilities** * Define and own the technical architecture for Knightscope's AI\-native Signals platform, from edge sensor/device ingestion through cloud processing and customer\-facing delivery. * Design real\-time, event\-driven, and streaming data pipelines capable of fusing signals from autonomous machines, robots, and IoT devices at scale. * Architect the AI/ML infrastructure and model\-serving layer that turns raw signal data into actionable alerts, insights, and automated responses. * Set platform\-wide standards for data contracts, APIs, observability, security, and reliability across engineering teams. * Partner with Robotics, ML, Product, and Security Operations teams to translate field requirements into scalable platform capabilities. * Evaluate build\-vs\-buy decisions and lead technical due diligence on new platform components and vendors. * Mentor senior and staff engineers, and act as a technical escalation point for the Signals platform. * Drive architectural reviews and ensure the platform meets low\-latency, high\-availability requirements for mission\-critical security use cases. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of software engineering experience with 3\+ years in a lead architect or principal engineer role. * Proven experience architecting large\-scale, real\-time data platforms (streaming, event\-driven, or pub/sub architectures such as Kafka, Kinesis, or Pulsar). * Strong background in AI/ML systems architecture, including model serving, feature pipelines, and MLOps. * Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), and microservices design. * Experience architecting systems that ingest data from IoT, robotics, or edge devices is highly preferred. * Track record of setting technical direction, driving architectural decisions, and mentoring senior engineers. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align cross\-functional stakeholders around a technical roadmap. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Base Salary:** $240,000 – $295,000 (DOE) * **Equity:** Stock options * **Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off * **Location Requirement:** Full\-time, on\-site at Sunnyvale HQ

jobs.title: Network Engineer

Koniag IT Systems LLC, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Network Engineer to support KITS and our government customer in Washington, DC. This position requires daily on\-site work and does not allow Hybrid or Remote work. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits, and tuition reimbursement. **The ideal Network Engineer will:** Support the organization’s networking infrastructure, equipment, software, and design. This role focuses on maintaining, configuring, and troubleshooting network components to ensure the reliability, performance, and security of all network systems. The ideal candidate will be skilled in network documentation, configuration management, and process improvement, with experience supporting enterprise\-scale network environments. **Key Duties and Responsibilities:** * Maintain, configure, and troubleshoot switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless systems. * Document all switching and routing equipment, IP\-addressable devices, and cabling interconnects. * Perform day\-to\-day network maintenance, installation, and configuration activities. * Review and analyze existing network processes, recommending improvements where needed. * Implement approved process improvements and maintain related documentation. * Monitor and analyze network performance, recommending and applying optimization measures. * Support disaster recovery planning and testing for network infrastructure. * Assist in implementing and maintaining network security and firewall configurations. * Conduct quality assurance and quality control checks on network systems. * Stay informed of emerging networking technologies and standards. * Provide data and documentation to support internal and external audits. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience). * 3\+ years of experience supporting and maintaining enterprise networks. **Required Skills and Competencies:** * Strong experience with upgrades/migrations to the Palo Alto platform. * Strong SCCM \& Ivanti – Software deployment, patch management, and endpoint security enforcement. * Proficiency with Layer 2/3 networking, VLANs, VPNs, routing protocols, and subnetting. * Experience with enterprise switches, routers, and firewalls. * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. * Understanding of network documentation and configuration management. * Familiarity with multicast technologies and network monitoring tools. **Desired Skills and Competencies:** * Cisco, Juniper, or similar vendor certifications (e.g., CCNA, CompTIA Network\+). * Experience implementing network automation or scripting. * Working knowledge of cloud networking or SD\-WAN technologies. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. **Security Requirements:** * This position requires a Criminal background check. The company shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, creed, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity (except where gender is a bona fide occupational qualification), national origin or ancestry, age, disability, citizenship, military/veteran status, marital status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. The company is dedicated to seeking all qualified applicants. If you require an accommodation to navigate or apply for a position on our website, please get in touch with Heaven Wood via e\-mail at accommodations@koniag\-gs.com or by calling 703\-488\-9377 to request accommodations. jobs.title: UI Design Associate
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. **The Role** **Your role** As a User Interface Designer, you will shape how people experience digital products by designing clear, intuitive, and visually cohesive interfaces. You will focus on how users move through screens and how visual and interactive elements support that movement. Your work will translate product intent and user needs into tangible interface designs that are usable, accessible, and consistent across platforms. You will balance independent design execution with close collaboration across design and delivery teams to bring interfaces from concept through implementation. **What you will do** * Design end to end user interfaces for digital products, including screens, layouts, components, and interaction states * Create visual and interactive elements that guide users clearly through workflows and tasks * Apply design systems, patterns, and standards to ensure consistency across products and platforms * Translate requirements and user insights into wireframes, high fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes * Collaborate with UX designers, researchers, engineers, and product partners to align interface design with user needs and technical constraints * Review implemented designs to ensure visual and interaction fidelity to approved designs * Iterate designs based on usability findings, feedback, and evolving product requirements **Who You Are** **Required skills and experience** * Experience designing user interfaces for web or digital applications * Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, layout, typography, color, and interaction design * Ability to design at the skeleton and surface levels of the experience * Proficiency with industry standard design and prototyping tools * Experience applying and contributing to design systems and component libraries * Ability to translate requirements into clear, production ready interface designs * Experience collaborating with cross functional teams in a product or delivery environment **Preferred skills and experience** * Experience designing for accessibility and inclusive design standards * Familiarity with usability testing and incorporating findings into interface design * Experience working closely with front end engineers during implementation * Exposure to enterprise or complex digital products The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is \- $63,360 to $114,120based on a full\-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job\-related skills and experience. For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area):$76,080 to $137,040 California (All Other):$69,720 to $125,640 Colorado: $63,360 to $114,120 Massachusetts$63,360 to $125,640 New York City: $76,080 to $137,040 Washington: $69,720 to $125,640 Washington DC:$69,720 to $125,640 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. **Being You** The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
