jobs.title: Full Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- ProductEngineering Overview **You do not need equal depth everywhere. You do need to own the whole result.** At Metaview, full stack does not mean collecting framework keywords. It means one engineer can follow a customer problem across the seams: from the interface to the API, data model, permissions, agent behavior, failure recovery, and production experience. You may be exceptional on one side of the stack. That is useful here. What matters is that you do not treat the other side as someone else’s problem when it stands between you and a great product. **Coding was first. Recruiting is next. We are building it.** ------------------------------------------------------------- Metaview is an applied AI lab building AI coworkers for some of the world’s most ambitious recruiting teams. Hear directly from our customers. The challenge is not another chatbot. It is software that can pursue a hiring objective, act across real workflows, ask for judgment at the right moment, and earn a customer’s trust. Founded by Siadhal Magos and Shahriar Tajbakhsh, who scaled Uber and Palantir, we have raised more than $50M and are growing 5x year over year. AI coding agents are part of the job, not a perk. Engineers routinely run several in parallel for exploration, implementation, and review. We assess both sides of the craft: how well you direct agents and how well you reason, code, and debug on your own. One interview exercise is completed without AI. **Our operating value is velocity** ----------------------------------- Velocity means reducing the time from customer evidence to a reliable product change. It does not mean trading away quality. We ship small changes daily, including Fridays, because the engineer who ships owns production behavior, recovery, and the next revision. Process stays light because customer context and ownership are direct. There is no queue of tickets moving between specialists. You will talk to customers, decide what product primitive solves the problem, build the visible experience and the systems behind it, then stay with the result in production. AI agents help our small team ship roughly 8x more product changes than a year ago. The engineer remains accountable for architecture, review, implementation quality, and production behavior. **What you will build and own** ------------------------------- You will work on problems such as: * building the interface, APIs, data model, permissions, and production behavior of the same customer workflow; * building agents that can pursue recruiting objectives over days, know when to ask for judgment, and recover safely when a model or tool fails; * turning interview and hiring\-team conversations into actions, with interfaces that let recruiters understand, correct, and trust the result; * designing controls and recovery paths for agents acting in customer systems; and * turning repeated product patterns into simple primitives that support many recruiting workflows. In your first 3 to 6 months, you should independently own and ship a bounded customer outcome from problem definition through rollout and iteration. The size of that outcome will reflect your level, but the operating model is the same: make product and technical decisions, contribute the consequential code, and own the production result. **You will probably thrive here if** ------------------------------------ * You have personally shipped software for external users and owned a meaningful outcome from problem definition through production. * You have real depth in at least one technical area and can cross product, frontend, and backend boundaries when the outcome requires it. * You use AI coding agents heavily and can still design, implement, review, and debug independently. * You want direct customer contact, hands\-on implementation, and responsibility after launch. * You enjoy following one product behavior through interface, API, data, permissions, and production recovery. * You move toward the difficult layer rather than routing the problem to another team. This opening spans mid\-level and staff\+ scope under the same hands\-on operating model. At mid\-level, you will independently own a bounded customer outcome across product and implementation. At staff\+, you will still write code while setting direction for a broader area, making hard architectural tradeoffs, and raising the quality of decisions around you. We level on demonstrated scope, not years served. This is a hands\-on product IC role. It is not a people\-management or model\-research role. Our stack includes React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, Postgres, and S3\. Experience with these exact technologies is not required. **What you want to know** ------------------------- * We work together in person in San Francisco. This is not a remote role with occasional office attendance. Decisions are made by the people closest to the customer and the code. Read our unfiltered Slack to see how that works in practice. * We pay in the top 10% of the SF market through salary and meaningful equity. We re\-benchmark against the market twice a year and adjust when compensation drifts. * Our process is fast and direct. It is not unusual to hear back the same day. * Metaview’s internal IC title is **Member of Product Staff, Engineer**. For this opening, level and compensation are set at mid\-level or staff\+ based on demonstrated scope. The work remains hands\-on at every level. * We offer competitive option grants so we are all owners. * We sponsor work visas and support the immigration process from start to finish. * In the US, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents. * Time off is unlimited. Take the time you need.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 15 Sep 2026 At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world. **About the Role** ================== MiniMed is building a lean, high\-leverage AI \& Data Science team. We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to be our senior technical anchor — the person who builds AI capabilities hands\-on and sets the standard the rest of the team builds to. This is a builder’s role first. You will take AI/ML models and LLM\-powered agents from a fast “proof of life” prototype through to a production deployment that holds up in a regulated environment. Roughly a fifth of your time goes to the force\-multiplier work: reviewing and quality\-gating other engineers’ designs, and establishing the reusable patterns that keep the architecture and the hard\-won judgment in\-house. To be clear about what this is not: this is not a people\-management role, and it is not a role where you hand a notebook to someone else to productionize. You own the capability until it is live and delivering value. Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. **Prototype fast.** Demonstrate “proof of life” for AI/ML models, agents, and tools against real MiniMed business problems, working from the business’s actual data and workflows rather than a sanitized sandbox. **Take it to production and drive adoption.** Build, evaluate, and deploy on the MIA stack (Databricks, LangGraph/LangSmith, enterprise agent platforms), applying evaluation\-driven development, guardrails, and deployment patterns so what ships is reliable, auditable, and maintainable. You own the capability from prototype through initial production release and its first monitoring cycle — measured by real adoption and business value, not just a stable deployment — then hand off to Model Operations for steady\-state run. **Integrate into the enterprise environment.** Wire agents and models into the surrounding systems — APIs, identity and access (SSO/SAML/OAuth), systems of record such as Salesforce and SAP, and enterprise data pipelines — so capabilities work against real, messy production systems rather than in isolation. **Set the technical standard.** Establish reusable patterns for agent design, tool\-calling, retrieval, and evaluation harnesses; review and quality\-gate the work of other engineers on the team so the bar holds without a manager in the loop. **Feed learnings back to the platform.** Turn what you learn in the field into improvements to the MIA platform, shared tooling, and reusable\-pattern roadmap, so each deployment makes the next one faster. **Self\-direct against outcomes.** Partner with the Product Manager, AI \& Data Science to choose what to build and when to stop, without needing the problem pre\-decomposed for you. **Build for a regulated environment.** Uphold the safety, privacy, and compliance requirements of a medical\-device context, including auditability and human\-in\-the\-loop where required. **Must Have: Minimum Requirements** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and 8\+ years of of relevant experience or advanced degree with a minimum of 6\+ years of relevant experience. **Nice to Have** * Demonstrated delivery of LLM\-powered systems or ML models to production — not prototypes, evaluations, or internal demos alone. * Strong system design skills and end\-to\-end ownership from prototype through production deployment. * Experience technically leading or directing other engineers, including reviewing their work. * Strong stakeholder\-facing communication — able to scope ambiguous problems with business partners and explain technical trade\-offs (latency, cost, model risk) to non\-technical leaders. * Hands\-on with Databricks, LangGraph, LangSmith, vector databases, and managed RAG/retrieval. * Forward\-deployed or embedded engineering experience — building AI systems from inside the business’s real data, workflows, and constraints. * Experience integrating AI or software systems into complex enterprise environments — APIs, identity/auth, systems of record (e.g., Salesforce, SAP), and data pipelines. * Comfort operating within a formal MLOps discipline, including a defined handoff to a model operations function. * Experience in a regulated industry (medical device, healthcare, financial services); familiarity with HIPAA, audit, and validation requirements. **Physical Job Requirements** ============================= The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. The physical demands described wi ve salary and flexible benefits package** At MiniMed, we put people first. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **About Morning Consult** ------------------------- Morning Consult is a global decision intelligence company changing how modern leaders make smarter, faster, better decisions. The company pairs its proprietary high\-frequency data with applied artificial intelligence to better inform decisions on what people think and how they will act. This role is available in any of our office locations (Washington, DC; New York, NY; Chicago, IL) or can be based remotely, though candidates in Washington, DC or New York, NY are preferred. Join us in the office for catered lunch on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, or grab a beverage from the fridge for an impromptu after\-work happy hour! **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Product Manager to join our highly collaborative, driven, and creative product \& engineering team. It’s never been a more exciting time to work at a data company building products on mountains of proprietary data. For the last few years, we’ve been continuously innovating on how we leverage AI to meet the next level of customer need, with creativity and speed. This is an execution\-first role. You'll partner day\-to\-day with engineering to turn priorities into a strong, well\-run backlog — writing tickets, unblocking work, tracking down the follow\-up nobody else caught, and making sure nothing stalls between teams. We do a lot of our work in ambiguous problem spaces that are being mapped out as we go. Your job is to bring clarity and momentum to the work, not to have all the answers on day one. You'll work closely with a Senior PM who owns the broader strategic picture across two engineering teams. What we need most is someone who can lock into the details, keep things moving, and build trust with engineers and stakeholders along the way. Over time, as you build context and track record, this role has room to grow into more strategic ownership and direct client\-facing work. We're intentionally open on background here. We're less focused on whether you've run a product team before and more focused on whether you're a self\-starter who's smart, curious, and proactive. A few years of relevant experience is great; what matters most is how you operate. **What You'll Be Working On** ----------------------------- **Execution (the core of this role)** * Own a clean, prioritized backlog with clear user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and scope decisions. Following up until requirements actually land * Partner with engineering on solution design and scope, pushing for iterative releases that get value out the door without waiting for perfect * Set the team up for productive planning and refinement by coming prepared, not catching up in the room * Track the metrics that tell you whether something's actually working, and use them to inform what's next * Proactively surface risks, blockers, and things that aren't connecting — before they turn into fire drills **Strategy (collaborative, growing over time)** * Work with engineering leads and your Senior PM partner to help shape and prioritize problem statements * Build enough domain fluency — through relentless, good\-natured question\-asking — to understand not just what you're building, but why it matters and what it unlocks downstream * Communicate clearly to a range of audiences: writing help docs and release notes, and keeping stakeholders honestly informed on status * As you grow in the role, take on more direct stakeholder and client conversations — asking the right discovery questions rather than just relaying what engineering tells you **About You** ------------- * Roughly 3\-5 years of relevant experience — this can be product management, or another background (engineering, operations, client success, program management) that's built the same muscles * Proactive, jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **About Morning Consult** ------------------------- Morning Consult is a global decision intelligence company changing how modern leaders make smarter, faster, better decisions. The company pairs its proprietary high\-frequency data with applied artificial intelligence to better inform decisions on what people think and how they will act. This role is available in any of our office locations (Washington, DC; New York, NY; Chicago, IL) or can be based remotely, though candidates in Washington, DC or New York, NY are preferred. Join us in the office for catered lunch on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, or grab a beverage from the fridge for an impromptu after\-work happy hour! **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Product Manager to join our highly collaborative, driven, and creative product \& engineering team. It’s never been a more exciting time to work at a data company building products on mountains of proprietary data. For the last few years, we’ve been continuously innovating on how we leverage AI to meet the next level of customer need, with creativity and speed. This is an execution\-first role. You'll partner day\-to\-day with engineering to turn priorities into a strong, well\-run backlog — writing tickets, unblocking work, tracking down the follow\-up nobody else caught, and making sure nothing stalls between teams. We do a lot of our work in ambiguous problem spaces that are being mapped out as we go. Your job is to bring clarity and momentum to the work, not to have all the answers on day one. You'll work closely with a Senior PM who owns the broader strategic picture across two engineering teams. What we need most is someone who can lock into the details, keep things moving, and build trust with engineers and stakeholders along the way. Over time, as you build context and track record, this role has room to grow into more strategic ownership and direct client\-facing work. We're intentionally open on background here. We're less focused on whether you've run a product team before and more focused on whether you're a self\-starter who's smart, curious, and proactive. A few years of relevant experience is great; what matters most is how you operate. **What You'll Be Working On** ----------------------------- **Execution (the core of this role)** * Own a clean, prioritized backlog with clear user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and scope decisions. Following up until requirements actually land * Partner with engineering on solution design and scope, pushing for iterative releases that get value out the door without waiting for perfect * Set the team up for productive planning and refinement by coming prepared, not catching up in the room * Track the metrics that tell you whether something's actually working, and use them to inform what's next * Proactively surface risks, blockers, and things that aren't connecting — before they turn into fire drills **Strategy (collaborative, growing over time)** * Work with engineering leads and your Senior PM partner to help shape and prioritize problem statements * Build enough domain fluency — through relentless, good\-natured question\-asking — to understand not just what you're building, but why it matters and what it unlocks downstream * Communicate clearly to a range of audiences: writing help docs and release notes, and keeping stakeholders honestly informed on status * As you grow in the role, take on more direct stakeholder and client conversations — asking the right discovery questions rather than just relaying what engineering tells you **About You** ------------- * Roughly 3\-5 years of relevant experience — this can be product management, or another background (engineering, operations, client success, program management) that's built the same muscles * Proactive, low\-ego, and collaborative — you care more about the team's outcomes than individual credit, and you'd rather ask "want me to jump in on this?" than wait to be assigned * A strong, clear communicator who shares status and priorities without being asked, and who's comfortable saying "here's where this actually stands" * Comfortable moving fast and showing work early, even when it's not fully polished — you'd rather check in on direction than burn a week perfecting something that might be off\-track * Curious enough to dig into a technical domain you haven't worked in before and keep asking questions until you genuinely understand it * A relationship\-builder — engineers trust you, and people don't worry about what's happening on your team * Experience with APIs or technical/data We welcome diverse and non\-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t satisfy every single bullet on this list! jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer / Vice President
jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** Our client is an early\-stage science and technology startup developing innovative research programs and product opportunities at the intersection of biotechnology, computational science, software engineering, and emerging technologies. We are seeking an exceptional Chief Operating Officer (COO) / Vice President to serve as a strategic partner to the CEO and help build the company from an early\-stage venture into a scalable, valuable organization. This is not a conventional salaried executive position. It is an entrepreneurial, equity\-based opportunity intended for someone who wants to participate directly in building a company, developing its intellectual property, advancing scientific and technology initiatives, establishing strategic partnerships, and ultimately creating substantial enterprise value. The ideal candidate is someone who is excited by the opportunity to build something from the ground up and is motivated by ownership, innovation, scientific advancement, and long\-term financial upside. **Role \& Responsibilities** The COO will work closely with the CEO across the company's strategic, operational, scientific, and commercial activities. Responsibilities may include: * Serve as a strategic right\-hand to the CEO and participate in major company decisions. * Help establish and execute the company's long\-term corporate and operational strategy. * Oversee and coordinate multidisciplinary projects spanning biotechnology, software, computational science, research, and product development. * Help recruit, organize, and manage scientific, engineering, business, and advisory teams. * Develop operational systems and processes necessary to transition the company from an early\-stage venture toward commercial growth. * Support development of strategic partnerships with universities, research institutions, biotechnology companies, technology companies, investors, and other organizations. * Assist with grant development, research collaborations, commercialization strategies, licensing opportunities, and other sources of non\-dilutive or strategic funding. * Help evaluate new technologies, research opportunities, intellectual property, and potential products. * Work with the CEO to develop business models and commercialization strategies around the company's scientific and technological assets. * Represent the company in selected meetings with potential partners, advisors, investors, researchers, and other stakeholders. * Contribute to corporate development activities, including fundraising, strategic partnerships, licensing, joint ventures, and potential mergers or acquisitions. * Establish measurable organizational goals and help ensure projects remain aligned with the company's strategic objectives. * Identify operational, scientific, technical, and commercial risks and develop strategies to address them. * Help build the company's brand, reputation, culture, and long\-term organizational infrastructure. **Ideal Candidate** This opportunity is exclusively open to recent college graduates who are interested in developing their careers through hands\-on involvement in an early\-stage company. We are particularly interested in graduates with backgrounds in one or more of the following: * Computer Science * Software Engineering * Biotechnology * Bioinformatics * Computational Biology * Biomedical Engineering * Data Science / Artificial Intelligence * Life Sciences * Technology Entrepreneurship * Business / Management with strong technical or scientific interests Candidates should possess a combination of technical or scientific knowledge, leadership potential, entrepreneurial judgment, intellectual curiosity, and strong interest in innovation. You do not need to possess expertise in every area listed above. We are particularly interested in individuals who can bring a strong technical, scientific, analytical, or business foundation while collaborating effectively across disciplines. **What We Are Looking For** The successful candidate should have: * A genuine passion for entrepreneurship and company building. * Strong interest in biotechnology, science, technology, or innovation. * The ability to operate independently in an early\-stage environment. * Strong strategic and analytical thinking. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * A willingness to take ownership rather than simply perform assigned tasks. * The ability to work with scientists, engineers, executives, investors, and external partners. * Strong initiative and willingness to learn. * The ability to handle ambiguity and operate without the structure of a traditional corporate environment. * A long\-term mindset and willingness to participate in building the organization over several years. * The ambition to help transform research and intellectual property into commercially valuable products and partnerships. Prior startup, research, leadership, engineering, scientific, or business\-development experien n early\-stage startup and is expected to be **primarily remote and highly flexible**. The COO may maintain other professional, academic, entrepreneurial, or personal commitments, provided they do not interfere with the responsibilities of this position or create conflicts of interest. Occasional in\-person meetings may be required depending on company activities, partnerships, research initiatives, or other business needs. However, this flexibility should not be interpreted as a short\-term or casual opportunity. **Long\-Term Commitment** **This is a multi\-year opportunity.** The company's scientific and commercial initiatives may require several years of research, development, regulatory progression, partnership development, fundraising, and commercialization before significant financial returns are realized. We are therefore seeking someone who genuinely wants to build with the company for the long term. Please do not apply if you are primarily seeking immediate salary compensation, a short\-term consulting engagement, or a position that you expect to leave within a few months. **Application Requirements** **Serious candidates must meet the following application requirements:** * **Recent College Graduate**This position is exclusively open to recent college graduates. * **LinkedIn Profile Required**Candidates must maintain an active LinkedIn profile that accurately represents their professional background. The profile must include a **current, authentic profile photograph** so that the company can verify the applicant's professional presence and identity. * **Letter of Interest Required**Candidates must submit a **letter of interest** explaining why they are interested in joining an early\-stage science and technology company, what they believe they can contribute, and why they are interested in an equity\-based, long\-term opportunity. * **Resume Required**Candidates must submit a current resume outlining their education, relevant experience, technical or scientific background, projects, leadership experience, and other qualifications. **How to Apply** Serious candidates should email the following materials to: **corporate@maaglobalconsulting.com** Please include: * **Resume** * **Letter of Interest** * **LinkedIn Profile URL** Applications that do not include a LinkedIn profile, resume, and letter of interest may not be considered. **Why Join?** This opportunity is best suited for someone who wants to participate in the creation of a company rather than simply join an established organization. You will have the opportunity to: * Help shape the company's strategy from an early stage. * Work directly with the CEO. * Influence scientific and technological direction. * Build teams and organizational infrastructure. * Participate in strategic partnerships and commercialization. * Contribute to the development of potentially valuable intellectual property and products. * Receive an ownership interest aligned with long\-term company value. * Develop executive\-level experience early in your career. * Help determine what the company ultimately becomes. **If you are a recent graduate with an entrepreneurial mindset, strong intellectual curiosity, and a genuine passion for science, technology, and company building, we encourage you to apply.** Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $500,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Professional development assistance Application Question(s): * This is an equity\-based COO/VP opportunity with no initial salary or guaranteed cash compensation. Are you willing to accept this compensation structure and commit to building the company for the long term, understanding that equity may not provide immediate or guaranteed financial compensation? * Tell us about one project, idea, research effort, business, technical project, organization, or other initiative that you personally took ownership of. What motivated you to pursue it, what specifically did you do, and what was the outcome? Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Controls & Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** ------------------------- Our client is developing innovative, high\-performance electric platforms for advanced commercial and government applications. We are seeking a hands\-on **Senior Controls \& Software Integration Engineer** to own control software and system integration from early development through real\-world testing and production. This is a highly hands\-on role for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of **controls, embedded software, high\-voltage systems, and hardware integration**. You will build, integrate, troubleshoot, test, and validate complex systems in real\-world environments. Experience in a specific industry is not required. Candidates from **EV, automotive, aerospace, defense technology, autonomous systems, robotics, or other advanced engineering environments** are encouraged to apply. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Develop, calibrate, and release control and remote\-control software using **Simulink\-based model development and automatic code generation**. * Integrate electric powertrain and high\-voltage systems over **CAN/J1939**, including BMS, motors, inverters, chargers, DC/DC converters, power distribution, and thermal management systems. * Design and implement fault handling, interlocks, derating strategies, and safe/limp operating modes. * Develop communication between control systems, displays, telemetry systems, and other connected platforms. * Integrate drive\-by\-wire and advanced control systems with third\-party autonomy platforms. * Own bench, HIL, and field validation, calibration, release sign\-off, and technical documentation. * Troubleshoot complex hardware and software integration issues using CAN tools, oscilloscopes, breakout boxes, and other diagnostic equipment. * Support field testing, customer demonstrations, and advanced technology programs. * Work closely with electrical, harness, software, and systems engineering teams. * Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and technicians. * Help transition complex technology from **prototype through scalable production**. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **5\+ years of experience** in controls engineering, embedded software, vehicle systems, powertrain controls, robotics, aerospace, or a similar technical environment. * Experience helping take a complex hardware/software product from **prototype through validation and production**. * Deep knowledge of **CAN communications and J1939**. * Experience with CAN tools such as **Vector, Kvaser, PCAN, or similar platforms**. * Strong high\-voltage system integration experience, including **BMS, inverters, chargers, motors, and related powertrain components**. * Experience with **MATLAB/Simulink or other model\-based controls development environments**. * Strong hands\-on diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities. * A strong **bias toward hardware**\-you are comfortable troubleshooting directly at the connector using breakout boxes, oscilloscopes, CAN tools, and other diagnostic equipment, not just working in simulation. * Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Computer, or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- Experience with any of the following is a plus:* MotoHawk, EcoCoder, OpenECU, or other model\-based development platforms. * NMEA 2000, CANopen, or other CAN\-based communication protocols. * Embedded C, CODESYS, Curtis VCL, or similar controls platforms. * Autonomous systems, ROS 2, DDS, MAVLink, or similar interfaces. * Functional safety standards such as ISO 26262 or ISO 13849\. * Startup, advanced development, skunkworks, or **0\-to\-1 product development experience**. **Why This Opportunity?** ------------------------- This is not a narrow software role. You will work across the complete system\-from high\-voltage power and battery systems through controls, CAN/J1939 communications, motors, inverters, charging, thermal systems, displays, and advanced control interfaces. You will have the opportunity to **build it, integrate it, troubleshoot it, test it, and see it operate in the real world** while helping move innovative technology from prototype to production.**Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- **Base Salary: $80,000\-$150,000 annually, depending on experience and technical depth.** Additional compensation and benefits may include:* Early\-stage equity consideration * Health and dental benefits * Paid time off * Significant technical ownership and growth opportunities **Location, Travel \& Work Authorization** ------------------------------------------ This position is based in the **Detroit / Southeast Michigan area** and requires substantial hands\-on field involvement. Candidates should be comfortable with **travel that may exceed 50%**, including extended periods supporting testing, demonstrations, and field programs.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Mozilla?** Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open\-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. **About this team and role:** Mozilla’s Data Engineering team is looking for a Senior Staff Data Engineer / Data Platform Engineer to help build the present and future of our Data Platform infrastructure. This role will be a hybrid Data Engineer / Data Platform Engineer, working across both teams (Data Platform Engineering and Data Engineering) in a technical leadership capacity. Mozilla’s Data Platform serves the needs of multiple products, including the Firefox browser, from data collection through to insights, product experiences, and machine learning applications. Our goal is to build a robust, efficient, and effective platform that makes it increasingly easy to inform Mozilla’s business and product decisions. For more details, please take a look at the overview or the Data@Mozilla blog. **What you’ll do:** * Design, build, and improve systems to reliably and efficiently process data at the scale of tens of terabytes per day, and apply those systems to solve meaningful problems for the business. * Evaluate new technologies. Work with Data Engineering and Data Platform Engineering not only to implement these technologies but also to set best\-practice standards. * Craft and improve workflows in GCP using standard, modern components such as Dataflow, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, GKE, and Airflow. * Drive cross\-functional projects with stakeholders across Mozilla, including Data Science, Product, Legal, Policy, and Engineering. * Mentor teammates and develop engineering best practices across the Data Organization. * Work with Data Science to design and implement useful data abstractions. * Address the evolving needs of active Data Products. **What you’ll bring:** * 10\+ years of combined experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Data Science, or Data Analyst roles * Deep expertise in Data Engineering and Data Platform Engineering. * Experience with data tooling in GCP, AWS, or Azure, including Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Dataflow (Apache Beam), or similar technologies. * Experience with Looker, Fivetran, Kubernetes / GKE, Airflow / Cloud Composer, and Terraform, or similar technologies. * Advanced coding skills in SQL and Python. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: modularity, abstraction, data structures, and algorithms. * Experience as a tech lead, team lead, hands\-on Data Engineering or Data Platform manager, or similar leadership role. * Commitment to our values: * + Welcoming differences + Being relationship\-minded + Practicing responsible participation + Having grit **What you’ll get:** * Generous performance\-based bonus plans to all eligible employees \- we share in our success as one team * Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage * Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) * Quarterly all\-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together * Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday * One\-time home office stipend * Annual professional development budget * Quarterly well\-being stipend * Considerable paid parental leave * Employee referral bonus program * Other benefits (life/AD\&D, disability, EAP, etc. \- varies by country) **About Mozilla** Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. **Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging** Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity\-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose. Group: C \#LI\-REMOTE Req ID: R3223 **Hiring Ranges:** US Tier 1 Locations $179,000 \- $238,000 USD US Tier 2 Locations $164,000 \- $219,000 USD US Tier 3 Locations $152,000 \- $203,000 USD

documents and ensure project and team compliance with contractual requirements. * Manage the financial aspects of assigned projects and accurately project final costs throughout the project lifecycle. * Review job costs weekly and identify potential cost issues or opportunities. * Prepare monthly billings and manage project cash flow. * Develop front\-loaded schedules of values prior to project activities being charged. * Review, price, negotiate, and manage change orders and other project cost impacts. * Assist with negotiating cost\-effective subcontract agreements and material purchases. * Monitor material orders, including purchasing, tracking, delivery, and stocking. * Coordinate with NGi field and BIM/Design teams to deliver required project design and documentation. * Establish and maintain project procedures, document controls, and workflows. * Prepare and manage project submittals and related documentation. * Create and manage quality control reports using information gathered from the field. * Coordinate required front\-end documents with the Safety Manager, including AHA, IIPP, safety manuals, and QA/QC programs. * Ensure significant project events are properly documented, including accidents, delays, changes, and other potential claims or impacts. * Coordinate project mobilization, including trailers, utilities, and other startup requirements. * Verify or retake\-off estimates to establish working project budgets based on value engineering, construction methods, and project\-specific quantities. * Coordinate project kickoff and job start meetings. * potential obstacles. * Facilitate regular project meetings with management, subcontractors, and other stakeholders. * Work proactively to identify, avoid, and mitigate claims, disputes, and conflicts. * Maintain strong working relationships with owners, architects, general contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams. * Manage, train, coach, and mentor project team members, including Project Engineers. * Complete project closeout procedures and ensure required documentation is submitted timely. * Coordinate warranty follow\-up and resolution of outstanding warranty items. * Participate in preconstruction services and activities as required. * Attend seminars, educational programs, and training as required. * Perform other duties as assigned. *Because the needs of the company are constantly evolving, the above list is not exhaustive and is subject to change to meet changing priorities.* WHAT YOU BRING Education \& Experience * Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent construction experience will be considered. * Minimum of 3 years of progressive experience in commercial construction. * Experience in drywall, framing, ceilings, or interior systems is preferred. * Experience managing commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout. * Experience with project financial management, scheduling, contract administration, change orders, and subcontractor management. Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities * Strong knowledge of commercial construction principles, techniques, and procedures. * Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, plans, specifications, and contract documents. * Strong understanding of construction schedules, budgets, project costs, and financial reporting. * Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills. * Ability to negotiate effectively and resolve conflicts. * Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams. * Ability to coach, mentor, and develop team members. * Ability to establish processes and solutions where no precedent or guidelines exist. * Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced construction environment. * Commitment to safety, quality, compliance, and professional standards. LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES The Project Manager is expected to provide leadership and direction to the project team, including Project Engineers and other assigned staff. Responsibilities include: * Train, coach, motivate, and develop team members. * Set clear expectations and hold team members accountable. * Mentor and cross\-train employees to support individual and organizational growth. * Promote collaboration and communication across departments. * Work with company leaders to assess project and workforce needs. * Address and resolve conflicts professionally. * Lead by example and promote NGi’s commitment to safety, quality, accountability, and teamwork. jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Netradyne** harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern\-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward\-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth. **About us:** At Netradyne, our team is committed to delivering solutions to our customers that advance their market leadership. Our focus is to continuously drive innovation while delivering meaningful, actionable data. The Netradyne Driveri® Vision\-Based Driver Recognition Safety Program significantly advances the technology category through the application of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Edge Computing. The foundations of Driveri® are equally focused on providing comprehensive performance insights, highlighting positive activity, and significantly reducing the resources needed to address risk. Netradyne draws from a diverse team of innovators, technologists, and customer advocates to create an experience where customer success continues to motivate what is next. Supported and funded by our investors, Softbank, M12, Hyundai Cradle, Point72 Ventures, Microsoft and Reliance Industrial Investments and Holdings; Netradyne is committed to building a world\-class team of technologists and industry experts to deliver products that improve safety, increase productivity, and optimize collaboration within the organizations. With growth exceeding 3x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology – that has put 'legacy' providers in a "spin" cycle trying to catch up. Our team is growing, and we need forward\-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth. **Position Summary:** We are building a new Physical AI product line at Netradyne — a vision\-based platform that monitors activity across physical environments and surfaces safety risks in real time. This is founding\-team work, and we're hiring generalists who are excited about building something new. A Founding Product Engineer owns problems end\-to\-end — from an edge device, through the cloud platform, to the surface a safety manager touches — and moves fluidly between them depending on what the product needs that week. You'll naturally lean toward platform/infrastructure or toward product/experience based on your strengths, but you're expected to have working range across both, not a hard boundary between "backend team" and "frontend team." You talk to customers directly, turn what you hear into what gets built, and take it the rest of the way to shipped. **Essential Functions:** *Platform \& infrastructure (lean here if that's your strength):* * **Cloud ingestion and storage** — real\-time event streaming, time\-series and event storage, the data model for safety events and metrics. * **Multi\-tenancy, identity, and access control** — multiple customers, multiple sites per customer, role\-based access control, authentication and SSO. * **Infrastructure and DevOps** — AWS, containerized deployments, CI/CD, and monitoring across the edge and cloud stack. *Product \& experience (lean here if that's your strength):* * **Operations dashboard** — real\-time event feed, alert detail with video clips, site map, zone\-violation tracking, risk summaries. * **Compliance analytics** — trend reporting, time\-based comparisons, exportable reports for safety and operational record\-keeping. * **Operator scoring and coaching workflow** — worker/operator safety scoring, coaching queue, session tracking and completion. *Shared, regardless of lean:* * **Agent layer / agentic features** — the orchestration layer and conversational/agentic surfaces over safety data (alert triage, auto\-coaching drafts, summarization), built on managed services or internal modules where they fit. * **Rapid iteration with real customers** — ship fast, instrument usage, work directly in the field, run pilots alongside live deployments. **Qualifications:** *What we're looking for:* * **Systems thinking** — you can reason about a problem end\-to\-end, from device to cloud to the person using it, and make sound calls with incomplete information. * **Dynamic range** — you move between an infra problem, a product/UX problem, and a customer conversation within the same week without needing to be re\-anchored each time. You don't default to the one lane you're most comfortable in. * **Bias to action, full ownership** — given an ambiguous problem, you scope it, build it, ship it, and measure it, without waiting to be told the next step. * **Direct customer experience** — you've worked directly with customers or end users to shape what gets built, not just built to a spec handed down. *Baseline technical range:* * Full\-stack comfort: a modern backend language (Go, Python, Java) and, depending on lean, either cloud infrastructure (AWS, containers, CI/CD, distributed/event\-driven systems) or modern frontend (TypeScript/JavaScript) and data\-dense real\-time UI (dashboards, event feeds, video, timelines). * Experience designing or working within multi\-tenant systems with role\-based access control. * Fluent with AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow. * 7\+ years of software engineering experience. We'd rather have someone with less tenure and real range than more tenure in one narrow lane. **Nice to have:** * Agent orchestration or workflow engines (e.g. Temporal); managed identity platforms (WorkOS, Auth0, Clerk). * Data pipelines at scale (Spark/PySpark, time\-series); high\-volume IoT or sensor data. * Building or integrating AI agent features (tool use, conversational interfaces, LLM\-powered surfaces) — a strong differentiator. * Safety, operations, or compliance software experience. **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. **Hybrid Work Schedule:** We believe in the value of in\-person collaboration while maintaining flexibility. Team members work from the office on **Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday**, with remote work on **Tuesday and Friday**. **Why This Role:** Netradyne has analyzed over 25 billion miles of driving data and built one of the most accurate edge AI systems in commercial transportation. We are applying that capability to a new Physical AI product line — new vertical, greenfield architecture, founding team. You won't be handed a lane — you'll help define one, and move across it as the product needs. **Compensation Package\_Perks of being a Netradyne employee:** * Competitive Salary \+ eligibility for yearly bonus. * Company equity * Company Paid Health Care, Dental, and Vision Coverage for you and most of your dependents * Generous PTO and Sick Leave * 401(K) with generous company match * Disability, Life Insurance and Ancillary Benefits * And much more! jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise AI Platform
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise AI Platform** ==================================================== ### **About OpenArt** OpenArt is an AI storytelling and visual creation platform used by millions of creators worldwide. We're building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting\-edge AI — enabling anyone to create videos, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We believe the future of creativity is AI\-native, and we're shaping that future. ### **Why Join OpenArt** * **Brand\-new function, real mandate** — enterprise and team customers are one of our biggest growth levers, and most of the infrastructure behind them hasn't been built yet. You'll be the first engineer on it. * **Small team, massive surface area** — senior engineers own whole systems, not slices. * **Real scale, real stakes** — OpenArt serves millions of creators, and enterprise deals will close (or not) on what you ship. * **Founder\-led engineering culture** — both founders are technical and deeply involved in product and architecture. * **AI\-native product** — you'll decide how cutting\-edge models get packaged, governed, and sold to teams and enterprises. * **High ownership, low process** — we value judgment, clarity, and speed over bureaucracy. ### **About the Role** We're hiring a senior engineer to build the product and infrastructure that lets OpenArt serve teams and enterprises, not just individual creators. That spans the full surface: workspaces and team management, roles and permissions, usage\-based billing and procurement\-friendly invoicing, audit logs, and the security posture — SSO, data controls, compliance groundwork — that larger customers expect before they'll sign. This is a full\-stack role in the enterprise function. You'll move between customer\-facing product (admin consoles, billing UI, workspace settings) and the backend and infrastructure underneath it (access control, usage metering, payment integrations, hardening our systems for enterprise\-grade reliability and security). You'll work directly with the founders to figure out, in real time, what "enterprise\-ready" needs to mean for an AI\-native creative platform — and then build it. ### **What You’ll Do** * Design and build core enterprise primitives: organizations/workspaces, roles and permissions (RBAC), SSO/SAML, and audit logging * Build usage\-based billing, invoicing, and payment infrastructure that supports both self\-serve and enterprise procurement (e.g. Stripe) * Harden platform security and reliability to the bar enterprise customers expect — access control, data isolation, and groundwork for compliance certifications (e.g. SOC 2\) * Design scalable backend architectures and APIs that support multi\-tenant, team\-based usage patterns * Build clean, polished frontend experiences (React/Next.js) for admin, billing, and workspace management * Partner directly with founders, sales, and customers to turn deal\-blocking requirements into shipped platform features * Make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy calls on infrastructure (billing providers, auth providers, compliance tooling) and clearly communicate the trade\-offs * Define OpenArt's enterprise engineering practices as the function's first hire, and help shape the team that grows around it ### **What We’re Looking For** **Core Requirements** * 5\+ years of full\-stack engineering experience shipping and owning production systems at scale * Strong system design and data modeling skills — comfortable reasoning about APIs, permission models, multi\-tenancy, and data isolation * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure and platform work: cloud architecture, observability, scaling, or reliability engineering * A strong AI\-assisted coding practice — you use tools like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a core part of how you build, and have real opinions about what makes them work well * Product sense for B2B — you know what makes an admin console feel trustworthy to an IT buyer and a workspace feel effortless for a team * Strong communication skills — you can sit in a customer security review or a sales call, then translate what you heard into clear technical trade\-offs for non\-technical teammates **Nice to Have** * Experience with payments or billing systems (e.g. Stripe): subscriptions, usage\-based billing, invoicing, disputes * Experience with security or compliance work: SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logging, SOC 2 / GDPR groundwork * Experience selling to or building for enterprise customers, including procurement and security\-review cycles * Startup experience, or ownership of a large product surface from 0 to 1 ### **Compensation** * $500k\+ total compensation including base salary, bonus, equity * Equity \- meaningful ownership in what you build * High autonomy, high growth environment ### **Work Setup** * Bay Area preferred (hybrid available) * Visa sponsorship available ### **What Success Looks Like in 3–6 Months** * Workspaces, roles, and permissions are live in production and used by paying teams * Enterprise billing — usage metering, invoicing, procurement\-friendly payments — is shipped and stable * At least one enterprise deal has closed on the strength of features you built (e.g. SSO, audit logs) * SOC 2 groundwork is underway, and you can walk a customer's security team through our posture with confidence * You're setting the direction for enterprise engineering — pushing ideas, not waiting for specs If you want to build the platform that turns a consumer AI product into an enterprise business — and own it from day one — we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.description: ### **About Openprise** Openprise is the Ops and AI orchestration platform for modern GTM teams. We help go\-to\-market teams clean, enrich, and activate their data so automation and AI actually work at scale. We’re building a brand that’s community\-oriented and shows up smart, creative, and a little unexpected. **Job Description:** We are seeking an experienced and motivated Enterprise Account Executive (AE). The ideal candidate will have a proven track record as a hunter of selling enterprise software in a fast\-paced, evolving startup environment. Having a deep understanding of revenue operations and GTM strategies is a bonus but not required. You will play a key role in driving revenue growth by acquiring and managing relationships with enterprise prospects, with a focus on senior\-level decision\-makers. In this role, you will leverage your experience to identify new business opportunities, drive enterprise sales cycles from lead generation to closing, and deliver value\-driven conversations that resonate with executives. You will work closely with your SDR, SE, sales leadership, and marketing teams to tailor the solutions that meet the unique needs of each prospect. **THIS IS NOT A REMOTE POSITION. THE POSITION IS BASED IN SAN MATEO, CA. QUALIFIED CANDIDATES MUST BE ABLE TO COMMUTE TO OUR OFFICE AT LEAST THREE TIMES A WEEK.** **Responsibilities:** * Meet and exceed annual and quarterly sales targets while accurately forecasting the business. * Methodically qualify, build, and manage an accurate sales funnel and pipeline. * Provide timely and accurate forecasts, along with clear visibility into sales and revenue. * Coordinate outbound efforts together with a designated SDR. * Manage the entire sales process from prospecting to closed revenue. * Understand customer needs and requirements, and translate them into a value\-driven positioning for Openprise. * Work closely with a Solutions Engineer to prescribe technical solutions that solve business needs. * Lead product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of the Openprise platform to prospective customers. * Understand the product inside out and be technically sound. * Contribute to developing best practices and sales playbooks to help scale the sales organization. **Requirements:** * 5\+ years of enterprise sales experience with a focus on RevOps, SaaS, cloud, MarTech, and AI/automation software. Sales and/or Marketing operations experience is a plus. * Proven ability to build and execute a coordinated outbound effort with an SDR into a named account portfolio * Comfortably selling to VP \& C\-Suite executives, navigating through multiple decision\-makers in large complex organizations. * Experience in solution selling processes. * Ability to work in a team environment and collaborate with team members. * Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear, compelling way. * Strong negotiation and closing skills with a focus on driving value\-based sales. * Results\-oriented with a data\-driven approach to sales forecasting and pipeline management. * Self\-motivated, proactive, and able to work effectively in a hybrid environment. On Target Earning (OTE) Range: $200,000 \- $220,000 (50/50 split) \#LI\-hybrid y0mmd0QND8

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Applied AI / Cloud
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Senior Applied AI Software Engineer (Software Engineer III) **Reports to:** Engineering Manager**Direct Reports:** None **Role ID:** IT10000584C**FLSA Classification:** Exempt**Location:** Hybrid in Long Island City (Queens), NY\* * *Must reside in one of the following states: NY, NJ, or CT* **About Us** Opentrons Labworks, Inc. is a disruptive life science company leveraging its integrated lab platform to supercharge the pace of innovation in research and healthcare. Through Opentrons Robotics, thousands of institutions are automating lab operations with flexible, easy\-to\-use liquid handling lab robots. With our own cutting edge R\&D, biopharma and biotech at large can also benefit from our world\-class genome\-scale cell engineering solutions. If you are looking for your next exciting opportunity, come join us! We provide excellent benefits, competitive compensation, equity packages, and opportunities for growth. Learn more on our Careers Website. **About the Role** We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer (SWE3\) to help build AI\-powered features as part of OpentronsAI, our platform that leverages Large Language Models to democratize laboratory automation. This role focuses on the internals of an AI\-powered application: building the AWS\-based microservices and asynchronous workflows that power protocol generation, integrating LLM calls and knowledge retrieval systems into production SaaS infrastructure, and making sure those systems are reliable and safe at scale for thousands of laboratories globally. You'll build the ML/AI systems layer that sits underneath the product, from parsing and understanding scientists' natural\-language input to the classifiers that route and score it and the embedding infrastructure that grounds model output in real protocol knowledge. Because correctness here isn't optional, you'll treat evaluation as a first\-class part of the build, designing the tests and benchmarks that catch bad output before it ships, alongside the cost and safety instrumentation (token spend tracking, guardrails, validation) that keeps the system trustworthy at scale. You'll bring the same engineering rigor to this layer that you'd bring to any production system: observability, cost control, and failure modes that fail safely rather than silently. This is a hybrid position, requiring onsite presence at our Long Island City headquarters at least 3 days per week. **What You’ll Do*** Design, build, and operate the AWS\-based microservices and asynchronous workflows that power protocol generation, including API design, service boundaries, message\-driven communication, and integration points with the rest of the SaaS platform. * Apply systems design principles to how AI components fit into the broader architecture: request routing, service\-to\-service communication, data flow, and scaling under production load. * Build the ML/AI systems layer underneath the product: NLP pipelines for parsing scientist input, classifiers for routing and scoring requests, and embedding infrastructure that grounds model output in real protocol knowledge. * Build and iterate on knowledge retrieval and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, including chunking, embedding/indexing, and retrieval tuning. * Design and apply evaluation frameworks and rubrics to benchmark model and application output, and use them to drive iteration before issues reach production. * Build the cost and safety instrumentation — token spend tracking, guardrails, and validation — that keeps AI services trustworthy and sustainable at scale. * Instrument services for observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and build the monitoring needed to catch failures before customers do. * Support features post\-launch: on\-call debugging, incident response, and iterating on the architecture based on real production usage. **Who We’re Looking For**Education: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar field, or equivalent certifications and experience Experience: * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 3\+ years spent building, deploying, and maintaining production AI/ML or LLM\-powered applications. * Experience shipping and supporting a SaaS product through a real launch, including the operational work that follows. * Solid hands\-on experience working within cloud microservice architectures (AWS strongly preferred) including deploying, scaling, and operating microservices in production. * Systems design experience: API design, service boundaries, data flow, and the tradeoffs involved in scaling distributed systems. * Hands\-on experience building production AI or machine learning systems from prototype to production (building full systems layers beyond simply integrating third\-party APIs), including NLP and classifier work. * Experience building RAG pipelines: chunking, embedding/indexing, and retrieval tuning. * Experience designing evaluation frameworks or rubrics to measure AI output quality. Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:* Practical understanding of AI safety and cost discipline: guardrails, validation, and token spend monitoring. * Proficiency in React/TypeScript and Python/FastAPI, with experience designing RESTful APIs and full\-stack debugging. * Familiarity with Git workflows and CI/CD practices. * Strong communicator who can own features end\-to\-end, balance speed with code quality, and thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment. * Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, debugging, and writing maintainable code. * Comfort with ambiguity and iterating quickly based on evaluation results and feedback. **Working Conditions and Physical Effort*** Hybrid work environment based in New York with flexibility for remote days * Core collaboration hours with occasional overlap for international team coordination * Prolonged periods working at a computer for development work * Fast\-paced startup environment requiring ability to deliver features iteratively while maintaining quality * Minimal physical effort required. **Compensation:** The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $150,000 and $180,000 per year. Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and years of experience. We typically target mid\-range for well\-qualified candidates. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including bonus, equity and full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. Following employment, growth beyond the hiring range is possible based on performance. *Opentrons Labworks Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non\-merit factor.* *The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.* *\#LI\-Hybrid*

jobs.title: Quantum Physicist
jobs.description: **About the Company:** Opto\-Atomics Corp. is a growing R\&D company located in Torrance, California, focused on the development of quantum sensing technologies and the photonic systems that enable them. Our ongoing research and development efforts span atom\-based sensing and metrology—including Rydberg\-atom sensors and atom interferometers—as well as optical frequency combs, integrated photonics, and related technologies. As a small team of scientists and engineers, we work on technically challenging problems that span fundamental physics, engineering, and system development. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and goal\-oriented work environment where team members can take meaningful ownership of their work. **About the Position:** We are seeking an experienced scientist with a strong background in experimental atomic/optical physics, photonics, or a closely related field. The successful candidate will play a senior technical role in the development of next\-generation quantum sensing and photonic technologies, working closely with a small multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers. The position will involve both hands\-on laboratory work and technical leadership, from developing new concepts and designing experiments to building, testing, and demonstrating integrated prototype systems. A Ph.D. in physics, applied physics, electrical engineering, photonics, or a related field is preferred. Candidates with equivalent advanced industry or laboratory experience will also be considered. Hands\-on experience in one or more of the following areas is particularly desirable: (1\) Atom\-based sensing with atom interferometers, atomic magnetometers, Rydberg\-atom sensors, or atomic clocks (2\) Integrated photonics (3\) Levitated nano\- or micro\-particles (4\) Optical frequency combs The ideal candidate would be a self\-starter with a Ph.D. degree in atomic/optical physics (or a related field) and several years of hands\-on laboratory experience. The new team member will collaborate closely with a small group of scientists/engineers to develop cutting\-edge technologies in the emerging field of quantum sensing. **Who We’re Looking For:** · Brings an innovative mindset and understands how to translate scientific ideas into practical, real\-world technologies. · Maintains a high standard of technical rigor and attention to detail, from precise optical alignment and experimental measurements to the development of fully integrated prototype systems. · Can independently identify technical challenges, develop solutions, and drive experiments or development efforts forward. · Learns quickly and applies existing knowledge to unfamiliar and multidisciplinary problems. · Thrives in a dynamic R\&D environment, is comfortable wearing multiple hats, and enjoys working closely with scientists and engineers from different technical backgrounds. · Is highly capable and confident in the laboratory and comfortable working directly with sophisticated scientific equipment. · Communicates technical ideas clearly and works effectively as part of a small, collaborative team. **Responsibilities:** · Lead and contribute to the development and demonstration of scientific and engineering solutions in Opto\-Atomics' core technology areas. · Design, build, characterize, and troubleshoot experimental systems involving lasers, free\-space and fiber optics, RF/microwave components, vacuum systems, control electronics, and data\-acquisition hardware. · Develop experimental concepts and system architectures and translate them into working laboratory prototypes. · Conduct research independently and collaboratively, including modeling, design, assembly, testing, data analysis, and interpretation of experimental results. · Take technical ownership of selected projects or major technical work packages and help guide projects from concept through prototype demonstration. · Identify technical risks, develop mitigation strategies, and make informed engineering and scientific tradeoffs. · Develop control, data\-acquisition, modeling, and analysis software as needed. · Write and contribute to compelling technical proposals for government agencies and commercial partners. · Prepare technical reports, presentations, test documentation, and other project deliverables. · Present results and technical concepts to internal teams, customers, collaborators, and government program representatives. · Mentor and provide technical guidance to other scientists and engineers as appropriate. · Maintain thorough experimental records and documentation. This is a full\-time, in\-person position based at our Torrance, California facility. **Key Qualifications:** · Ph.D. in experimental atomic/optical physics, applied physics, photonics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent advanced industry experience. · Several years of hands\-on experimental or product\-development experience beyond graduate\-level research is strongly preferred. · Strong laboratory skills and proficiency with scientific instrumentation. · Experience designing, assembling, aligning, characterizing, and troubleshooting optical or electro\-optical systems. · Proficiency in data acquisition, processing, analysis, and interpretation. · Strong technical and scientific writing skills. · Proficiency with one or more scientific programming or development environments such as Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, C/C\+\+, or similar tools. · Ability to independently solve complex technical problems while working effectively within a multidisciplinary team. · Strong written and verbal communication skills. · Ability to work on projects subject to applicable U.S. government and export\-control requirements. **Additional Desired Skills:** Experience in one or more of the following areas would be advantageous: · Design and troubleshooting of electronic and optoelectronic circuits, including diode\-laser drivers, photodetectors, control electronics, and related instrumentation · Laser frequency stabilization, precision spectroscopy, nonlinear optics, or optical frequency conversion · RF and microwave electronics and measurement techniques · Vacuum\-system design and operation · Systems integration, prototype development, design modeling, and experimental hardware construction · Photonic integrated circuit design, fabrication, packaging, and testing · FPGA development, including Verilog or related tools · Optical and electromagnetic simulation tools such as Lumerical · Technical leadership of government\-funded R\&D programs · SBIR/STTR, DoD, NASA, DOE, or other government proposal preparation **Compensation:** The anticipated annual salary range for this position is **$110,000–$180,000**, depending on experience, technical background, and qualifications. **Benefits:** · 15\+ days of PTO and 12\+ days of paid holidays a year. · Company\-sponsored retirement plan. · Medical/health\-related cost reimbursement up to an annual maximum. · Relocation assistance. Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person
