If your instinct on a messy problem is to open an editor rather than schedule a working session, this is your role.**What you'll do** ------------------ * Embed with a business unit, diagnose where throughput or margin is lost, and ship a working agent against it inside the first few weeks. * Build production agent systems: tool use, planning loops, memory, retrieval, orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates where money or brand safety is on the line. * Integrate deeply against the commerce and ad platforms our revenue runs on: TikTok Shop and TikTok Ads, Meta and Instagram, Amazon, Shopify, Google, Snap, and affiliate and creator APIs. * Build data pipelines and analytics infrastructure that tie creator content, ad spend, and attributed GMV into one picture. * Build the evaluation harness alongside the agent. Nothing ships to production without a way to measure whether it is right. * Own the infrastructure: APIs, queues, auth and token refresh, observability, error handling, rate limits, and cost controls. * Instrument everything. Every system you ship gets tied to a number: hours returned, cycle time cut, spend efficiency, GMV or revenue supported. * Document it, drive adoption with the team that uses it, and keep improving it after launch. **Who you are** --------------- * Computer science or another technical background, or equivalent hands\-on experience as a developer or as a self\-taught AI\-native builder. We care about what you have shipped and whether it works, not where you learned it. * 3 to 5 years building and shipping software that other people depended on. * You can read, write, and debug Python or TypeScript. You have deployed and maintained real services and you understand what is happening underneath, whether you wrote every line yourself or built it alongside AI coding tools. * Hands\-on experience building LLM agent systems: function and tool calling, RAG, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, agent evals. * Real experience integrating third\-party marketing, ad, or commerce APIs. You know what OAuth token expiry, rate limiting, webhook replay, and undocumented API behavior actually cost you. * Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), containers, CI/CD, and SQL. * You work fluently with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. We expect you to build with them. We also expect you to be able to explain, debug, and defend what comes out of them. * You understand how performance marketing works: ROAS, CAC, attribution, creative testing, funnel mechanics, affiliate and creator economics. Or you can learn a domain fast and go deep, and you can prove it. * Entrepreneurial. You have built something of your own, a startup, a product, a side venture, an open source project, and can point to what you shipped and what it did. * High agency. You gather your own requirements, make the call, and ship. You do not wait for a spec, a committee, or a change management plan. * Able to sit with a senior executive or a brand's head of ecommerce, understand the business problem in their language, and translate it into a system without a translator in the room. **Nice to have:** direct experience with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, or Amazon Seller/Ads APIs. Background at a DTC brand, an ecommerce platform, a creator or affiliate network, or a performance agency. Prior forward deployed, applied AI, or founding engineer experience. **Benefits*** Competitive salary range: $90,000 \- $100,000 USD * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. * 401(k) plan with employer match. * Unlimited paid time off policy to support work\-life balance. * Professional development opportunities and budget. Please note that we do not offer Visa support of any type, and that the position is on\-site in Miami 4\-5 days per week.

jobs.title: Product Marketing
jobs.description: **About Adapt** Every company will have a central company agent. Adapt is the platform for building, running, and governing it. We connect the models a company chooses to its systems, data, people, and workflows. With persistent memory, secure compute, deep integrations, reusable skills, and enterprise controls, Adapt helps the agent understand real context, complete real work, and improve over time. We believe this infrastructure should be open, portable, secure, and controlled by the organizations that depend on it. Models will change. What a company builds with Adapt stays theirs. Join us in building the platform that will define how companies work with AI. **About the role** We are hiring Adapt's first dedicated product marketer. You will make a deeply technical and rapidly evolving product clear, relevant, and compelling to developers, technical leaders, enterprise buyers, and the broader open\-source community. You will develop a deep understanding of our customers, users, market, competitors, and product. You will turn that understanding into positioning, messaging, launches, customer stories, competitive materials, and sales enablement that help people understand why Adapt matters and how to adopt it. This is a hands\-on role on a small team. You will work directly with the CEO, Product, Engineering, Sales, customers, and open\-source users. You should be equally comfortable interviewing a developer, shaping a product narrative, writing launch copy, creating a sales narrative, and determining whether the message is working. **What you will own** * Customer and market insight. Build a continuous research practice across customers, prospects, developers, open\-source users, lost opportunities, and the broader market. Turn those insights into clear recommendations for Product, Sales, and company leadership. * Positioning and messaging. Define Adapt’s category narrative, product positioning, audience\-specific messages, value propositions, and competitive framing. * Segmentation and ICP. Clarify the users, buyers, companies, and use cases where Adapt delivers the most value. Help the company prioritize the right audiences and opportunities. * Product launches. Build a repeatable launch process with Product and Engineering. Translate capabilities and releases into clear stories, demonstrations, use cases, and distribution plans. * Open\-source product marketing. Help developers understand, evaluate, adopt, and advocate for Adapt. Partner with Engineering on release communication, documentation, GitHub presence, community feedback, and the path from open\-source usage to broader organizational adoption. * Customer evidence. Develop accurate, permissioned customer stories, demonstrations, proof points, and evidence of business impact. * Sales enablement. Give Sales the narratives, discovery insights, demonstrations, competitive guidance, and supporting materials needed to run effective technical and executive conversations. * Competitive intelligence. Maintain a current view of the market, alternatives, emerging categories, and changes in how companies build and deploy agents. * Packaging and adoption. Partner with Product, Sales, and leadership on packaging, pricing, activation, adoption, and the journey from individual developer interest to team and enterprise deployment. * Measurement and learning. Define how we evaluate messaging, launches, adoption, sales effectiveness, and product marketing programs. Use the results to improve what we say and what we build. **What success looks like** * Adapt has a clear, differentiated product and category story that Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership use consistently. * Developers and enterprise buyers quickly understand what Adapt is, why it is different, and how it fits into their existing AI stack. * Product launches are timely, technically credible, and supported by repeatable systems for research, messaging, demonstrations, enablement, and distribution. * Customer and open\-source community insights regularly influence product priorities, messaging, and go\-to\-market decisions. * Sales has effective, current materials for technical practitioners, champions, and executive buyers. * Adapt builds a growing body of credible customer evidence and product demonstrations. * We improve adoption and the path from initial product or open\-source engagement to team and enterprise deployment. **What we are looking for** * Experience marketing an open\-source product, developer platform, infrastructure product, or similarly technical product. * Experience working on a small or early\-stage team where you personally researched, wrote, launched, measured, and iterated. * Exceptional writing and editing, with the ability to make complex technical systems clear without making them generic or inaccurate. * Evidence of shaping positioning, launching products, and influencing product adoption or commercial outcomes. * Technical fluency across AI systems, APIs, infrastructure, developer tools, or enterprise software. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to earn credibility with engineers. * Strong customer and market research skills, including the ability to identify patterns without overgeneralizing from limited evidence. * Comfort moving between developers, technical leaders, end users, and executive buyers. * High judgment, curiosity, and a bias toward shipping useful work rather than waiting for perfect information or a large team. **Benefits** * Competitive compensation strategy including large equity grants for early hires at an early stage in the company's journey * Inclusive healthcare packages (medical, dental, vision) * Frontier AI access: Claude Code, OpenAI, Cursor, Codex, and most importantly unlimited internal use of Adapt itself Base salary: $150\-250k. Actual offer depends on skills, experience, and location. Total comp also includes equity, benefits, and potential bonus or variable pay. Your recruiter will walk you through the details. Adapt is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Adapt encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Co-op
jobs.description: Steelhead Technologies is on a mission to build the ERP that powers manufacturing. Our cloud\-based platform is purpose\-built for job shops — the powder coaters, platers, anodizers, heat treaters, and fabricators at the heartbeat of manufacturing. We give shops real\-time visibility into their operations, eliminate paper\-based inefficiencies, and bring AI to the shop floor through features like automated order entry and intelligent reporting. Our vision is simple: move manufacturing forward. Everything we build is in service of our north star — shops using Steelhead. **Our Values** * Customer Obsession \- Create dream outcomes for customers. * Relentless Curiosity \- Understand from first principles. * Integrity \- Everything we do is built on trust. * Ownership \- Success is not an accident * Conviction \- Whether you think you can, or you think you can't, you're right. **About the role** Steelhead Technologies is hiring a Software Engineer Co\-op. The co\-op will be full\-time 40 hours/week at our office in Calumet, Michigan. Candidates can apply for a 4\-month single semester co\-op or an 8\-month spring/summer or summer/fall co\-op. You’ll be working on the ERP that runs metal finishing and fabrication shops across the country. Our customers depend on Steelhead to run every part of their business — quoting, work orders, part tracking, inventory, job costing, invoicing. It isn't one tool among many for them; it's the system their entire operation runs on. That raises the stakes and it shortens the feedback loop considerably. Ship something good and you hear about it from the people using it. If something is off you’ll hear about it even faster. Few engineering roles offer that kind of directness. Our developers sit in the same room, which means questions get answered face\-to\-face. You’ll join a team of five engineers with a tech lead to help you grow in your role. You'll own features rather than tickets, and you won't wait for permission to take on hard problems. You act as the product manager for what you build. You’ll get requirements from shops using the software through deployment specialists, support, and sales. From there you have a big say in how the feature will work and will direct AI across the whole cycle to get it done. The stack is React, Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, and GraphQL. We're based in Calumet, in Michigan's Upper Peninsula. **Responsibilities** * Collect requirements from multiple sources and assist in development of features * AI\-native development using Claude Code or Cursor * Work with tech leads on architecture and data model design * Support the development of larger efforts through loops and multiple agents * Develop test plans for your feature and thoroughly test different workflows * Collaborate with QA to work through testing feedback * Collect feedback through operational logs and product metrics **What We're Looking For** * Currently pursuing a B.S. in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field * Available for a full\-time co\-op term (please note desired dates/duration when applying) * Coursework or project experience with SQL and data model design * Interest in or experience with AI\-native development * Strong written and oral communication skills * Action\-oriented and self\-directed * Focused on making great product experiences * Development experience with React.js or a similar web app framework Nice to have: * GraphQL experience * Experience with AI looping * AWS * Docker * DataDog

jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer
jobs.description: If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider WGU as the next step in your career. Driven by a mission to expand access to higher education through online, competency\-based degree programs, WGU is also committed to being a great place to work for a diverse workforce of student\-focused professionals. The university has pioneered a new way to learn in the 21st century, one that has received praise from academic, industry, government, and media leaders. Whatever your role, working for WGU gives you a part to play in helping students graduate, creating a better tomorrow for themselves and their families. The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is: Grade: Technical 414 Pay Range: $226,200\.00 \- $350,500\.00**Job Description** The Distinguished Software Engineer is a hands\-on technical leadership role responsible for advancing WGU’s software engineering practices, technical standards, architecture, and quality at enterprise scale. This role operates at the highest level of technical expertise, partnering closely with Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, engineering leaders, Product Management, and executive stakeholders to shape technology strategy and deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, reliable, observable, and built for long\-term reuse. The Distinguished Software Engineer serves as a technical thought leader across WGU, establishing engineering standards and raising the quality of software delivery across teams and domains. This includes designing and delivering high\-quality software, advancing automation and self\-service capabilities, enabling observability and operational controls, and developing self\-healing and resilient engineering practices. This individual pioneers new technologies and approaches that advance WGU’s student experience and technology platform. They evaluate emerging technologies, develop prototypes and proofs of concept, and translate innovative ideas into practical, scalable solutions. The Distinguished Software Engineer brings deep expertise in modern software engineering, architecture, cloud technologies, security, reliability, and development practices while understanding how technology decisions support WGU’s broader business and student\-success objectives. The role also has significant organizational influence. The Distinguished Software Engineer mentors engineers and technical leaders, strengthens engineering communities of practice, communicates complex technical strategies and trade\-offs to executives, and helps establish a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement aligned with WGU’s Leadership Principles. **Job Duties** * **Pioneer new technology approaches** that advance WGU’s online higher\-education platform, student experience, engineering capabilities, and operational efficiency. * **Define and advance enterprise engineering standards** for software development, architecture, quality, security, reliability, observability, automation, and operational excellence. * **Provide technical leadership for complex software and data architecture**, developing solutions that satisfy functional and non\-functional requirements while remaining scalable, resilient, secure, reusable, and cost\-effective. * **Partner with Principal and Senior Principal Engineers** to establish and continuously improve engineering practices, technical standards, and delivery artifacts across the organization. * **Partner with technology leaders and Product Management** to shape technology strategy, evaluate priorities, and make informed commitments to technical deliverables within WGU’s broader planning processes. * **Lead the design and delivery of high\-quality software** while maintaining a hands\-on presence in architecture, coding, prototyping, technical reviews, and complex problem solving. * **Drive engineering quality and consistency** by establishing coding standards, development practices, design patterns, testing strategies, and approaches that improve the overall quality and maintainability of WGU’s technology ecosystem. * **Design for enterprise scale, reliability, and performance**, particularly within public cloud and SaaS environments, using data and operational metrics to evaluate system health and key performance indicators. * **Advance observability, auditability, security, and operational controls**, incl ng change\-management practices to drive adoption of new technologies and approaches. * **Support initiatives focused on student success**, ensuring technology decisions ultimately contribute to a high\-quality, scalable, student\-focused experience. * **Execute against department OKRs** and other organizational priorities. * Perform other job\-related duties as assigned. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. * **15\+ years of progressive software engineering experience**, including experience pioneering new technologies or engineering approaches in complex, fast\-paced environments. * Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership across **multiple engineering teams or large\-scale technology initiatives**. * Extensive experience designing and developing web\-based applications and web services. * Strong experience with **Java, REST, SQL, Git**, and modern software engineering technologies. * Experience integrating third\-party products and enterprise systems. * Demonstrated experience with software architecture, technical standards, and engineering quality practices. * Equivalent relevant experience performing the essential functions of this position may substitute for education requirements. Generally, equivalent relevant experience is defined as one year of relevant experience for one year of education, at the discretion of the hiring manager. Preferred Qualifications * Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. * Experience with **Java, Spring, Spring Boot, Oracle, SQL, Git, Angular 2\+, and Amazon Web Services (AWS)**. * Deep experience with cloud\-native application development and enterprise\-scale distributed systems. * Experience establishing engineering standards, architecture practices, or technical communities across large organizations. * Experience with observability, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, self\-service engineering platforms, or self\-healing systems. * Experience working in or supporting **online or distance education environments**. * Strong understanding of the needs and technology challenges associated with serving distance\-learning students at scale. * Demonstrated experience evaluating and adopting emerging technologies to solve complex business or engineering problems. * Experience communicating technology strategy and architecture to senior executives and organizational leadership. **Position \& Application Details** Full\-Time Regular Positions (classified as regular and working 40 standard weekly hours): This is a full\-time, regular position (classified for 40 standard weekly hours) that is eligible for bonuses; medical, dental, vision, telehealth and mental healthcare; health savings account and flexible spending account; basic and voluntary life insurance; disability coverage; accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity supplemental coverages; legal and identity theft coverage; retirement savings plan; wellbeing program; discounted WGU tuition; and flexible paid time off for rest and relaxation with no need for accrual, flexible paid sick time with no need for accrual, 11 paid holidays, and other paid leaves, including up to 12 weeks of parental leave. How to Apply: If interested, an application will need to be submitted online. Internal WGU employees will need to apply through the internal job board in Workday. **Additional Information** Disclaimer: The job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job. It’s not all\-inclusive. Accommodations: Applicants with disabilities who require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process should contact our Talent Acquisition team at recruiting@wgu.edu. Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic as required by law.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering (Core Money Transfer)
jobs.description: LOCATION: US – Austin TYPE: Full time WORK SHIFT: Hybrid POSTED: September 8, 2026 ID: JR0131930 Overview At Western Union, we’re more than a trusted name in global payments. We’re moving beyond remittances, beyond cash, and beyond the expectations of our customers. Our talented teams enable us to transform into a digital\-first company, built on the strength of our retail foundation and powered by next\-generation payments. All this with the goal of helping people prosper. Our customers inspire us to push boundaries and create services that make life easier and communities stronger. Wherever you are in the world, we’re committed to shaping the next generation of financial experiences. Join us as we go beyond and be part of a team that’s redefining what’s possible. Are you ready to help modernize a software engineering organization that builds products connecting millions of users around the world? Are you seeking an opportunity to join a globally diverse organization where unique contributions are recognized and celebrated, and where everyone is empowered to thrive? Join Western Union as a Director, Software Engineering. Role Overview Western Union is seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering teams responsible for delivering critical capabilities across our Core Money Transfer platform. This leader will help shape the strategic direction of the platform, contribute to long\-term roadmap planning, drive execution against business priorities, and provide engineering leadership, coaching, and organizational direction on a day\-to\-day basis. The role oversees multiple engineering teams spanning software delivery, API services, and platform health and operations functions, and is accountable for delivering exceptional technology solutions and measurable business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Platform Delivery Guide the architectural direction of scalable, high\-performance systems by partnering with architects and engineering leaders to deliver resilient, secure, and highly available platforms. Deliver technical and business outcomes by making sound technology investment, architectural, and product trade\-off decisions that improve platform performance, profitability, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Champion quality, performance, and reliability across the platform, ensuring strong observability, automation, and operational excellence. Drive platform modernization initiatives that simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, improve resiliency, and accelerate delivery velocity. Accountable for platform availability, delivery predictability, engineering productivity, operational excellence, and customer\-impacting performance metrics. Operational Excellence Establish robust support and execution models to effectively manage ad\-hoc and operational requests without disrupting planned delivery. Advocate for developer experience through platform abstractions, tooling, and standards that enhance engineering productivity and consistency. Promote continuous improvement through modern engineering practices, CI/CD, and cloud\-native design principles. Lead engineering teams responsible for application support, API operations, platform health, and production reliability, ensuring strong operational discipline, service availability, incident management, vulnerability remediation, and continuous improvement across the Core Money Transfer and pricing ecosystems. People \& Culture Build and lead high\-performing teams of software engineers across regions by attracting, developing, and mentoring engineering talent while fostering a culture of accountability. Foster an engineering excellence culture grounded in strong coding standards, architectural discipline, innovation, accountability, and collaboration. Develop future leaders by strengthening technical leadership depth and scalability across the organization. Establish organizational goals, metrics, and operating mechanisms that improve execution predictability, engineering effectiveness, and business alignment. Manage engineering capacity, workforce planning, organizational design, and talent strategy across globally distributed teams. Leadership \& Collaboration Drive cross\-functional collaboration by partnering closely with Product Management, Data Engineering, and Operations teams to shape platform strategy and technical solutions. Influence the technology roadmap by aligning platform engineering strategy with business objectives and product priorities. Lead multiple engineering teams through the delivery lifecycle, ensuring predictable execution, technical excellence, and alignment with business objectives. Required Qualifications Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale software engineering organizations responsible for mission\-critical platforms and customer\-facing capabilities. BS in Computer Science or a related field with 12\+ years of professional experience, or MS with 10\+ years, including 6\+ years in an engin pipelines. Experience designing and delivering cloud\-based architectures (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or hybrid environments). Preferred Qualifications Experience in the Financial Services industry. AWS certification(s) preferred (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Developer, or equivalent). Hands\-on experience building and operating cloud\-native platforms in AWS, Azure, or hybrid environments. Experience with containerized microservices, Kubernetes, and modern API platforms. Familiarity with infrastructure as code, automated deployment pipelines, and platform observability. Familiarity with integrating AI tools into developer workflows (IDEs, CI/CD pipelines, code review systems). Awareness of emerging AI development tools and practices. Proven success leading globally distributed engineering organizations of 50\+ engineers, managers, and technical leaders responsible for highly available, scalable, mission\-critical platforms. Work Shift HYBRID – Western Union values in\-person collaboration, problem solving, and ideation whenever possible. We believe this fosters common ways of working and supports how we execute initiatives for our customers. The expectation is to work from the office a minimum of three days a week. BENEFITS AND OTHER DETAILS Benefits You will also have access to short\-term incentives, multiple health insurance options, accident and life insurance, and access to best\-in\-class development platforms, to name a few. Please see the benefits below specific to your country. If applicable, additional role\-specific benefits will be mentioned during your interview process or in an offer of employment. Your United States specific benefits include: Paid Time Off Medical, Dental and Life Insurance Tuition Assistance Program Student Loan Repayment (below manager level only) Parental Leave One day volunteer time off $0 Money Transfer Fee Discount Code – Quarterly Recognition Program “Game Changers” Employee Discount Program Global Adoption Assistance Global Scholarship Awards Program 401K plan For residents of Colorado, California, Connecticut, Delaware, Minnesota, and Pennsylvania: Please do not respond to any questions on this initial application that may seek age\-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You may also redact this information from any materials you submit during the application process. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. Salary The on\-target earnings range is $290,000\-$310,000 per year, which includes a base salary and short\-term and long\-term incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on candidates’ qualifications, skills, and competencies. Other Details As part of the application process, all applicants are required to take assessments. Western Union has partnered with a 3rd party provider to administer these tests. Applicants will need to provide their name and email address in order to process the assessments. If you have any questions, you may reach out to careers@westernunion.com. We are passionate about honoring our employee's identity and fostering a feeling of belonging. Our commitment is to provide an inclusive culture that celebrates the unique backgrounds and perspectives of our global teams while reflecting the communities we serve. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, political affiliation, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, or veteran status. The company will provide accommodation to applicants, including those with disabilities, during the recruitment process, following applicable laws. \#LI\-KS1 \#LI\-Hybrid Estimated Job Posting End Date: 10\-31\-2026 This application window is a good\-faith estimate of the time that this posting will remain open. jobs.title: Civil Project Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Westwood Professional Services, Inc.** is seeking a Project Engineer to join our Land Development team. Westwood has a highly experienced and dynamic team of individuals dedicated to providing high\-level professional services to our clients. Requirements: * Executes land development civil engineering projects efficiently (meets schedules and budgets) * Supports land development civil teams to produce civil plan sets. * Effectively manages internal support teams (survey, traffic, hydrology and hydraulics, etc.) – able to communicate/manage technical details as well as schedules and budgets. * Implements QA/QC program and ensures compliance within project team. * Works with City/County staff for approval of project plans. * Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously and allocate resources through differing project stages. * Administers the construction services portions of projects including RFI response, site meetings with contractors, etc. * Effectively leads up to five (5\) assigned technical personnel including: + Assigns and oversees project assignments; + Reviews work for accuracy and completeness; + Trains staff in civil engeering design and CAD/Civil3D; + Recommends compensation adjustments and/or promotions. The compensation for this position is competitive and will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, and qualification. Additionally, this is bonus\-eligible position, offering further potential for financial recognition based on performance and company success. **Required Skills and Abilities:** * Demonstrates competence in fundamental civil engineering design principles for land development projects. * Experienced in cost estimating, bid phase assistance construction administration, and general construction methods. * Demonstrates proficiency with current computer aided design (CAD/Civil 3D) and production software and ability to learn new versions or new technology. * Ability to read, analyze and interpret * Ability to write effective reports and correspondence * Construction document and 3D production ability * Possesses a firm understanding of engineering design for all aspects of site development along with current knowledge of industry trends, technology, codes and regulations * Embraces teamwork approach and possesses strong communication skills * Must possess strong technical skills * Proficiency in Microsoft Office products, AutoCAD and other discipline specific software **Education and Experience:** * Minimum of four (4\) years of experience in Land Development Engineering design. * Licensed Professional Engineer in respective state (or eligible for licensure in 6\-12 months). * Graduate from an accredited university or college with a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (Experience or degrees in other disciplines may be substituted at Management's discretion). **Other Duties:** Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **About Westwood Professional Services, Inc. (Westwood)** At Westwood, our purpose is to create a better world for people through our work. We transform the energy grid, design resilient infrastructure, and develop communities that will flourish today and for future generations. With over 50 years of experience and a legacy of innovation, we stand at the forefront of our industry, dedicated to understanding the unique needs of the markets we serve. Our approach revolves around people. We are committed to building a culture that attracts, retains, and develops high performers. Our team values relationships, innovation, dedication, initiative, and growth. We believe fostering a collaborative “One Team” mentality yields superior outcomes in everything we do. We customize our technical capabilities and geographic reach to meet our clients where they are and help them realize their vision. We are partners in our clients’ success, driving to provide solutions that make a lasting difference. Safety, sustainability, and operational excellence are not just facets of our work; they are intrinsic to our identity, guiding every decision we make. We are deeply invested in the communities we serve. Through our projects and giving\-back initiatives, we enrich the lives of those we serve, engage others within our industry, and create a lasting impact on communities around the world. jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer, App Platform
jobs.description: **Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!** --------------------------------------------- Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce. **Role** -------- App Platform is Whatnot's client infrastructure team, building the consistent, reliable foundation that every product team builds on top of across iOS, Android, and Web. Rather than owning a single feature surface, the team pushes technical boundaries so product pods can move fast without sacrificing quality — owning things like app stability and observability, the Whatnot Design System, localization, core components, and the shared architecture that keeps our apps performant and consistent at scale. As an Fullstack Engineer on App Platform, you'll focus on the infrastructure and building blocks that feature teams rely on: scaling our Web backend services, strengthening our networking and persistence layers, improving our client testing harnesses, driving app stability and crash reduction, and partnering closely with product teams to make sure the "right way" to build is also the easiest way. It's a high\-leverage role for someone who wants their work to compound across the entire app rather than a single feature. This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys shipping product\-facing platform work, cares deeply about user trust and message quality, and is excited by the challenge of building systems used by many teams across the company. **We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in\-person time for planning, problem\-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our New York or Seattle hub.** **You** ------- People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it. As our next Fullstack Engineer you should have 5\+ years of software development plus: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience. * Web development experience with React, using GraphQL for API development, and modern frontend applications (exposure to Next.js framework is not required but preferred). * Backend expertise: Proven track record of building end\-to\-end high\-scale product experiences as a fullstack engineer. Experience with Node or Python on backend, and/or Postgres databases is a plus. * Excellent product instincts—you first think about users rather than the best technical solution. * Care deeply about the craft of software engineering, maintaining systems at scale, and how to balance the productivity and velocity of teams while maintaining a high quality end\-user experience. * You can mentor others, and prioritize building inclusive, supportive teams. * Contribute to team\-wide ownership of production health, incident response, and continuous improvement of platform reliability. * Project owner—you’ve strong ownership instincts and can own projects from inception to production and beyond. * You are known for shipping products and features lightning\-fast. * You’re an excellent problem solver and can operate autonomously. * Ability to pick up on new technologies very quickly. * Proven track record of delivering features. **Benefits** ------------ * Generous Holiday and Time off Policy * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision * Work From Home Support + Home office setup allowance + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet * Care benefits + Monthly allowance for wellness + Annual allowance towards Childcare + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses * Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally * Monthly allowance to dogfood the app + All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **EOE** ------- Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce. Compensation Range: $207K \- $230K

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **DEPARTMENT:** **Product: Engineering** **POSITION:** **Applied AI Engineer** **REPORTS TO:** **Team Lead, Software Engineering** **SUPERVISES:** **None** **JOB CLASS:** **Exempt** **PURPOSE:** We’re building the next generation of AI\-powered experiences to support participants on their health journey, helping them achieve sustainable weight loss through meaningful behavioral change and guided, personalized experiences powered by applied AI. We’re looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help bring that vision to life by building and evolving our agent platform across orchestration, tool use, retrieval, safety, escalation, evaluation, and observability. Beyond the product, you’ll build AI automation for our engineering team, including agents and workflows that accelerate development, testing, code review, and delivery. If you see a repetitive engineering task, you’ll be expected to automate it. This role will be focused on building and evolving enterprise AI systems, not research prototypes. We’re looking for someone who has shipped production agent systems and understands real\-world challenges such as memory, evals, compaction, safety and control, and multi\-agent orchestration. Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent in\-house systems is a plus. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****:** * Develop and maintain LLM agent systems using AWS Bedrock, LangChain, and LangSmith, with transferable experience from comparable tools and frameworks. * Build and contribute to core agent capabilities, including tool use for knowledge retrieval, ticketing, and onboarding flows, agentic loops, and human\-in\-the\-loop interactions. * Develop and improve memory and context systems, including conversation history, participant memory, and summarization for long\-running interactions. * Develop and evolve multi\-agent and sub\-agent systems using explicit state and orchestration rather than prompt sprawl. * Implement and tune safety\-critical flows, including guardrails, adversarial handling, escalation routing, and lockout logic. * Build AI automation tools for engineering workflows, including code review assistance, testing automation, documentation generation, CI/CD intelligence, and developer productivity tools. * Champion agentic development practices and help other engineers adopt AI\-assisted workflows. * Implement end\-to\-end tracing and evaluation so every request, node, LLM call, and tool call is observable and easy to debug. * Manage model selection and cost/latency trade\-offs, including prompt caching and routing to smaller models where appropriate. * Integrate agent systems with platform services and third\-party tools, including support systems, vector databases, API gateways, and mobile/web clients. * Author technical design documents for new agent capabilities and contribute to architecture decisions. * Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews. * Demonstrable hands\-on experience building and operating production LLM/agent systems, with experience in at least few of the following: memory and context management, conversation summarization, workflow orchestration, or escalation. * Hands\-on experience with LLM evaluation methods, including automated evals, LLM\-as\-a\-judge, and regression testing. * Experience with RAG pipelines: vector databases (any, such as Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, Weaviate), embedding strategies, and retrieval quality tuning * Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and managed LLM services (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI). We use AWS, but experience across platforms is transferable. * Experience building safety and reliability mechanisms for LLM systems, including guardrails, adversarial handling, escalation paths, and failure modes. * Enthusiasm for AI\-assisted engineering workflows and hands\-on use of agentic coding tools to improve developer productivity through automation. * Strong communication skills. You can write clear technical design documents and explain trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical teammates. * A systems\-thinking mindset: you consider token cost, latency, reliability, failure modes, and user trust beyond just whether a demo works. * Operate production agent systems, including observability, incident response, debugging, evaluation, and continuous improvement. * Direct experience with AWS Bedrock, LLMs including open\-source models, LangChain/LangGraph, and LangSmith. * Experience with LLM observability and tracing in production systems. * Experience building internal developer tools or automation (e.g., AI\-assisted code review, test generation, CI/CD bots, documentation pipelines). * Experience in health tech or other high\-trust, safety\-sensitive domains (e.g., crisis handling, PHI, compliance\-aware systems). * Frontend experience with Vue or React Native. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** **Required:** * 3–5 years of solid backend engineering experience in a production environment, using Python or a similar programming language. **Additional experience that is a plus:** * Direct experience with AWS Bedrock, LLMs including open\-source models, LangChain/LangGraph, and LangSmith. * Experience with LLM observability and tracing in production systems. * Experience building internal developer tools or automation (e.g., AI\-assisted code review, test generation, CI/CD bots, documentation pipelines). * Experience in health tech or other high\-trust, safety\-sensitive domains (e.g., crisis handling, PHI, compliance\-aware systems). * Frontend experience with Vue or React Native. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:** In your first 30 days: You’re onboarded, shipping small PRs against the agent platform, contributing to code reviews, and tracing production conversations end\-to\-end to build context on how the agent works today. By 90 days: Contribute to agent capabilities end\-to\-end and participate in technical design discussions and documentation. By 6 months: You’ll contribute to architecture decisions with guidance from senior engineers, with a path toward owning them, and ship internal AI tooling used by the engineering team. **WHY WONDR:** * **Mission that matters.** The code you write directly affects people’s health outcomes. * **Build the AI platform** powering Wondr’s next generation of AI experiences, from agent orchestration and memory to tools, safety, and observability. * High\-impact engineering. Solve challenging problems at the intersection of AI and production engineering, with the opportunity to see your work reach real participants. * Shape how we build. Help establish the patterns, tooling, and engineering practices that will define how we build and operate AI systems at Wondr. * **Fully remote.** Work from wherever you do your best thinking. * **Growth opportunity.** You'll have a clear path from strong mid\-level contributor to senior engineer with system design ownership. * **Collaborative culture.** Small team, low ego, high trust. **DISCLAIMER:** This description is intended to be sufficient merely to identify the classification and be illustrative of the duties that may be assigned. It should not be interpreted to describe all the duties an employee assigned to this classification may be required to perform. Wondr Health is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need. jobs.description: **Minimum Qualifications** * 10\+ years in networking, HPC, or data center infrastructure engineering, including 7\+ years in a customer\-facing architecture role. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Deep working knowledge of NVIDIA networking platforms, including Quantum InfiniBand switch architecture (MLNX\-OS, UFM) and Spectrum\-X Ethernet running NVIDIA Cumulus Linux or SONiC. * Proficiency in RoCEv2 (RDMA over Converged Ethernet), including PFC and ECN, and a working architectural understanding of NVIDIA BlueField DPU and DOCA offload use cases. * Automation and infrastructure\-as\-code experience, with proficiency in Python and Ansible for switch configuration management. * Demonstrated ability to translate technical architecture into commercial outcomes for senior stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Industry background: experience within a systems integrator (SI) or managed service provider (MSP) environment. * Multi\-vendor exposure: Arista EOS for high\-performance AI Ethernet, or Cisco Nexus Dashboard for AI infrastructure. * Routing protocols: solid understanding of BGP, EVPN, and VXLAN for multi\-tenant isolation. * Compute integration: understanding of how the network interacts with the host OS (IPoIB, Netlink) and optimization of GPUDirect RDMA (GDR) and NCCL communication patterns. * Scale\-across: experience extending an InfiniBand fabric across multiple data center halls (NVIDIA MetroX). * Certifications: NVIDIA\-Certified Professional: AI Networking (NCP\-AIN); NVIDIA\-Certified Associate: AI Infrastructure and Operations (NCA\-AIIO); Arista ACE (Cloud Engineer); Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center. Certain states and localities require employers to post a reasonable estimate of salary range. A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $110,000\.00 to $150,000\.00 annually. Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including shift, location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base pay. The well\-being of WWT employees is essential. When it comes to our benefits package, WWT has one of the best. We offer the following benefits to all full\-time employees: * Health and Wellbeing: Health (Medical \& Prescription), Dental, and Vision Care, Onsite Health Centers (MO \& IL), Employee Assistance Program, Wellness program * Financial Benefits: Competitive Pay, Profit Sharing, 401k Plan with Company Matching, Life and Disability Insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Tuition Reimbursement * Paid Time Off: PTO \& Holidays, Parental Leave, Medical Leave, Military Leave, Bereavement, Day of Caring * Additional Perks: Family Planning Benefits, Nursing Mothers Benefits, Voluntary Legal, Voluntary Supplemental Accident/Illness/Hospital, Voluntary ID Theft, Pet Insurance, Employee Discount Program Note: This is not an all\-encompassing list and should not be used as a complete description of the plan's benefits. For more information, see our US benefits website at wwt.com/us\-benefits. We strive to create an environment where all employees are empowered to succeed based on their skills, performance, and dedication. Our goal is to cultivate a culture of belonging that encourages innovation, collaboration, and respect for all team members, ensuring that WWT remains a great place to work for all! If you require accessibility accommodation(s) or adjustment during any stage of the hiring process, please let your WWT Recruiter know. The recruiter will work with you to understand your needs and help ensure an accessible experience throughout the interview process. World Wide Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you have any questions or concerns about this posting, please email taposting@wwt.com. \#LI\-AF1 \#LI\-Remote Requirements: World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe. Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world\-class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state\-of\-the\-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distributions capabilities. With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for   enterprise AI cloud deployments, owning the network layer of the compute, network, and storage stack. Your time will be split roughly 60/40 between delivering complex AI infrastructure (60%) and providing pre\-sales subject matter expertise (40%). You will lead the physical provisioning of InfiniBand and Spectrum\-X Ethernet fabrics for NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD, NVIDIA DGX BasePOD, and Cisco AI POD environments, ensuring clients inherit platforms that are genuinely ready for day\-2 operations, while helping the sales team scope and cost future deployments. **Key Responsibilities** **Delivery and implementation** **High\-performance fabric design** * Architect and deploy non\-blocking fat\-tree (Clos) topologies using NVIDIA Quantum\-2 (NDR) and Quantum\-3 (XDR) InfiniBand switches, and NVIDIA Spectrum\-4 Ethernet switches. * Implement rail\-optimized network designs so GPU\-to\-GPU traffic aligns with compute\-node PCIe topology, minimizing latency for NCCL collective operations. * Configure adaptive routing, congestion control, and quality of service (QoS) to prevent head\-of\-line blocking and guarantee lossless data delivery. **In\-network computing and offload strategy** * InfiniBand: enable and tune SHARP (Scalable Hierarchical Aggregation and Reduction Protocol) on Quantum switches to offload collective operations (AllReduce, ReduceScatter) from the GPU to the switch silicon. * Ethernet: architect high\-performance Ethernet AI fabrics using SmartNIC/DPU offload (NVIDIA BlueField\-3\) to accelerate collective operations and isolate management traffic from the data path. * Evaluate and roadmap emerging Ultra Ethernet Consortium (UEC) standards as the practice transitions in\-network collectives from proprietary InfiniBand toward open Ethernet. * Tune RoCEv2, PFC, and ECN on Ethernet fabrics and SmartNICs to approximate InfiniBand\-class lossless behavior. **Fabric management, automation, and telemetry** * Deploy NVIDIA UFM (Unified Fabric Manager) to manage InfiniBand subnets and NetQ for Ethernet fabric telemetry; implement PTP for nanosecond\-level clock synchronization across the cluster. * Use automation and AI\-assisted tooling to generate switch configuration from the P2P cabling schedule, LLD, and PDG, then validate every topology in NVIDIA DSX Air before it ever touches hardware. * Monitor fabric health continuously to identify slow receivers and link degradation in real time, and maintain Python and Ansible\-based infrastructure\-as\-code for ongoing configuration management. **Layer 1 precision and performance engineering** * Own the physical cabling strategy, defining cable schedules (DAC, AOC, or OSFP transceivers) that meet signal\-integrity requirements over the required distances. * Validate the link budget to ensure optical loss stays within acceptable limits for 400G and 800G links. * Conduct acceptance and validation testing using NCCL tests to verify fabric performance against expected baselines. **Pre\-sales SME and consulting** **Technical scoping and estimation** * Calculate the bisectional bandwidth required for a client's workload (for example, training typically requires 1:1 non\-blocking; inference may tolerate 3:1 oversubscription), and produce accurate level\-of\-effort (LOE) estimates for statements of work. **Bill of materials validation and architecture** * Own the technical accuracy of the network bill of materials, validating that every switch, transceiver, and cable is on the NVIDIA or OEM hardware compatibility list (HCL). * Manage the complexity of breakout cables (for example, 800G to 2x400G) and connector types (OSFP, QSFP112\) to prevent on\-site installation failures. **Client workshops** * Educate clients on the difference between standard enterprise Ethernet (lossy, TCP\-based) and AI fabric (lossless, RDMA\-based) traffic. * Design the integration point between the high\-speed “back\-end” AI fabric and the client's existing “front\-end” management network, including BGP/EVPN handoffs.

jobs.title: Director, Finance Systems Strategy and Transformation
jobs.description: Who we are We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence. We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500\+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way. Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit. Why Worldwide We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands\-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us! **What** **The Director, Finance Systems Strategy and Transformation does at Worldwide** Serves as the enterprise leader responsible for evolving the Finance technology stack and data architecture in alignment with the shift to Artificial Intelligence (AI) and intelligent automation. This role acts as a senior advisor and transformation leader to Finance leadership across Accounts Payable, Procurement, Accounts Receivable, Accounting, Tax, Project Finance, Treasury, and Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A). The Director owns the multi\-year Finance transformation roadmap, leads programs and projects focused on delivering measurable business outcomes, and partners closely with process engineers, data engineers, and enterprise architecture to modernize systems, streamline operations, and embed AI\-driven capabilities across the finance function. Success in this role requires deep expertise in finance systems architecture, a strong command of AI and automation trends, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, governed, and high\-impact technology solutions within a complex, global enterprise environment. **What you will do** * Serve as the primary transformation leader across the Finance front, middle, and back\-office Finance domains * Own and maintain the multi\-year Finance Transformation roadmap, with a clear focus on evolving the technology stack and data architecture to support AI and automation * Lead complex, cross\-functional programs and projects from concept through hypercare, ensuring measurable outcomes tied to efficiency, accuracy, controls, and business impact * Partner closely with process engineers to identify improvement opportunities, eliminate manual effort, reduce cycle times, and re\-engineer end\-to\-end finance processes * Develop and document business requirements, translating Finance leader pain points and strategic objectives into actionable technology\-based solutions * Evaluate build versus buy decisions across Finance domains, with a preference for commoditized, proven platforms where appropriate and a clear rationale where custom builds deliver differentiated capability * Partner with Finance leads across the domains to define target operating models, align solution design, and ensure adoption * Collaborate with data engineers and the enterprise data team on data governance, master data management, and data quality standards required to enable trusted analytics, reporting, and AI use cases * Lead forward\-thinking AI initiatives across the Finance function, including agentic Finance use cases, predictive forecasting, intelligent document processing, anomaly detection, and automated reconciliations * Ensure alignment to governance, explainability, and control frameworks for AI and automation deployed within the Finance technology landscape * Architect the evolution of the Finance technology stack to ensure scalability, integration, and resilience * Drive vendor evaluations, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and assessments for new Finance platforms * Work closely with the Finance Systems team to manage relationships with strategic vendors and ensure value realization through renewals and roadmap alignment * Partner with enterprise architecture, integration, and security teams to ensure all solutions adhere to architectural standards, data protection, and compliance requirements * Lead stakeholder communications, executive updates, and steering committee forums, translating technical strategy into clear, business\-ready language for Finance leaders and the broader executive team * Define and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and benefit realization metrics for each transformation initiative, ensuring measurable outcomes are delivered and reported * Provide day\-to\-day guidan 3 direct reports (business analysts/architects) * Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all\-inclusive. **What you bring to the role** * Deep understanding of Finance operations across the various domains, including upstream and downstream process dependencies * Strong working knowledge of AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation applied to Finance, including agentic AI, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), and embedded platform capabilities * Proven ability to architect and evolve enterprise Finance technology stacks and data architectures * Ability to build trusted partnerships with Finance, Information Technology (IT), Data, and business process leaders * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technology and data concepts into executive\-ready language * Strategic mindset combined with strong systems\-thinking and architectural capabilities * Strong program leadership skills, with a track record of delivering measurable outcomes on large, complex initiatives * High attention to detail with a strong focus on governance, data quality, controls, and auditability * Comfortable operating in a global, matrixed organization with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities * Strong problem\-solving skills and comfort managing ambiguity in evolving transformation environments **Your experience** * 10\+ years of experience in finance transformation, finance systems, or enterprise technology leadership roles * Demonstrated experience evolving finance technology stacks and data architectures in Review work products and provide guidance on standards, design, and troubleshooting. Lead technical workstreams within governance programs, including effort scoping, delivery sequencing, and progress reporting. * Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with data owners, data stewards, platform engineering, enterprise architecture, and cyber security to translate governance policy into enforceable technical controls. jobs.title: IT Service Desk & SLA Operations Manager
jobs.description: The IT Service Desk \& SLA Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of all IT support tickets, from initial intake through resolution and closure. This role demands unrelenting ownership: you will follow every ticket on its entire journey to the end\-of\-the\-earth to achieve resolution in a timely and effective manner. Driven by a "Simple Sets You Free" mindset, this role actively strips away bureaucratic friction, eliminates operational waste, and continuously optimizes IT service management processes to maximize efficiency, speed up ticket resolution, and boost customer satisfaction. ### **In This Role, You Will...** End\-to\-End Ticket Ownership \& Lifecycle Management * Relentless Resolution Ownership: Personally track and follow tickets on their entire journey to the end\-of\-the\-earth, taking total responsibility until issues are thoroughly, accurately, and effectively resolved. Queue Administration \& Triage: Monitor, triage, and assign incoming incidents, service requests, and problem tickets across multi\-tiered support teams with speed and accuracy.* Closure \& Quality Control: Validate that all tickets are properly documented, root causes are identified, and end\-users confirm resolution before ticket closure. * Escalation Management: Identify aging, stuck, or high\-priority (P1/P2\) tickets and proactively cross organizational boundaries to drive action and prevent SLA breaches. Process Optimization \& Friction Elimination ("Simple Sets You Free") * Bottleneck Identification: Continuously audit ticket lifecycles, intake workflows, and escalation paths to pinpoint bottlenecks, redundant approvals, or process inefficiencies that delay issue reporting and resolution. * Streamlined Workflows: Design and implement intuitive, simplified ticketing processes and self\-service channels that make it effortless for users to report issues and for technicians to resolve them. * Root\-Cause Process Fixing: Collaborate across IT and business departments to re\-engineer flawed processes, remove unnecessary handoffs, and eliminate administrative bloat slowing down resolution times. * Automation \& Lean Operations: Champion lean service desk practices by eliminating obsolete procedures, automating routine tasks, and establishing straightforward, zero\-friction standards across all support tiers. SLA \& Metric Tracking * SLA Monitoring: Enforce and monitor compliance against core SLAs (First Response Time, Mean Time to Resolution \[MTTR], First Contact Resolution \[FCR], and Customer Satisfaction \[CSAT]). * Reporting \& Dashboards: Design, build, and maintain real\-time operational dashboards and weekly/monthly executive report packs using ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk). * Trend Analysis: Analyze incident data to detect recurring technical issues, capacity bottlenecks, or process failures, feeding insights directly into Problem Management. Process Governance \& Continuous Improvement * ITIL \& Lean Governance: Standardize and enforce streamlined incident management processes, simplified escalation pathways, and consistent ticket categorization/tagging. * Vendor \& Cross\-Team Coordination: Hold internal technical teams and external IT vendors accountable to contractual response and resolution targets while streamlining joint operational workflows. * Customer Feedback: Manage the CSAT survey process, follow up on negative feedback, and implement actionable improvement plans based on direct user input. ### **Qualifications** * 3–5\+ years in IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations, or Service Desk leadership roles with demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end ticket management and lean process optimization. * Unwavering ownership mentality—willing to follow a ticket to the end\-of\-the\-earth to see it resolved. * Strong lean operational mindset focused on process simplification and waste reduction. * Advanced proficiency in ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, BMC Helix, Freshservice, etc.). * Deep expertise in analytics/BI platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Excel/Google Sheets advanced reporting). ### **Bonus Qualifications** * ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification * Excellent written/verbal communication * Strong analytical problem\-solving * Proven ability to simplify complex technical workflows under tight SLA timelines **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance. **About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Robot Software Infrastructure
jobs.description: Zoox's Robot Software Infrastructure team is seeking a passionate software engineer to help develop Robot software and infrastructure to advance the common performant operating system that powers several devices on our vehicle including Autonomy systems. This team develops platform\-level software and services, including operating systems that enable complex, hardware\-accelerated workloads critical for autonomous driving on automotive\-grade hardware. We work closely with cross\-functional teams—including application software engineering, release management, hardware engineering, manufacturing and operations—to support vehicle development and deployment at scale. If you are excited to explore a wide problem space and are mindful of how components fit within a larger system, you may be a great fit! ### **In this role, you will:** * Design, develop, and maintain the operating system platform that powers various on\-bot devices and applications * Architect and implement platform\-level software to support robust and scalable robotics infrastructure * Configure and manage embedded Linux build systems (e.g., Yocto) and bootloader processes (e.g., U\-Boot) to ensure reliable system startup and maintenance * Develop and optimize device drivers and kernel\-space components using C, C\+\+, or Rust to meet performance and reliability requirements * Collaborate cross\-functionally to support seamless integration and delivery of the OS platform, triage issues, support new hardware bring\-up and manufacturing functions ### **Qualifications:** * 8\+ years delivering production systems and software applications * Designed and deployed end\-to\-end continuous integration and validation toolchains to verify Linux/OS images for production software releases supporting different hardware platforms * Proficiency in Linux internals, including init systems, containerization, filesystems, kernel\-space development, device drivers, and systems programming in C/C\+\+ and scripting languages (Python/Bash). * Strong written and verbal communication skills along with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience ### **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience with embedded Linux in a robotics application * Familiarity with security software: PKI, secure boot, OTA software update, hardware key storage, etc. * Familiarity with Nvidia GPUs, Nvidia Thor/Orin, Cuda, TRT, etc. * Graduate degree with a focus on networking, operating systems, or firmware **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.**About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
